verses.sa:
सोमस्य मा तवसं वक्ष्यग्ने वह्निं चकर्थ विदथे यजध्यै ।
देवाँ अच्छा दीद्यद् युञ्जे अद्रिं शमाये अग्ने तन्वं जुषस्व॥
verses.tr: somasya mā tavasaṃ vakṣyagne vahniṃ cakartha vidathe yajadhyai devāṃ acchā dīdyad yuñje adriṃ śamāye agne tanvaṃ juṣasva
verses.en: Thou, Agni, who wilt have the strong, hast made me the Soma's priest, to worship in assembly. Thou shinest to the Gods, I set the press stones. I toil; be joyful in thyself, O Agni.

verses.sa:
प्राञ्चं यज्ञं चकृम वर्धतां गीः समिद्भिरग्निं नमसा दुवस्यन् ।
दिवः शशासुर्विदथा कवीनां गृत्साय चित् तवसे गातुमीषुः॥
verses.tr: prāñcaṃ yajñaṃ cakṛma vardhatāṃ gīḥ samidbhiragniṃ namasā duvasyan divaḥ śaśāsurvidathā kavīnāṃ gṛtsāya cit tavase gātumīṣuḥ
verses.en: East have we turned the rite; may the hymn aid it. With wood and worship shall they honour Agni. From heaven the synods of the wise have learnt it: c'en for the quick and strong they seek advancement.

verses.sa:
मयो दधे मेधिरः पूतदक्षो दिवः सुबन्धुर्जनुषा पृथिव्याः ।
अविन्दन्नु दर्शतमप्स्व१न्तर्देवासो अग्निमपसि स्वसॄणाम्॥
verses.tr: mayo dadhe medhiraḥ pūtadakṣo divaḥ subandhurjanuṣā pṛthivyāḥ avindannu darśatamapsva1ntardevāso agnimapasi svasṝṇām
verses.en: The Prudent, he whose will is pure, brought welfare, allied by birth to Heaven and Earth in kinship. The Gods discovered in the midst of waters beautiful Agni with the Sisters' labour.

verses.sa:
अवर्धयन् त्सुभगं सप्त यह्वीः श्वेतं जज्ञानमरुषं महित्वा ।
शिशुं न जातमभ्यारुरश्वा देवासो अग्निं जनिमन् वपुष्यन्॥
verses.tr: avardhayan tsubhagaṃ sapta yahvīḥ śvetaṃ jajñānamaruṣaṃ mahitvā śiśuṃ na jātamabhyāruraśvā devāso agniṃ janiman vapuṣyan
verses.en: Him, Blessed One, the Seven strong Floods augmented, him white at birth and red when waxen mighty. As mother mares run to their new-born you ling, so at his birth the Gods wondered at Agni.

verses.sa:
शुक्रेभिरङ्गै रज आततन्वान् क्रतुं पुनानः कविभिः पवित्रैः ।
शोचिर्वसानः पर्यायुरपां श्रियो मिमीते बृहतीरनूनाः॥
verses.tr: śukrebhiraṅgai raja ātatanvān kratuṃ punānaḥ kavibhiḥ pavitraiḥ śocirvasānaḥ paryāyurapāṃ śriyo mimīte bṛhatīranūnāḥ
verses.en: Spreading with radiant limbs throughout the region, purging his power with wise purifications, Robing himself in light, the life of waters, lie spreads abroad his high and perfect glories.

verses.sa:
वव्राजा सीमनदतीरदब्धा दिवो यह्वीरवसाना अनग्नाः ।
सना अत्र युवतयः सयोनीरेकं गर्भं दधिरे सप्त वाणीः॥
verses.tr: vavrājā sīmanadatīradabdhā divo yahvīravasānā anagnāḥ sanā atra yuvatayaḥ sayonīrekaṃ garbhaṃ dadhire sapta vāṇīḥ
verses.en: He sought heaven's Mighty Ones, the unconsuming, the unimpaired, not clothed and yet not naked. Then they, ancient and young, who dwell together, Seven sounding Rivers, as one germ received him.

verses.sa:
स्तीर्णा अस्य संहतो विश्वरूपा घृतस्य योनौ स्रवथे मधूनाम् ।
अस्थुरत्र धेनवः पिन्वमाना मही दस्मस्य मातरा समीची॥
verses.tr: stīrṇā asya saṃhato viśvarūpā ghṛtasya yonau sravathe madhūnām asthuratra dhenavaḥ pinvamānā mahī dasmasya mātarā samīcī
verses.en: His piles, assuming every form, are scattered where flow sweet waters, at the spring of fatness; There stood the milch-kine with full-laden udders, and both paired Mighty Mothers of the Wondrous.

verses.sa:
बभ्राणः सूनो सहसो व्यद्यौद् दधानः शुक्रा रभसा वपूंषि ।
श्चोतन्ति धारा मधुनो घृतस्य वृषा यत्र वावृधे काव्येन॥
verses.tr: babhrāṇaḥ sūno sahaso vyadyaud dadhānaḥ śukrā rabhasā vapūṃṣi ścotanti dhārā madhuno ghṛtasya vṛṣā yatra vāvṛdhe kāvyena
verses.en: Carefully cherished, Son of Strength, thou showest assuming lasting and refulgent beauties. Full streams of fatness and sweet juice descended, there where the Mighty One grew strong by wisdom.

verses.sa:
पितुश्चिदूधर्जनुषा विवेद व्यस्य धारा असृजद्वि धेनाः ।
गुहा चरन्तं सखिभिः शिवेभिर्दिवो यह्वीभिर्न गुहा बभूव॥
verses.tr: pituścidūdharjanuṣā viveda vyasya dhārā asṛjadvi dhenāḥ guhā carantaṃ sakhibhiḥ śivebhirdivo yahvībhirna guhā babhūva
verses.en: From birth he knew even his Father's bosom, he set his voices and his streams in motion; Knew him who moved with blessed Friends in secret, with the young Dames of heaven. He stayed not hidden.

verses.sa:
पितुश्च गर्भं जनितुश्च बभ्रे पूर्वीरेको अधयत्पी पीप्यानाः ।
वृष्णे सपत्नी शुचये सबन्धू उभे अस्मै मनुष्ये३ नि पाहि॥
verses.tr: pituśca garbhaṃ janituśca babhre pūrvīreko adhayatpī pīpyānāḥ vṛṣṇe sapatnī śucaye sabandhū ubhe asmai manuṣye3 ni pāhi
verses.en: He nursed the Infant of the Sire and Maker: alone the Babe sucked many a teeming bosom. Guard, for the Bright and Strong, the fellow-spouses friendly to men and bound to him in kinship.

verses.sa:
उरौ महाँ अनिबाधे ववर्धाऽऽपो अग्निं यशसः सं हि पूर्वीः ।
ऋतस्य योनावशयद् दमूना जामीनामग्निरपसि स्वसॄणाम्॥
verses.tr: urau mahāṃ anibādhe vavardhā''po agniṃ yaśasaḥ saṃ hi pūrvīḥ ṛtasya yonāvaśayad damūnā jāmīnāmagnirapasi svasṝṇām
verses.en: The Mighty One increased in space unbounded; full many a glorious flood gave strength to Agni. Friend of the house, within the lap of Order lay Agni, in the Sister Rivers' service.

verses.sa:
अक्रो न बभ्रिः समिथे महीनां दिदृक्षेयः सूनवे भाऋजीकः ।
उदुस्रिया जनिता यो जजानाऽपां गर्भो नृतमो यह्वो अग्निः॥
verses.tr: akro na babhriḥ samithe mahīnāṃ didṛkṣeyaḥ sūnave bhāṛjīkaḥ udusriyā janitā yo jajānā'pāṃ garbho nṛtamo yahvo agniḥ
verses.en: As keen supporter where great waters gather, light-shedder whom the brood rejoice to look on; He who begat, and will beget, the dawnlights, most manly, Child of Floods, is youthful Agni.

verses.sa:
अपां गर्भं दर्शतमोषधीनां वना जजान सुभगा विरूपम् ।
देवासश्चिन्मनसा सं हि जग्मुः पनिष्ठं जातं तवसं दुवस्यन्॥
verses.tr: apāṃ garbhaṃ darśatamoṣadhīnāṃ vanā jajāna subhagā virūpam devāsaścinmanasā saṃ hi jagmuḥ paniṣṭhaṃ jātaṃ tavasaṃ duvasyan
verses.en: Him, varied in his form, the lovely Infant of floods and plants the blessed wood hath gendered. Gods even, moved in spirit, came around him, and served him at his birth, the Strong, the Wondrous.

verses.sa:
बृहन्त इद् भानवो भाऋजीकमग्निं सचन्त विद्युतो न शुक्राः ।
गुहेव वृद्धं सदसि स्वे अन्तरपार ऊर्वे अमृतं दुहानाः॥
verses.tr: bṛhanta id bhānavo bhāṛjīkamagniṃ sacanta vidyuto na śukrāḥ guheva vṛddhaṃ sadasi sve antarapāra ūrve amṛtaṃ duhānāḥ
verses.en: Like brilliant lightnings, mighty luminaries accompany the light-diffusing Agni, Waxen, as 'twere in secret, in his dwelling, while in the boundless stall they milk out Amrta.

verses.sa:
ईळे च त्वा यजमानो हविर्भिरीळे सखित्वं सुमतिं निकामः ।
देवैरवो मिमीहि सं जरित्रे रक्षा च नो दम्येभिरनीकैः॥
verses.tr: īḻe ca tvā yajamāno havirbhirīḻe sakhitvaṃ sumatiṃ nikāmaḥ devairavo mimīhi saṃ jaritre rakṣā ca no damyebhiranīkaiḥ
verses.en: I sacrificing serve thee with oblations and crave with longing thy good-will and friendship. Grant, with the Gods, thy grace to him who lauds thee, protect us with thy rays that guard the homestead.

verses.sa:
उपक्षेतारस्तव सुप्रणीतेऽग्ने विश्वानि धन्या दधानाः ।
सुरेतसा श्रवसा तुञ्जमाना अभि ष्याम पृतनायूँरदेवान्॥
verses.tr: upakṣetārastava supraṇīte'gne viśvāni dhanyā dadhānāḥ suretasā śravasā tuñjamānā abhi ṣyāma pṛtanāyūṃradevān
verses.en: May we, O Agni, thou who leadest wisely, thy followers and masters of all treasures, Strong in the glory of our noble offspring, subdue the godless when they seek the battle.

verses.sa:
आ देवानामभवः केतुरग्ने मन्द्रो विश्वानि काव्यानि विद्वान् ।
प्रति मर्ताँ अवासयो दमूना अनु देवान् रथिरो यासि साधन्॥
verses.tr: ā devānāmabhavaḥ keturagne mandro viśvāni kāvyāni vidvān prati martāṃ avāsayo damūnā anu devān rathiro yāsi sādhan
verses.en: Ensign of Gods hast thou become, O Agni, joy-giver, knower of all secret wisdom. Friend of the homestead, thou hast lightened mortals: car borne thou goest to the Gods, fulfilling.

verses.sa:
नि दुरोणे अमृतो मर्त्यानां राजा ससाद विदथानि साधन् ।
घृतप्रतीक उर्विया व्यद्यौदग्निर्विश्वानि काव्यानि विद्वान्॥
verses.tr: ni duroṇe amṛto martyānāṃ rājā sasāda vidathāni sādhan ghṛtapratīka urviyā vyadyaudagnirviśvāni kāvyāni vidvān
verses.en: Within the house hath sate the King immortal of mortals, filling full their sacred synods. Bedewed with holy oil he shineth widely, Agni, the knower of all secret wisdom.

verses.sa:
आ नो गहि सख्येभिः शिवेभिर्महान् महीभिरूतिभिः सरण्यन् ।
अस्मे रयिं बहुलं संतरुत्रं सुवाचं भागं यशसं कृधी नः॥
verses.tr: ā no gahi sakhyebhiḥ śivebhirmahān mahībhirūtibhiḥ saraṇyan asme rayiṃ bahulaṃ saṃtarutraṃ suvācaṃ bhāgaṃ yaśasaṃ kṛdhī naḥ
verses.en: Come unto us with thine auspicious friendship, come speeding, Mighty, with thy mighty succours. Grant us abundant wealth that saves from danger, that brings a good repute, a glorious portion.

verses.sa:
एता ते अग्ने जनिमा सनानि प्र पूर्व्याय नूतनानि वोचम् ।
महान्ति वृष्णे सवना कृतेमा जन्मञ्जन्मन् निहितो जातवेदाः॥
verses.tr: etā te agne janimā sanāni pra pūrvyāya nūtanāni vocam mahānti vṛṣṇe savanā kṛtemā janmañjanman nihito jātavedāḥ
verses.en: To thee who art of old these songs, O Agni, have I declared, the ancient and the later. These great libations to the Strong are offiered: in every birth is Jatavedas stablished.

verses.sa:
जन्मञ्जन्मन् निहितो जातवेदा विश्वामित्रेभिरिध्यते अजस्रः ।
तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्याऽपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम॥
verses.tr: janmañjanman nihito jātavedā viśvāmitrebhiridhyate ajasraḥ tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyā'pi bhadre saumanase syāma
verses.en: Stablished in every birth is Jatavedas, kindled perpetual by the Visvamitras. May we rest ever in the loving-kindness, in the auspicious grace of him the Holy.

verses.sa:
इमं यज्ञं सहसावन् त्वं नो देवत्रा धेहि सुक्रतो रराणः ।
प्र यंसि होतर्बृहतीरिषो नोऽग्ने महि द्रविणमा यजस्व॥
verses.tr: imaṃ yajñaṃ sahasāvan tvaṃ no devatrā dhehi sukrato rarāṇaḥ pra yaṃsi hotarbṛhatīriṣo no'gne mahi draviṇamā yajasva
verses.en: This sacrifice of ours do thou, O Mighty, O truly Wise, bear to the Gods rejoicing. Grant us abundant food, thou priestly Herald, vouchsafe to give us ample wealth, O Agni.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावा ऽग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे॥
verses.tr: iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvā 'gne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme
verses.en: As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels. To us he born a son, and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानराय धिषणामृतावृधे घृतं न पूतमग्नये जनामसि ।
द्विता होतारं मनुषश्च वाघतो धिया रथं न कुलिशः समृण्वति॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarāya dhiṣaṇāmṛtāvṛdhe ghṛtaṃ na pūtamagnaye janāmasi dvitā hotāraṃ manuṣaśca vāghato dhiyā rathaṃ na kuliśaḥ samṛṇvati
verses.en: To him, Vaisvanara, who strengthens Holy Law, to Agni we present our praise like oil made pure. With thoughtful insight human priests bring him anear, our Herald from of old, as an axe forms a car.

verses.sa:
स रोचयज्जनुषा रोदसी उभे स मात्रोरभवत्पुत्र ईड्यः ।
हव्यवाळग्निरजरश्चनोहितो दूळभो विशामतिथिर्विभावसुः॥
verses.tr: sa rocayajjanuṣā rodasī ubhe sa mātrorabhavatputra īḍyaḥ havyavāḻagnirajaraścanohito dūḻabho viśāmatithirvibhāvasuḥ
verses.en: He made the heaven and earth resplendent by his birth: Child of two Mothers he was meet to be implored, Agni, oblation-bearer, gracious, ever-young, infallible, rich in radiant light, the guest of men.

verses.sa:
क्रत्वा दक्षस्य तरुषो विधर्मणि देवासो अग्निं जनयन्त चित्तिभिः ।
रुरुचानं भानुना ज्योतिषा महामत्यं न वाजं सनिष्यन्नुप ब्रुवे॥
verses.tr: kratvā dakṣasya taruṣo vidharmaṇi devāso agniṃ janayanta cittibhiḥ rurucānaṃ bhānunā jyotiṣā mahāmatyaṃ na vājaṃ saniṣyannupa bruve
verses.en: Within the range of their surpassing power, by might, the Gods created Agni with inventive thought. I, eager to win strength, address him, like a steed, resplendent with his brilliance, with his ample light.

verses.sa:
आ मन्द्रस्य सनिष्यन्तो वरेण्यं वृणीमहे अह्रयं वाजमृग्मियम् ।
रातिं भृगूणामुशिजं कविक्रतुमग्निं राजन्तं दिव्येन शोचिषा॥
verses.tr: ā mandrasya saniṣyanto vareṇyaṃ vṛṇīmahe ahrayaṃ vājamṛgmiyam rātiṃ bhṛgūṇāmuśijaṃ kavikratumagniṃ rājantaṃ divyena śociṣā
verses.en: Eager to gain, we crave from him the friendly God strength confident, choice worthy meet to be extolled: The Bhrgus' bounty, willing, strong with sages' lore, even Agni shining forth with light that comes from heaven.

verses.sa:
अग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जना वाजश्रवसमिह वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
यतस्रुचः सुरुचं विश्वदेव्यं रुद्रं यज्ञानां साधदिष्टिमपसाम्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janā vājaśravasamiha vṛktabarhiṣaḥ yatasrucaḥ surucaṃ viśvadevyaṃ rudraṃ yajñānāṃ sādhadiṣṭimapasām
verses.en: For happiness, men, having trimmed the sacred grass, set Agni glorious for his strength before them here; Yea, with raised ladles, him bright, dear to all the Gods, perfecting aims of works, Rudra of solemn rites.

verses.sa:
पावकशोचे तव हि क्षयं परि होतर्यज्ञेषु वृक्तबर्हिषो नरः ।
अग्ने दुव इच्छमानास आप्यमुपासते द्रविणं धेहि तेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: pāvakaśoce tava hi kṣayaṃ pari hotaryajñeṣu vṛktabarhiṣo naraḥ agne duva icchamānāsa āpyamupāsate draviṇaṃ dhehi tebhyaḥ
verses.en: Around thy dwelling-place, O brightly-shining Priest, are men at sacrifice, whose sacred grass is trimmed. Wishing to do thee service, Agni, they are there, desirous of thy friendship grant them store of wealth.

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी अपृणदा स्वर्महज्जातं यदेनमपसो अधारयन् ।
सो अध्वराय परि णीयते कविरत्यो न वाजसातये चनोहितः॥
verses.tr: ā rodasī apṛṇadā svarmahajjātaṃ yadenamapaso adhārayan so adhvarāya pari ṇīyate kaviratyo na vājasātaye canohitaḥ
verses.en: He hath filled heaven and earth and the great realm of light, when at his birth the skillful held him in their hold. He like a horse is led forth to the sacrifice Sage, graciously inclined, that he may win us strength.

verses.sa:
नमस्यत हव्यदातिं स्वध्वरं दुवस्यत दम्यं जातवेदसम् ।
रथीर्ऋतस्य बृहतो विचर्षणिरग्निर्देवानामभवत् पुरोहितः॥
verses.tr: namasyata havyadātiṃ svadhvaraṃ duvasyata damyaṃ jātavedasam rathīrṛtasya bṛhato vicarṣaṇiragnirdevānāmabhavat purohitaḥ
verses.en: Honour the oblation-bearer, him who knows fair rites, serve ye the Household Friend who knows all things that be. He drives the chariot of the lofty ordinance: Agni most active, is the great High Priest of Gods.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो यह्वस्य समिधः परिज्मनोऽग्नेरपुनन्नुशिजो अमृत्यवः ।
तासामेकामदधुर्मर्त्ये भुजमु लोकमु द्वे उप जामिमीयतुः॥
verses.tr: tisro yahvasya samidhaḥ parijmano'gnerapunannuśijo amṛtyavaḥ tāsāmekāmadadhurmartye bhujamu lokamu dve upa jāmimīyatuḥ
verses.en: They who are free from death, fain for him, purified three splendours of the mighty Agni, circling all. To man, for his enjoyment, one of these they gave: the other two have passed into the sister sphere.

verses.sa:
विशां कविं विश्पतिं मानुषीरिषः सं सीमकृण्वन् त्स्वधितिं न तेजसे ।
स उद्वतो निवतो याति वेविषत् स गर्भमेषु भुवनेषु दीधरत्॥
verses.tr: viśāṃ kaviṃ viśpatiṃ mānuṣīriṣaḥ saṃ sīmakṛṇvan tsvadhitiṃ na tejase sa udvato nivato yāti veviṣat sa garbhameṣu bhuvaneṣu dīdharat
verses.en: Man's sacrificial food hath sharpened like an axe, for brightness, him the Sage of men, the people's Lord, Busied with sacred rites he mounts and he descends. He hath laid down his vital germ within these worlds.

verses.sa:
स जिन्वते जठरेषु प्रजज्ञिवान् वृषा चित्रेषु नानदन्न सिंहः ।
वैश्वानरः पृथुपाजा अमर्त्यो वसु रत्ना दयमानो वि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: sa jinvate jaṭhareṣu prajajñivān vṛṣā citreṣu nānadanna siṃhaḥ vaiśvānaraḥ pṛthupājā amartyo vasu ratnā dayamāno vi dāśuṣe
verses.en: He stirs with life in wombs dissimilar in kind, born as a Lion or a loudly-bellowing Bull: Vaisvanara immortal with wide-reaching might, bestowing goods and wealth on him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरः प्रत्नथा नाकमारुहद् दिवस्पृष्ठं भन्दमानः सुमन्मभिः ।
स पूर्ववज्जनयञ्जन्तवे धनं समानमज्मं पर्येति जागृविः॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānaraḥ pratnathā nākamāruhad divaspṛṣṭhaṃ bhandamānaḥ sumanmabhiḥ sa pūrvavajjanayañjantave dhanaṃ samānamajmaṃ paryeti jāgṛviḥ
verses.en: Vaisvanara, as of old, mounted the cope of heaven, heaven's ridge, well greeted, by those skilled in noble songs. He, as of old, producing riches for the folk, still watchful, traverses the common way again.

verses.sa:
ऋतावानं यज्ञियं विप्रमुक्थ्य१मा यं दधे मातरिश्वा दिवि क्षयम् ।
तं चित्रयामं हरिकेशमीमहे सुदीतिमग्निं सुविताय नव्यसे॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvānaṃ yajñiyaṃ vipramukthya1mā yaṃ dadhe mātariśvā divi kṣayam taṃ citrayāmaṃ harikeśamīmahe sudītimagniṃ suvitāya navyase
verses.en: For new prosperity we seek to Agni, him whose course is splendid, gold-haired, excellently bright, Whom Matarisvan stablished, dweller in the heaven, meet for high praise and holy, sage and true to Law.

verses.sa:
शुचिं न यामन्निषिरं स्वर्दृशं केतुं दिवो रोचनस्थामुषर्बुधम् ।
अग्निं मूर्धानं दिवो अप्रतिष्कुतं तमीमहे नमसा वाजिनं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: śuciṃ na yāmanniṣiraṃ svardṛśaṃ ketuṃ divo rocanasthāmuṣarbudham agniṃ mūrdhānaṃ divo apratiṣkutaṃ tamīmahe namasā vājinaṃ bṛhat
verses.en: As pure and swift of course, beholder of the light, who stands in heaven's bright sphere a sign, who wakes at dawn, Agni, the head of heaven, whom none may turn aside-to him the Powerful with mighty prayer we seek.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रं होतारं शुचिमद्वयाविनं दमूनसमुक्थ्यं विश्वचर्षणिम् ।
रथं न चित्रं वपुषाय दर्शतं मनुर्हितं सदमिद् राय ईमहे॥
verses.tr: mandraṃ hotāraṃ śucimadvayāvinaṃ damūnasamukthyaṃ viśvacarṣaṇim rathaṃ na citraṃ vapuṣāya darśataṃ manurhitaṃ sadamid rāya īmahe
verses.en: The cheerful Priest, the pure, in whom no guile is found, Friend of the House, praise-worthy, dear to all mankind, Fair to behold for beauty like a splendid car,- Agni the Friend of men we ever seek for wealth.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानराय पृथुपाजसे विपो रत्ना विधन्त धरुणेषच गातवे ।
अग्निर्हि देवाँ अमृतो दुवस्यत्यथा धर्माणि सनता न दूदुषत्॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarāya pṛthupājase vipo ratnā vidhanta dharuṇeṣaca gātave agnirhi devāṃ amṛto duvasyatyathā dharmāṇi sanatā na dūduṣat
verses.en: To him who shines afar, Vaisvanara, shall bards give precious things that he may go on certain paths: For Agni the Immortal serves the Deities, and therefore never breaks their everlasting laws.

verses.sa:
अन्तर्दूतो रोदसी दस्म ईयते होता निषत्तो मनुषः पुरोहितः ।
क्षयं बृहन्तं परि भूषति द्युभिर्देवेभिरग्निरिषितो धियावसुः॥
verses.tr: antardūto rodasī dasma īyate hotā niṣatto manuṣaḥ purohitaḥ kṣayaṃ bṛhantaṃ pari bhūṣati dyubhirdevebhiragniriṣito dhiyāvasuḥ
verses.en: He, wondrous envoy, goes between the earth and heaven, firm seated as the Herald, great High Priest of men. He compasseth with rays the lofty dwelling-place, Agni, sent forward by the Gods, enriched with piayer.

verses.sa:
केतुं यज्ञानां विदथस्य साधनं विप्रासो अग्निं महयन्त चित्तिभिः ।
अपांसि यस्मिन्नधि संदधुर्गिरस्तस्मिन्त्सुम्नानि यजमान आ चके॥
verses.tr: ketuṃ yajñānāṃ vidathasya sādhanaṃ viprāso agniṃ mahayanta cittibhiḥ apāṃsi yasminnadhi saṃdadhurgirastasmintsumnāni yajamāna ā cake
verses.en: Sages shall glorify Agni with earnest thoughts, ensign of sacrifice, who fills the synod full: In whom the singers have stored up their holy acts to him the worshipper looks for joy and happiness.

verses.sa:
पिता यज्ञानामसुरो विपश्चितां विमानमग्निर्वयुनं च वाघताम् ।
आ विवेश रोदसी भूरिवर्पसा पुरुप्रियो भन्दते धामभिः कविः॥
verses.tr: pitā yajñānāmasuro vipaścitāṃ vimānamagnirvayunaṃ ca vāghatām ā viveśa rodasī bhūrivarpasā purupriyo bhandate dhāmabhiḥ kaviḥ
verses.en: The Sire of sacrifice, great God of holy bards, Agni, the measure and the symbol of the priests, Hath entered heaven and earth that show in varied form: the Sage whom many love rejoiceth in his might.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमग्निं चन्द्ररथं हरिव्रतं वैश्वानरमप्सुषदं स्वर्विदम् ।
विगाहं तूर्णिं तविषीभिरावृतं भूर्णिं देवास इह सुश्रियं दधुः॥
verses.tr: candramagniṃ candrarathaṃ harivrataṃ vaiśvānaramapsuṣadaṃ svarvidam vigāhaṃ tūrṇiṃ taviṣībhirāvṛtaṃ bhūrṇiṃ devāsa iha suśriyaṃ dadhuḥ
verses.en: Bright Agni with the bright car, Lord of green domains, Vaisvanara dweller in the floods, who finds the light, Pervading, swift and wild, encompassed round with powers, him very glorious have the Gods established here.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्देवेभिर्मनुषश्च जन्तुभिस्तन्वानो यज्ञं पुरुपेशसं धिया ।
रथीरन्तरीयते साधदिष्टिभिर्जीरो दमूना अभिशस्तिचातनः॥
verses.tr: agnirdevebhirmanuṣaśca jantubhistanvāno yajñaṃ purupeśasaṃ dhiyā rathīrantarīyate sādhadiṣṭibhirjīro damūnā abhiśasticātanaḥ
verses.en: Agni, together with the Gods and Manu's folk by thought extending sacrifice in varied form, Goes, car-borne, to and fro with those who crown each rite, the fleet, the Household Friend, who turns the curse aside.

verses.sa:
अग्ने जरस्व स्वपत्य आयुन्यूर्जा पिन्वस्व समिषो दिदीहि नः ।
वयांसि जिन्व बृहतश्च जागृव उशिग्देवानामसि सुक्रतुर्विपाम्॥
verses.tr: agne jarasva svapatya āyunyūrjā pinvasva samiṣo didīhi naḥ vayāṃsi jinva bṛhataśca jāgṛva uśigdevānāmasi sukraturvipām
verses.en: Sing, Agni, for long life to us and noble sons: teem thou with plenty, shine upon us store of food. Increase the great man's strength, thou ever-vigilant: thou, longing for the Gods, knowest their hymns full well.

verses.sa:
विश्पतिं यह्वमतिथिं नरः सदा यन्तारं धीनामुशिजं च वाघताम् ।
अध्वराणां चेतनं जातवेदसं प्र शंसन्ति नमसा जूतिभिर्वृधे॥
verses.tr: viśpatiṃ yahvamatithiṃ naraḥ sadā yantāraṃ dhīnāmuśijaṃ ca vāghatām adhvarāṇāṃ cetanaṃ jātavedasaṃ pra śaṃsanti namasā jūtibhirvṛdhe
verses.en: The Mighty One, Lord of the people and their guest, the leader of their thoughts, devoted Friend of priests, Our solemn rites' announcer, Jatavedas, men with worship ever praise, with urgings for their weal.

verses.sa:
विभावा देवः सुरणः परि क्षितीरग्निर्बभूव शवसा सुमद्रथः ।
तस्य व्रतानि भूरिपोषिणो वयमुप भूषेम दम आ सुवृक्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: vibhāvā devaḥ suraṇaḥ pari kṣitīragnirbabhūva śavasā sumadrathaḥ tasya vratāni bhūripoṣiṇo vayamupa bhūṣema dama ā suvṛktibhiḥ
verses.en: Agni the God resplendent, giver of great joy, hath on his lovely car compassed the lands with, might. Let us with pure laudations in his house approach the high laws of the nourisher of multitudes.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानर तव धामान्या चके येभिः स्वर्विदभवो विचक्षण ।
जात आपृणो भुवनानि रोदसी अग्ने ता विश्वा परिभूरसि त्मना॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānara tava dhāmānyā cake yebhiḥ svarvidabhavo vicakṣaṇa jāta āpṛṇo bhuvanāni rodasī agne tā viśvā paribhūrasi tmanā
verses.en: I celebrate thy glories, O Vaisvanara, wherewith thou, O farsighted God, has found the light. Thou filledst at thy birth both worlds, the earth and heaven: all this, O Agni, hast thou compassed of thyself.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरस्य दंसनाभ्यो बृहदरिणादेकः स्वपस्यया कविः ।
उभा पितरा महयन्नजायताग्निर्द्यावापृथिवी भूरिरेतसा॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānarasya daṃsanābhyo bṛhadariṇādekaḥ svapasyayā kaviḥ ubhā pitarā mahayannajāyatāgnirdyāvāpṛthivī bhūriretasā
verses.en: By his great skill the Sage alone hath brought to pass a great deed, mightier than Vaisvanara's wondrous acts. Agni sprang into being, magnifying both his Parents, Heaven and Earth, rich in prolific seed.

verses.sa:
समित्समित् सुमना बोध्यस्मे शुचाशुचा सुमतिं रासि वस्वः ।
आ देव देवान् यजथाय वक्षि सखा सखीन् त्सुमना यक्ष्यग्ने॥
verses.tr: samitsamit sumanā bodhyasme śucāśucā sumatiṃ rāsi vasvaḥ ā deva devān yajathāya vakṣi sakhā sakhīn tsumanā yakṣyagne
verses.en: Be friendly with each kindled log of fuel, with every flash bestow the boon of riches. Bring thou the Gods, O God, unto our worship: serve, well-inclined, as Friend thy friends, O Agni.

verses.sa:
यं देवासस्त्रिरहन्नायजन्ते दिवेदिवे वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ।
सेमं यज्ञं मधुमन्तं कृधी नस्तनूनपाद् घृतयोनिं विधन्तम्॥
verses.tr: yaṃ devāsastrirahannāyajante divedive varuṇo mitro agniḥ semaṃ yajñaṃ madhumantaṃ kṛdhī nastanūnapād ghṛtayoniṃ vidhantam
verses.en: Agni whom daily Varuna and Mitra the Gods bring thrice a day to this our worship, Tanunapat, enrich with meath our service that dwells with holy oil, that offers honour.

verses.sa:
प्र दीधितिर्विश्ववारा जिगाति होतारमिळः प्रथमं यजध्यै ।
अच्छा नमोभिर्वृषभं वन्दध्यै स देवान् यक्षदिषितो यजीयान्॥
verses.tr: pra dīdhitirviśvavārā jigāti hotāramiḻaḥ prathamaṃ yajadhyai acchā namobhirvṛṣabhaṃ vandadhyai sa devān yakṣadiṣito yajīyān
verses.en: The thought that bringeth every boon proceedeth to worship first the Priest of the libation, That we may greet the Strong One with our homage. Urged, may he bring the Gods, best Sacrificer.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो वां गातुरध्वरे अकार्यूर्ध्वा शोचींषि प्रस्थिता रजांसि ।
दिवो वा नाभा न्यसादि होता स्तृणीमहि देवव्यचा वि बर्हिः॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo vāṃ gāturadhvare akāryūrdhvā śocīṃṣi prasthitā rajāṃsi divo vā nābhā nyasādi hotā stṛṇīmahi devavyacā vi barhiḥ
verses.en: On high your way to sacrifice was made ready; the radiant flames went upward to the regions. Full in the midst of heaven the Priest is seated: strew we the sacred grass where Gods may rest them.

verses.sa:
सप्त होत्राणि मनसा वृणाना इन्वन्तो विश्वं प्रति यन्नृतेन ।
नृपेशसो विदथेषु प्र जाता अभी३मं यज्ञं वि चरन्त पूर्वीः॥
verses.tr: sapta hotrāṇi manasā vṛṇānā invanto viśvaṃ prati yannṛtena nṛpeśaso vidatheṣu pra jātā abhī3maṃ yajñaṃ vi caranta pūrvīḥ
verses.en: Claiming in mind the seven priests' burnt oblations, inciting all, they came in settled order. To this our sacrifice approach the many who show in hero beauty at assemblies.

verses.sa:
आ भन्दमाने उषसा उपाके उत स्मयेते तन्वा३ विरूपे ।
यथा नो मित्रो वरुणो जुजोषदिन्द्रो मरुत्वाँ उत वा महोभिः॥
verses.tr: ā bhandamāne uṣasā upāke uta smayete tanvā3 virūpe yathā no mitro varuṇo jujoṣadindro marutvāṃ uta vā mahobhiḥ
verses.en: Night and Dawn, lauded, hither come together, both smiling, different are their forms in colour, That Varuna and Mitra may accept us, and Indra, girt by Maruts, with his glories.

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा न्यृञ्जे सप्त पृक्षासः स्वधया मदन्ति ।
ऋतं शंसन्त ऋतमित् त आहुरनु व्रतं व्रतपा दीध्यानाः॥
verses.tr: daivyā hotārā prathamā nyṛñje sapta pṛkṣāsaḥ svadhayā madanti ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛtamit ta āhuranu vrataṃ vratapā dīdhyānāḥ
verses.en: I crave the grace of heaven's two chief Invokers: the seven swift steeds joy in their wonted manner. These speak of truth, praising the truth eternal, thinking on Order as the guards of Order.

verses.sa:
आ भारती भारतीभिः सजोषा इळा देवैर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः ।
सरस्वती सारस्वतेभिरर्वाक् तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं सदन्तु॥
verses.tr: ā bhāratī bhāratībhiḥ sajoṣā iḻā devairmanuṣyebhiragniḥ sarasvatī sārasvatebhirarvāk tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ sadantu
verses.en: May Bharati with all her Sisters, Ila accordant with the Gods, with immortal Agni, Sarasvati with all her kindred Rivers, come to this grass, Three Goddesses, and seat them.

verses.sa:
तन्नस्तुरीपमध पोषयित्नु देव त्वष्टर्वि रराणः स्यस्व ।
यतो वीरः कर्मण्यः सुदक्षो युक्तग्रावा जायते देवकामः॥
verses.tr: tannasturīpamadha poṣayitnu deva tvaṣṭarvi rarāṇaḥ syasva yato vīraḥ karmaṇyaḥ sudakṣo yuktagrāvā jāyate devakāmaḥ
verses.en: Well pleased with us do thou O God, O Tvastar, give ready issue to our procreant vigour, Whence springs the hero, powerful, skilled in action, lover of Gods, adjuster of the press-stones.

verses.sa:
वनस्पतेऽव सृजोप देवानग्निर्हविः शमिता सूदयाति ।
सेदु होता सत्यतरो यजाति यथा देवानां जनिमानि वेद॥
verses.tr: vanaspate'va sṛjopa devānagnirhaviḥ śamitā sūdayāti sedu hotā satyataro yajāti yathā devānāṃ janimāni veda
verses.en: Send to the Gods the oblation, Lord of Forests; and let the Immolator, Agni, dress it. He as the truer Priest shall offer worship, for the Gods' generations well he knoweth.

verses.sa:
आ याह्यग्ने समिधानो अर्वाङिन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं तुरेभिः ।
बर्हिर्न आस्तामदितिः सुपुत्रा स्वाहा देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ā yāhyagne samidhāno arvāṅindreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ turebhiḥ barhirna āstāmaditiḥ suputrā svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām
verses.en: Come thou to us, O Agni, duly kindled, together with the potent Gods and Indra. On this our grass sit Aditi, happy Mother, and let our Hail delight the Gods Immortal.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्निरुषसश्चेकितानोऽबोधि विप्रः पदवीः कवीनाम् ।
पृथुपाजा देवयद्भिः समिद्धोऽप द्वारा तमसो वह्निरावः॥
verses.tr: pratyagniruṣasaścekitāno'bodhi vipraḥ padavīḥ kavīnām pṛthupājā devayadbhiḥ samiddho'pa dvārā tamaso vahnirāvaḥ
verses.en: Agni who shines against the Dawns is wakened. The holy Singer who precedes the sages. With far-spread lustre, kindled by the pious, the Priest hath thrown both gates of darkness open.

verses.sa:
प्रेद्वग्निर्वावृधे स्तोमेभिर्गीर्भिः स्तोतॄणां नमस्य उक्थैः ।
पूर्वीर्ऋतस्य संदृशश्चकानः सं दूतो अद्यौदुषसो विरोके॥
verses.tr: predvagnirvāvṛdhe stomebhirgīrbhiḥ stotṝṇāṃ namasya ukthaiḥ pūrvīrṛtasya saṃdṛśaścakānaḥ saṃ dūto adyauduṣaso viroke
verses.en: Agni hath waxen mighty by laudations, to be adored with hymns of those who praise him. Loving the varied shows of holy Order at the first flush of dawn he shines as envoy.

verses.sa:
अधाय्यग्निर्मानुषीषु विक्ष्व१पां गर्भो मित्र ऋतेन साधन् ।
आ हर्यतो यजतः सान्वस्थादभूदु विप्रो हव्यो मतीनाम्॥
verses.tr: adhāyyagnirmānuṣīṣu vikṣva1pāṃ garbho mitra ṛtena sādhan ā haryato yajataḥ sānvasthādabhūdu vipro havyo matīnām
verses.en: Amid men's homes hath Agni been established, fulfilling with the Law, Friend, germ of waters. Loved and adored, the height he hath ascended, the Singer, object of our invocations.

verses.sa:
मित्रो अग्निर्भवति यत् समिद्धो मित्रो होता वरुणो जातवेदाः ।
मित्रो अध्वर्युरिषिरो दमूना मित्रः सिन्धूनामुत पर्वतानाम्॥
verses.tr: mitro agnirbhavati yat samiddho mitro hotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ mitro adhvaryuriṣiro damūnā mitraḥ sindhūnāmuta parvatānām
verses.en: Agni is Mitra when enkindled duly, Mitra as Priest, Varuna, Jatavedas; Mitra as active minister, and House-Friend, Mitra of flowing rivers and of mountains.

verses.sa:
पाति प्रियं रिपो अग्रं पदं वेः पाति यह्वश्चरणं सूर्यस्य ।
पाति नाभा सप्तशीर्षाणमग्निः पाति देवानामुपमादमृष्वः॥
verses.tr: pāti priyaṃ ripo agraṃ padaṃ veḥ pāti yahvaścaraṇaṃ sūryasya pāti nābhā saptaśīrṣāṇamagniḥ pāti devānāmupamādamṛṣvaḥ
verses.en: The Earth's, the Bird's dear lofty place he guardeth, he guardeth in his might the course of Surya, Guardeth the Seven-headed in the centre, guardeth sublime the Deities enjoyment.

verses.sa:
ऋभुश्चक्र ईड्यं चारु नाम विश्वानि देवो वयुनानि विद्वान् ।
ससस्य चर्म घृतवत् पदं वेस्तदिदग्नी रक्षत्यप्रयुच्छन्॥
verses.tr: ṛbhuścakra īḍyaṃ cāru nāma viśvāni devo vayunāni vidvān sasasya carma ghṛtavat padaṃ vestadidagnī rakṣatyaprayucchan
verses.en: The skillful God who knows all forms of knowledge made for himself a fair form, meet for worship. This Agni guards with care that never ceases the Sonia's skin, the Bird's place rich in fatness.

verses.sa:
आ योनिमग्निर्घृतवन्तमस्थात् पृथुप्रगाणमुशन्तमुशानः ।
दीद्यानः शुचिर्ऋष्वः पावकः पुनःपुनर्मातरा नव्यसी कः॥
verses.tr: ā yonimagnirghṛtavantamasthāt pṛthupragāṇamuśantamuśānaḥ dīdyānaḥ śucirṛṣvaḥ pāvakaḥ punaḥpunarmātarā navyasī kaḥ
verses.en: Agni hath entered longingly the longing shrine rich with fatness, giving easy access. Resplendent, pure, sublime and purifying, again, again he renovates his Mothers.

verses.sa:
सद्यो जात ओषधीभिर्ववक्षे यदी वर्धन्ति प्रस्वो घृतेन ।
आप इव प्रवता शुम्भमाना उरुष्यदग्निः पित्रोरुपस्थे॥
verses.tr: sadyo jāta oṣadhībhirvavakṣe yadī vardhanti prasvo ghṛtena āpa iva pravatā śumbhamānā uruṣyadagniḥ pitrorupasthe
verses.en: Born suddenly, by plants he grew to greatness, when tender shoots with holy oil increased him, Like waters lovely when they hasten downward may Agni in his Parents' lap protect us.

verses.sa:
उदु ष्टुतः समिधा यह्वो अद्यौद् वर्ष्मन् दिवो अधि नाभा पृथिव्याः ।
मित्रो अग्निरीड्यो मातरिश्वा ऽऽ दूतो वक्षद् यजथाय देवान्॥
verses.tr: udu ṣṭutaḥ samidhā yahvo adyaud varṣman divo adhi nābhā pṛthivyāḥ mitro agnirīḍyo mātariśvā '' dūto vakṣad yajathāya devān
verses.en: Extolled, the Strong shone forth with kindled fuel to the earth's centre, to the height of heaven. May Agni, Friend, adorable Matarisvan, as envoy bring the Gods unto our worship.

verses.sa:
उदस्तम्भीत्समिधा नाकमृष्वो३ऽग्निर्भवन्नुत्तमो रोचनानाम् ।
यदी भृगुभ्यः परि मातरिश्वा गुहा सन्तं हव्यवाहं समीधे॥
verses.tr: udastambhītsamidhā nākamṛṣvo3'gnirbhavannuttamo rocanānām yadī bhṛgubhyaḥ pari mātariśvā guhā santaṃ havyavāhaṃ samīdhe
verses.en: Best of all luminaries lofty Agni supported with his flame the height of heaven, When, far from Bhrgus, Matarisvan kindled the oblation-bearer where he lay in secret.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावा ऽग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे॥
verses.tr: iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvā 'gne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme
verses.en: As holy food, Agni to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels. To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-word.

verses.sa:
प्र कारवो मनना वच्यमाना देवद्रीचीं नयत देवयन्तः ।
दक्षिणावाड् वाजिनी प्राच्येति हविर्भरन्त्यग्नये घृताची॥
verses.tr: pra kāravo mananā vacyamānā devadrīcīṃ nayata devayantaḥ dakṣiṇāvāḍ vājinī prācyeti havirbharantyagnaye ghṛtācī
verses.en: Urged on by deep devotion, O ye singers, bring, pious ones, the God-approaching ladle. Borne onward to the right it travels eastward, and, filled with oil, to Agni bears oblation.

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी अपृणा जायमान उत प्र रिक्था अध नु प्रयज्यो ।
दिवश्चिदग्ने महिना पृथिव्या वच्यन्तां ते वह्नयः सप्तजिह्वाः॥
verses.tr: ā rodasī apṛṇā jāyamāna uta pra rikthā adha nu prayajyo divaścidagne mahinā pṛthivyā vacyantāṃ te vahnayaḥ saptajihvāḥ
verses.en: Thou at thy birth didst fill both earth and heaven, yea, Most Adorable, thou didst exceed them. Even through the heaven's and through the earth's expanses let thy swift seven tongued flames roll on, O Agni.

verses.sa:
द्यौश्च त्वा पृथिवी यज्ञियासो नि होतारं सादयन्ते दमाय ।
यदी विशो मानुषीर्देवयन्तीः प्रयस्वतीरीळते शुक्रमर्चिः॥
verses.tr: dyauśca tvā pṛthivī yajñiyāso ni hotāraṃ sādayante damāya yadī viśo mānuṣīrdevayantīḥ prayasvatīrīḻate śukramarciḥ
verses.en: Both Heaven and Earth and Gods who should be worshipped establish thee as Priest for every dwelling, Whenever human families, God-devoted, bringing oblations; laud thy splendid lustre.

verses.sa:
महान् त्सधस्थे ध्रुव आ निषत्तोऽन्तर्द्यावा माहिने हर्यमाणः ।
आस्क्रे सपत्नी अजरे अमृक्ते सबर्दुघे उरुगायस्य धेनू॥
verses.tr: mahān tsadhasthe dhruva ā niṣatto'ntardyāvā māhine haryamāṇaḥ āskre sapatnī ajare amṛkte sabardughe urugāyasya dhenū
verses.en: Firm in the Gods' home is the Mighty seated, between vast Heaven and Earth the well-beloved- Those Cows who yield, unharmed, their nectar, Spouses of the Far-Strider, ever young, united.

verses.sa:
व्रता ते अग्ने महतो महानि तव क्रत्वा रोदसी आ ततन्थ ।
त्वं दूतो अभवो जायमानस्त्वं नेता वृषभ चर्षणीनाम्॥
verses.tr: vratā te agne mahato mahāni tava kratvā rodasī ā tatantha tvaṃ dūto abhavo jāyamānastvaṃ netā vṛṣabha carṣaṇīnām
verses.en: Great are the deeds of thee, the Great, O Agni: thou by thy power hast spread out earth and heaven. As soon as thou wast born thou wast an envoy, thou, Mighty One, was Leader of the people.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य वा केशिना योग्याभिर्घृतस्नुवा रोहिता धुरि धिष्व ।
अथा वह देवान् देव विश्वान् त्स्वध्वरा कृणुहि जातवेदः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya vā keśinā yogyābhirghṛtasnuvā rohitā dhuri dhiṣva athā vaha devān deva viśvān tsvadhvarā kṛṇuhi jātavedaḥ
verses.en: Bind to the pole with cords of holy Order the long-maned ruddy steeds who sprinkle fatness. Bring hither, O thou God, all Gods together: provide them noble worship, Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चिदा ते रुचयन्त रोका उषो विभातीरनु भासि पूर्वीः ।
अपो यदग्न उशधग्वनेषु होतुर्मन्द्रस्य पनयन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: divaścidā te rucayanta rokā uṣo vibhātīranu bhāsi pūrvīḥ apo yadagna uśadhagvaneṣu hoturmandrasya panayanta devāḥ
verses.en: Even from the sky thy brilliant lights shone hither: still hast thou beamed through many a radiant morning, That the Gods praised their joyous Herald's labour eagerly burning, Agni, in the forests.

verses.sa:
उरौ वा ये अन्तरिक्षे मदन्ति दिवो वा ये रोचने सन्ति देवाः ।
ऊमा वा ये सुहवासो यजत्रा आयेमिरे रथ्यो अग्ने अश्वाः॥
verses.tr: urau vā ye antarikṣe madanti divo vā ye rocane santi devāḥ ūmā vā ye suhavāso yajatrā āyemire rathyo agne aśvāḥ
verses.en: The Gods who take delight in air's wide region, or those the dwellers in heaven's realm of brightness, Or those, the Holy, prompt to hear, our helpers, who, car borne, turn their horses hither, Agni---

verses.sa:
ऐभिरग्ने सरथं याह्यर्वाङ् नानारथं वा विभवो ह्यश्वाः ।
पत्नीवतस्त्रिंशतं त्रीँश्च देवाननुष्वधमा वह मादयस्व॥
verses.tr: aibhiragne sarathaṃ yāhyarvāṅ nānārathaṃ vā vibhavo hyaśvāḥ patnīvatastriṃśataṃ trīṃśca devānanuṣvadhamā vaha mādayasva
verses.en: With these, borne on one ear, Agni, approach us, or borne on many, for thy steeds are able. Bring, with their Dames, the Gods, the Three and-Thirty, after thy Godlike nature, and be joyful.

verses.sa:
स होता यस्य रोदसी चिदुर्वी यज्ञंयज्ञमभि वृधे गृणीतः ।
प्राची अध्वरेव तस्थतुः सुमेके ऋतावरी ऋतजातस्य सत्ये॥
verses.tr: sa hotā yasya rodasī cidurvī yajñaṃyajñamabhi vṛdhe gṛṇītaḥ prācī adhvareva tasthatuḥ sumeke ṛtāvarī ṛtajātasya satye
verses.en: He is the Priest at whose repeated worship even wide Heaven and Earth sing out for increase. They fair and true and holy coming forward stand at his sacrifice who springs from Order.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावा ऽग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे॥
verses.tr: iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvā 'gne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme
verses.en: As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels. To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to usward.

verses.sa:
प्र य आरुः शितिपृष्ठस्य धासेरा मातरा विविशुः सप्त वाणीः ।
परिक्षिता पितरा सं चरेते प्र सर्स्राते दीर्घमायुः प्रयक्षे॥
verses.tr: pra ya āruḥ śitipṛṣṭhasya dhāserā mātarā viviśuḥ sapta vāṇīḥ parikṣitā pitarā saṃ carete pra sarsrāte dīrghamāyuḥ prayakṣe
verses.en: The seven tones risen from the whitebacked viand have made their way between the pair of Mothers. Both circumjacent Parents come together to yield us length of days they hasten forward.

verses.sa:
दिवक्षसो धेनवो वृष्णो अश्वा देवीरा तस्थौ मधुमद् वहन्तीः ।
ऋतस्य त्वा सदसि क्षेमयन्तं पर्येका चरति वर्तनिं गौः॥
verses.tr: divakṣaso dhenavo vṛṣṇo aśvā devīrā tasthau madhumad vahantīḥ ṛtasya tvā sadasi kṣemayantaṃ paryekā carati vartaniṃ gauḥ
verses.en: The Male who dwells in heaven hath Mares and Milch kine: he came to Goddesses who bring sweet treasure. To thee safe resting in the seat of Order the Cow alone upon her way proceedeth.

verses.sa:
आ सीमरोहत् सुयमा भवन्तीः पतिश्चिकित्वान् रयिविद् रयीणाम् ।
प्र नीलपृष्ठो अतसस्य धासेस्ता अवासयत् पुरुधप्रतीकः॥
verses.tr: ā sīmarohat suyamā bhavantīḥ patiścikitvān rayivid rayīṇām pra nīlapṛṣṭho atasasya dhāsestā avāsayat purudhapratīkaḥ
verses.en: Wise Master, wealthy finder-out of riches, he mounted those who may with case be guided. He, dark-backed, manifold with varied aspect, hath made them burst forth from their food the brush-wood.

verses.sa:
महि त्वाष्ट्रमूर्जयन्तीरजुर्यं स्तभूयमानं वहतो वहन्ति ।
व्यङ्गेभिर्दिद्युतानः सधस्थ एकामिव रोदसी आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: mahi tvāṣṭramūrjayantīrajuryaṃ stabhūyamānaṃ vahato vahanti vyaṅgebhirdidyutānaḥ sadhastha ekāmiva rodasī ā viveśa
verses.en: Strength-giving streams bear hither him eternal, fain to support the mighty work. of Tvastar. He, flashing in his home with all his members, hath entered both the worlds as they were single.

verses.sa:
जानन्ति वृष्णो अरुषस्य शेवमुत ब्रध्नस्य शासने रणन्ति ।
दिवोरुचः सुरुचो रोचमाना इळा येषां गण्या माहिना गीः॥
verses.tr: jānanti vṛṣṇo aruṣasya śevamuta bradhnasya śāsane raṇanti divorucaḥ suruco rocamānā iḻā yeṣāṃ gaṇyā māhinā gīḥ
verses.en: They know the red Bull's blessing, and are joyful under the flaming-coloured Lord's dominion: They who give shine from heaven with fair effulgence, whose lofty song like Ila must be honoured.

verses.sa:
उतो पितृभ्यां प्रविदानु घोषं महो महद्भ्यामनयन्त शूषम् ।
उक्षा ह यत्र परि धानमक्तोरनु स्वं धाम जरितुर्ववक्ष॥
verses.tr: uto pitṛbhyāṃ pravidānu ghoṣaṃ maho mahadbhyāmanayanta śūṣam ukṣā ha yatra pari dhānamaktoranu svaṃ dhāma jariturvavakṣa
verses.en: Yea, by tradition from the ancient sages they brought great strength from the two mighty Parents, To where the singer's Bull, the night's dispeller, after his proper law hath waxen stronger.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्युभिः पञ्चभिः सप्त विप्राः प्रियं रक्षन्ते निहितं पदं वेः ।
प्राञ्चो मदन्त्युक्षणो अजुर्या देवा देवानामनु हि व्रता गुः॥
verses.tr: adhvaryubhiḥ pañcabhiḥ sapta viprāḥ priyaṃ rakṣante nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ prāñco madantyukṣaṇo ajuryā devā devānāmanu hi vratā guḥ
verses.en: Seven holy singers guard with five Adhvaryus the Bird's beloved firmly-settled station. The willing Bulls, untouched by old, rejoice them: as Gods themselves the ways of Gods they follow.

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा न्यृञ्जे सप्त पृक्षासः स्वधया मदन्ति ।
ऋतं शंसन्त ऋतमित् त आहुरनु व्रतं व्रतपा दीध्यानाः॥
verses.tr: daivyā hotārā prathamā nyṛñje sapta pṛkṣāsaḥ svadhayā madanti ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛtamit ta āhuranu vrataṃ vratapā dīdhyānāḥ
verses.en: I crave the grace of heaven's two chief Invokers: the seven swift steeds joy in their wonted manner. These speak of truth, praising the Truth Eternal, thinking on Order as the guards of Order.

verses.sa:
वृषायन्ते महे अत्याय पूर्वीर्वृष्णे चित्राय रश्मयः सुयामाः ।
देव होतर्मन्द्रतरश्चिकित्वान् महो देवान् रोदसी एह वक्षि॥
verses.tr: vṛṣāyante mahe atyāya pūrvīrvṛṣṇe citrāya raśmayaḥ suyāmāḥ deva hotarmandrataraścikitvān maho devān rodasī eha vakṣi
verses.en: The many seek the great Steed as a stallion: the reins obey the Lord of varied colour. O heavenly Priest, most pleasant, full of wisdom, bring the great Gods to us, and Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
पृक्षप्रयजो द्रविणः सुवाचः सुकेतव उषसो रेवदूषुः ।
उतो चिदग्ने महिना पृथिव्याः कृतं चिदेनः सं महे दशस्य॥
verses.tr: pṛkṣaprayajo draviṇaḥ suvācaḥ suketava uṣaso revadūṣuḥ uto cidagne mahinā pṛthivyāḥ kṛtaṃ cidenaḥ saṃ mahe daśasya
verses.en: Rich Lord, the Mornings have gleamed forth in splendour, fair-rayed, fair-speaking, worshipped with all viands, Yea, with the glory of the earth, O Agni. Forgive us, for our weal, e'en sin committed.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे॥
verses.tr: iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme
verses.en: As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker, give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels. To us be born a son, and spreading offspring Agni, be this thy gracious will to usward.

verses.sa:
अञ्जन्ति त्वामध्वरे देवयन्तो वनस्पते मधुना दैव्येन ।
यदूर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा द्रविणेह धत्ताद् यद् वा क्षयो मातुरस्या उपस्थे॥
verses.tr: añjanti tvāmadhvare devayanto vanaspate madhunā daivyena yadūrdhvastiṣṭhā draviṇeha dhattād yad vā kṣayo māturasyā upasthe
verses.en: God-SERVING men, O Sovran of the Forest, with heavenly meath at sacrifice anoint thee. Grant wealth to us when thou art standing upright as when reposing on this Mother's bosom.

verses.sa:
समिद्धस्य श्रयमाणः पुरस्ताद् ब्रह्म वन्वानो अजरं सुवीरम् ।
आरे अस्मदमतिं बाधमान उच्छ्रयस्व महते सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: samiddhasya śrayamāṇaḥ purastād brahma vanvāno ajaraṃ suvīram āre asmadamatiṃ bādhamāna ucchrayasva mahate saubhagāya
verses.en: Set up to eastward of the fire enkindled, accepting prayer that wastes not, rich in hero. Driving far from us poverty and famine, lift thyself up to bring us great good fortune.

verses.sa:
उच्छ्रयस्व वनस्पते वर्ष्मन्पृ पृथिव्या अधि ।
सुमिती मीयमानो वर्चो धा यज्ञवाहसे॥
verses.tr: ucchrayasva vanaspate varṣmanpṛ pṛthivyā adhi sumitī mīyamāno varco dhā yajñavāhase
verses.en: Lord of the Forest, raise. thyself up on the loftiest spot of earth. Give splendour, fixt and measured well, to him who brings the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
युवा सुवासाः परिवीत आगात् स उ श्रेयान् भवति जायमानः ।
तं धीरासः कवय उन्नयन्ति स्वाध्यो३ मनसा देवयन्तः॥
verses.tr: yuvā suvāsāḥ parivīta āgāt sa u śreyān bhavati jāyamānaḥ taṃ dhīrāsaḥ kavaya unnayanti svādhyo3 manasā devayantaḥ
verses.en: Well-robed, enveloped he is come, the youthful: springing to life his glory waxeth greater. Contemplative in mind and God-adoring, sages of high intelligence upraise him.

verses.sa:
जातो जायते सुदिनत्वे अह्नां समर्य आ विदथे वर्धमानः ।
पुनन्ति धीरा अपसो मनीषा देवया विप्र उदियर्ति वाचम्॥
verses.tr: jāto jāyate sudinatve ahnāṃ samarya ā vidathe vardhamānaḥ punanti dhīrā apaso manīṣā devayā vipra udiyarti vācam
verses.en: Sprung up he rises in the days' fair weather, increasing in the men-frequented synod. With song the wise and skillful consecrate him: his voice the God-adoring singer utters.

verses.sa:
यान् वो नरो देवयन्तो निमिम्युर्वनस्पते स्वधितिर्वा ततक्ष ।
ते देवासः स्वरवस्तस्थिवांसः प्रजावदस्मे दिधिषन्तु रत्नम्॥
verses.tr: yān vo naro devayanto nimimyurvanaspate svadhitirvā tatakṣa te devāsaḥ svaravastasthivāṃsaḥ prajāvadasme didhiṣantu ratnam
verses.en: Ye whom religious men have firmly planted; thou Forest Sovran whom the axe hath fashioned,- Let those the Stakes divine which here are standing be fain to grant us wealth with store of children.

verses.sa:
ये वृक्णासो अधि क्षमि निमितासो यतस्रुचः ।
ते नो व्यन्तु वार्यं देवत्रा क्षेत्रसाधसः॥
verses.tr: ye vṛkṇāso adhi kṣami nimitāso yatasrucaḥ te no vyantu vāryaṃ devatrā kṣetrasādhasaḥ
verses.en: O men who lift the ladles up, these hewn and planted in the ground, Bringing a blessing to the field, shall bear our precious gift to Gods.

verses.sa:
आदित्या रुद्रा वसवः सुनीथा द्यावाक्षामा पृथिवी अन्तरिक्षम् ।
सजोषसो यज्ञमवन्तु देवा ऊर्ध्वं कृण्वन्त्वध्वरस्य केतुम्॥
verses.tr: ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sunīthā dyāvākṣāmā pṛthivī antarikṣam sajoṣaso yajñamavantu devā ūrdhvaṃ kṛṇvantvadhvarasya ketum
verses.en: Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, careful leaders, Earth, Heaven, and Prthivi and Air's mid-region, Accordant Deities shall bless our worship and make our sacrifice's ensign lofty.

verses.sa:
हंसा इव श्रेणिशो यतानाः शुक्रा वसानाः स्वरवो न आगुः ।
उन्नीयमानाः कविभिः पुरस्ताद् देवा देवानामपि यन्ति पाथः॥
verses.tr: haṃsā iva śreṇiśo yatānāḥ śukrā vasānāḥ svaravo na āguḥ unnīyamānāḥ kavibhiḥ purastād devā devānāmapi yanti pāthaḥ
verses.en: Like swan's that flee in lengthened line, the Pillars have come to us arrayed in brilliant colour. They, lifted up on high, by sages, eastward, go forth as Gods to the God's dwelling-places.

verses.sa:
शृङ्गाणीवेच्छृङ्गिणां सं ददृश्रे चषालवन्तः स्वरवः पृथिव्याम् ।
वाघद्भिर्वा विहवे श्रोषमाणा अस्माँ अवन्तु पृतनाज्येषु॥
verses.tr: śṛṅgāṇīvecchṛṅgiṇāṃ saṃ dadṛśre caṣālavantaḥ svaravaḥ pṛthivyām vāghadbhirvā vihave śroṣamāṇā asmāṃ avantu pṛtanājyeṣu
verses.en: Those Stakes upon the earth with rings that deck them seem to the eye like horns of horned creatures; Or, as upraised by priests in invocation, let them assist us in the rush to battle.

verses.sa:
वनस्पते शतवल्शो वि रोह सहस्रवल्शा वि वयं रुहेम ।
यं त्वामयं स्वधितिस्तेजमानः प्रणिनाय महते सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: vanaspate śatavalśo vi roha sahasravalśā vi vayaṃ ruhema yaṃ tvāmayaṃ svadhitistejamānaḥ praṇināya mahate saubhagāya
verses.en: Lord of the Wood, rise with a hundred branches. with thousand branches may we rise to greatness, Thou whom this hatchet, with an edge well whetted for great felicity, hath brought before us.

verses.sa:
सखायस्त्वा ववृमहे देवं मर्तास ऊतये ।
अपां नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिं सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसम्॥
verses.tr: sakhāyastvā vavṛmahe devaṃ martāsa ūtaye apāṃ napātaṃ subhagaṃ sudīditiṃ supratūrtimanehasam
verses.en: We as thy friends have chosen thee, mortals a God, to be our help, The Waters' Child, the blessed, the resplendent One, victorious and beyond compare.

verses.sa:
कायमानो वना त्वं यन्मातॄरजगन्नपः ।
न तत् ते अग्ने प्रमृषे निवर्तनं यद् दूरे सन्निहाभवः॥
verses.tr: kāyamāno vanā tvaṃ yanmātṝrajagannapaḥ na tat te agne pramṛṣe nivartanaṃ yad dūre sannihābhavaḥ
verses.en: Since thou delighting in the woods hast gone unto thy mother streams, Not to be scorned, Agni, is that return of thine when from afar thou now art here.

verses.sa:
अति तृष्टं ववक्षिथाथैव सुमना असि ।
प्रप्रान्ये यन्ति पर्यन्य आसते येषां सख्ये असि श्रितः॥
verses.tr: ati tṛṣṭaṃ vavakṣithāthaiva sumanā asi praprānye yanti paryanya āsate yeṣāṃ sakhye asi śritaḥ
verses.en: O'er pungent smoke host thou prevailed, and thus art thou benevolent. Some go before, and others round about thee sit, they in whose friendship thou hast place.

verses.sa:
ईयिवांसमति स्रिधः शश्वतीरति सश्चतः ।
अन्वीमविन्दन् निचिरासो अद्रुहोऽप्सु सिंहमिव श्रितम्॥
verses.tr: īyivāṃsamati sridhaḥ śaśvatīrati saścataḥ anvīmavindan nicirāso adruho'psu siṃhamiva śritam
verses.en: Him who had passed beyond his foes, beyond continual pursuits, Him the unerring Ones, observant, found in floods, couched like a lion in his lair.

verses.sa:
ससृवांसमिव त्मना ऽग्निमित्था तिरोहितम् ।
ऐनं नयन्मातरिश्वा परावतो देवेभ्यो मथितं परि॥
verses.tr: sasṛvāṃsamiva tmanā 'gnimitthā tirohitam ainaṃ nayanmātariśvā parāvato devebhyo mathitaṃ pari
verses.en: Him wandering at his own free will, Agni here hidden from our view, Him Matarisvan brought to us from far away produced by friction, from the Gods.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा मर्ता अगृभ्णत देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन ।
विश्वान् यद् यज्ञाँ अभिपासि मानुष तव क्रत्वा यविष्ठ्य॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā martā agṛbhṇata devebhyo havyavāhana viśvān yad yajñāṃ abhipāsi mānuṣa tava kratvā yaviṣṭhya
verses.en: O Bearer of Oblations, thus mortals received thee from the Gods, Whilst thou, the Friend of man, guardest each sacrifice with thine own power, Most Youthful One.

verses.sa:
तद् भद्रं तव दंसना पाकाय चिच्छदयति ।
त्वां यदग्ने पशवः समासते समिद्धमपिशर्वरे॥
verses.tr: tad bhadraṃ tava daṃsanā pākāya cicchadayati tvāṃ yadagne paśavaḥ samāsate samiddhamapiśarvare
verses.en: Amid thy wonders this is good, yea, to the simple is it clear, When gathered round about thee, Agni, lie the herds where thou art kindled in the morn.

verses.sa:
आ जुहोता स्वध्वरं शीरं पावकशोचिषम् ।
आशुं दूतमजिरं प्रत्नमीड्यं श्रुष्टी देवं सपर्यत॥
verses.tr: ā juhotā svadhvaraṃ śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣam āśuṃ dūtamajiraṃ pratnamīḍyaṃ śruṣṭī devaṃ saparyata
verses.en: Offer to him who knows fair rites, who burns with purifying glow, Swift envoy, active, ancient, and adorable: serve ye the God attentively.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि शता त्री सहस्राण्यग्निं त्रिंशच्च देवा नव चासपर्यन् ।
औक्षन् घृतैरस्तृणन् बर्हिरस्मा आदिद्धोतारं न्यसादयन्त॥
verses.tr: trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇyagniṃ triṃśacca devā nava cāsaparyan aukṣan ghṛtairastṛṇan barhirasmā ādiddhotāraṃ nyasādayanta
verses.en: Three times a hundred Gods and thrice a thousand, and three times ten and nine have worshipped Agni, For him spread sacred grass, with oil bedewed him, and stablished him as Priest and Sacrificer.

verses.sa: त्वामग्ने मनीषिणः सम्राजं चर्षणीनाम् । देवं मर्तास इन्धते समध्वरे॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne manīṣiṇaḥ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnām devaṃ martāsa indhate samadhvare
verses.en: Thee Agni, God, Imperial Lord of all mankind, do mortal men With understanding kindle at the sacrifice.

verses.sa: त्वां यज्ञेष्वृत्विजमग्ने होतारमीळते । गोपा ऋतस्य दीदिहि स्वे दमे॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ yajñeṣvṛtvijamagne hotāramīḻate gopā ṛtasya dīdihi sve dame
verses.en: They laud thee in their solemn rites, Agni, as Minister and Priest, Shine forth in thine own home as guardian of the Law.

verses.sa: स घा यस्ते ददाशति समिधा जातवेदसे । सो अग्ने धत्ते सुवीर्यं स पुष्यति॥
verses.tr: sa ghā yaste dadāśati samidhā jātavedase so agne dhatte suvīryaṃ sa puṣyati
verses.en: He, verily, who honours thee with fuel, Knower of all life, He, Agni! wins heroic might, he prospers well.

verses.sa: स केतुरध्वराणामग्निर्देवेभिरा गमत् । अञ्जानः सप्त होतृभिर्हविष्मते॥
verses.tr: sa keturadhvarāṇāmagnirdevebhirā gamat añjānaḥ sapta hotṛbhirhaviṣmate
verses.en: Ensign of sacrifices, he, Agni, with Gods is come to us, Decked by the seven priests, to him who bringeth gifts.

verses.sa: प्र होत्रे पूर्व्यं वचोऽग्नये भरता बृहत् । विपां ज्योतींषि बिभ्रते न वेधसे॥
verses.tr: pra hotre pūrvyaṃ vaco'gnaye bharatā bṛhat vipāṃ jyotīṃṣi bibhrate na vedhase
verses.en: To Agni, the Invoking Priest, offer your best, your lofty speech, To him Ordainer-like who brings the light of songs.

verses.sa: अग्निं वर्धन्तु नो गिरो यतो जायत उक्थ्यः । महे वाजाय द्रविणाय दर्शतः॥
verses.tr: agniṃ vardhantu no giro yato jāyata ukthyaḥ mahe vājāya draviṇāya darśataḥ
verses.en: Let these our hymns make Agni grow, whence, meet for laud, he springs to life, To mighty strength and great possession, fair to see.

verses.sa: अग्ने यजिष्ठो अध्वरे देवान् देवयते यज । होता मन्द्रो वि राजस्यति स्रिधः॥
verses.tr: agne yajiṣṭho adhvare devān devayate yaja hotā mandro vi rājasyati sridhaḥ
verses.en: Best Sacrificer, bring the Gods, O Agni, to the pious man: A joyful Priest, thy splendour drive our foes afar

verses.sa: स नः पावक दीदिहि द्युमदस्मे सुवीर्यम् । भवा स्तोतृभ्यो अन्तमः स्वस्तये॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ pāvaka dīdihi dyumadasme suvīryam bhavā stotṛbhyo antamaḥ svastaye
verses.en: As such, O Purifier, shine on us heroic glorious might: Be nearest Friend to those who laud thee, for their weal.

verses.sa: तं त्वा विप्रा विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिन्धते । हव्यवाहममर्त्यं सहोवृधम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā viprā vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate havyavāhamamartyaṃ sahovṛdham
verses.en: So, wakeful, versed in sacred hymns, the holy singers kindly thee. Oblation-bearer, deathless, cherisher of strength.

verses.sa: अग्निर्होता पुरोहितोऽध्वरस्य विचर्षणिः । स वेद यज्ञमानुषक्॥
verses.tr: agnirhotā purohito'dhvarasya vicarṣaṇiḥ sa veda yajñamānuṣak
verses.en: Agni is Priest, the great High Priest of sacrifice, most swift in act: He knows the rite in constant course.

verses.sa: स हव्यवाळमर्त्य उशिग्दूतश्चनोहितः । अग्निर्धिया समृण्वति॥
verses.tr: sa havyavāḻamartya uśigdūtaścanohitaḥ agnirdhiyā samṛṇvati
verses.en: Oblation-bearer, deathless, well inclined, an eager messenger, Agni comes nigh us with the thought.

verses.sa: अग्निर्धिया स चेतति केतुर्यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः । अर्थं ह्यस्य तरणि॥
verses.tr: agnirdhiyā sa cetati keturyajñasya pūrvyaḥ arthaṃ hyasya taraṇi
verses.en: Ensign of sacrifice from of old, Agni well knoweth with his thought To prosper this man's aim and hope.

verses.sa: अग्निं सूनुं सनश्रुतं सहसो जातवेदसम् । वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत॥
verses.tr: agniṃ sūnuṃ sanaśrutaṃ sahaso jātavedasam vahniṃ devā akṛṇvata
verses.en: Agni, illustrious from old time, the Son of Strength who knows all life, The Gods have made to their Priest.

verses.sa: अदाभ्यः पुरएता विशामग्निर्मानुषीणाम् । तूर्णी रथः सदा नवः॥
verses.tr: adābhyaḥ puraetā viśāmagnirmānuṣīṇām tūrṇī rathaḥ sadā navaḥ
verses.en: Infallible is Agni, he who goes before the tribes of men, A chariot swift and ever new.

verses.sa: साह्वान् विश्वा अभियुजः क्रतुर्देवानाममृक्तः । अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमः॥
verses.tr: sāhvān viśvā abhiyujaḥ kraturdevānāmamṛktaḥ agnistuviśravastamaḥ
verses.en: Strength of the Gods which none may harm, subduing all his enemies, Agni is mightiest in fame.

verses.sa: अभि प्रयांसि वाहसा दाश्वाँ अश्नोति मर्त्यः । क्षयं पावकशोचिषः॥
verses.tr: abhi prayāṃsi vāhasā dāśvāṃ aśnoti martyaḥ kṣayaṃ pāvakaśociṣaḥ
verses.en: By offering sacred food to him the mortal worshipper obtains. A home from him whose light makes pure.

verses.sa: परि विश्वानि सुधिता ऽग्नेरश्याम मन्मभिः । विप्रासो जातवेदसः॥
verses.tr: pari viśvāni sudhitā 'gneraśyāma manmabhiḥ viprāso jātavedasaḥ
verses.en: From Agni, by our hymns, may we gain all things that bring happiness, Singers of him who knows all life.

verses.sa: अग्ने विश्वानि वार्या वाजेषु सनिषामहे । त्वे देवास एरिरे॥
verses.tr: agne viśvāni vāryā vājeṣu saniṣāmahe tve devāsa erire
verses.en: O Agni, in our deeds of might may we obtain all precious things: The Gods are centred all in thee.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं सुतं गीर्भिर्नभो वरेण्यम् । अस्य पातं धियेषिता॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī ā gataṃ sutaṃ gīrbhirnabho vareṇyam asya pātaṃ dhiyeṣitā
verses.en: Moved, Indra-Agni, by our hymn, come to the juice, the precious dew: Drink ye thereof, impelled by song.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी जरितुः सचा यज्ञो जिगाति चेतनः । अया पातमिमं सुतम्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī jarituḥ sacā yajño jigāti cetanaḥ ayā pātamimaṃ sutam
verses.en: O Indra-Agni, with the man who lauds you comes the wakening rite: So drink ye both this juice assured.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमग्निं कविच्छदा यज्ञस्य जूत्या वृणे । ता सोमस्येह तृम्पताम्॥
verses.tr: indramagniṃ kavicchadā yajñasya jūtyā vṛṇe tā somasyeha tṛmpatām
verses.en: Through force of sacrifice I choose Indra-Agni who love the wise: With Sorna let these sate them here.

verses.sa: तोशा वृत्रहणा हुवे सजित्वानापराजिता । इन्द्राग्नी वाजसातमा॥
verses.tr: tośā vṛtrahaṇā huve sajitvānāparājitā indrāgnī vājasātamā
verses.en: Indra and Agni I invoke, joint-victors, bounteous, unsubdued, Foe-slayers, best to win the spoil.

verses.sa: प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः । इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे॥
verses.tr: pra vāmarcantyukthino nīthāvido jaritāraḥ indrāgnī iṣa ā vṛṇe
verses.en: Indra and Agni, singers skilled in melody hymn you, bringing lauds: I choose you for the sacred food.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतम् । साकमेकेन कर्मणा॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī navatiṃ puro dāsapatnīradhūnutam sākamekena karmaṇā
verses.en: Indra and Agni, ye cast down the ninety forts which DAsas held, Together, with one mighty deed.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्पर्युप प्र यन्ति धीतयः । ऋतस्य पथ्या३ अनु॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī apasasparyupa pra yanti dhītayaḥ ṛtasya pathyā3 anu
verses.en: To Indra-Agni reverent thoughts go forward from the holy task Along the path of sacred Law.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणि वां सधस्थानि प्रयांसि च । युवोरप्तूर्यं हितम्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī taviṣāṇi vāṃ sadhasthāni prayāṃsi ca yuvoraptūryaṃ hitam
verses.en: O Indra-Agni, powers are yours, and dwellings and delightful food Good is your readiness to act.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी रोचना दिवः परि वाजेषु भूषथः । तद्वां चेति प्र वीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ pari vājeṣu bhūṣathaḥ tadvāṃ ceti pra vīryam
verses.en: Indra and Agni, in your deeds of might ye deck heaven's lucid realms: Famed is that hero strength of yours.

verses.sa:
प्र वो देवायाग्नये बर्हिष्ठमर्चास्मै ।
गमद् देवेभिरा स नो यजिष्ठो बर्हिरा सदत्॥
verses.tr: pra vo devāyāgnaye barhiṣṭhamarcāsmai gamad devebhirā sa no yajiṣṭho barhirā sadat
verses.en: To Agni, to this God of yours I sing aloud with utmost power. May he come to us with the Gods, and sit, best Offerer, on the grass.

verses.sa:
ऋतावा यस्य रोदसी दक्षं सचन्त ऊतयः ।
हविष्मन्तस्तमीळते तं सनिष्यन्तोऽवसे॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvā yasya rodasī dakṣaṃ sacanta ūtayaḥ haviṣmantastamīḻate taṃ saniṣyanto'vase
verses.en: The Holy, whose are earth and heaven, and succour waits upon his strength; Him men who bring oblations laud, and they who wish to gain, for grace.

verses.sa:
स यन्ता विप्र एषां स यज्ञानामथा हि षः ।
अग्निं तं वो दुवस्यत दाता यो वनिता मघम्॥
verses.tr: sa yantā vipra eṣāṃ sa yajñānāmathā hi ṣaḥ agniṃ taṃ vo duvasyata dātā yo vanitā magham
verses.en: He is the Sage who guides these men, Leader of sacred rites is he. Him your own Agni, serve ye well, who winneth and bestoweth wealth.

verses.sa:
स नः शर्माणि वीतयेऽग्निर्यच्छतु शंतमा ।
यतो नः प्रुष्णवद् वसु दिवि क्षितिभ्यो अप्स्वा॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ śarmāṇi vītaye'gniryacchatu śaṃtamā yato naḥ pruṣṇavad vasu divi kṣitibhyo apsvā
verses.en: So may the gracious Agni grant most goodly shelter for our use; Whence in the heavens or in the floods he shall pour wealth upon our lands.

verses.sa:
दीदिवांसमपूर्व्यं वस्वीभिरस्य धीतिभिः ।
ऋक्वाणो अग्निमिन्धते होतारं विश्पतिं विशाम्॥
verses.tr: dīdivāṃsamapūrvyaṃ vasvībhirasya dhītibhiḥ ṛkvāṇo agnimindhate hotāraṃ viśpatiṃ viśām
verses.en: The singers kindle him, the Priest, Agni the Lord of tribes of men, Resplendent and without a peer through his own excellent designs.

verses.sa:
उत नो ब्रह्मन्नविष उक्थेषु देवहूतमः ।
शं नः शोचा मरुद्वृधोऽग्ने सहस्रसातमः॥
verses.tr: uta no brahmannaviṣa uktheṣu devahūtamaḥ śaṃ naḥ śocā marudvṛdho'gne sahasrasātamaḥ
verses.en: Help us, thou Brahman, best of all invokers of the Gods in song. Beam, Friend of Maruts, bliss on us, O Agni, a most liberal God.

verses.sa:
नू नो रास्व सहस्रवत् तोकवत्पुष्टिमद् वसु ।
द्युमदग्ने सुवीर्यं वर्षिष्ठमनुपक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: nū no rāsva sahasravat tokavatpuṣṭimad vasu dyumadagne suvīryaṃ varṣiṣṭhamanupakṣitam
verses.en: Yea, grant us treasure thousandfold with children and with nourishment, And, Agni, splendid hero strength, exalted, wasting not away.

verses.sa:
आ होता मन्द्रो विदथान्यस्थात् सत्यो यज्वा कवितमः स वेधाः ।
विद्युद्रथः सहसस्पुत्रो अग्निः शोचिष्केशः पृथिव्यां पाजो अश्रेत्॥
verses.tr: ā hotā mandro vidathānyasthāt satyo yajvā kavitamaḥ sa vedhāḥ vidyudrathaḥ sahasasputro agniḥ śociṣkeśaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pājo aśret
verses.en: The pleasant Priest is come into the synod, true, skilled in sacrifice, most wise, Ordainer. Agni, the Son of Strength, whose car is lightning, whose hair is flame, hath shown on earth his lustre.

verses.sa:
अयामि ते नमउक्तिं जुषस्व ऋतावस्तुभ्यं चेतते सहस्वः ।
विद्वाँ आ वक्षि विदुषो नि षत्सि मध्य आ बर्हिरूतये यजत्र॥
verses.tr: ayāmi te namauktiṃ juṣasva ṛtāvastubhyaṃ cetate sahasvaḥ vidvāṃ ā vakṣi viduṣo ni ṣatsi madhya ā barhirūtaye yajatra
verses.en: To thee I offer reverent speech: accept it: to thee who markest it, victorious, faithful! Bring, thou who knowest, those who know, and seat thee amid the sacred grass, for help, O Holy.

verses.sa:
द्रवतां त उषसा वाजयन्ती अग्ने वातस्य पथ्याभिरच्छ ।
यत् सीमञ्जन्ति पूर्व्यं हविर्भिरा वन्धुरेव तस्थतुर्दुरोणे॥
verses.tr: dravatāṃ ta uṣasā vājayantī agne vātasya pathyābhiraccha yat sīmañjanti pūrvyaṃ havirbhirā vandhureva tasthaturduroṇe
verses.en: The Two who show their vigour, Night and Morning, by the wind's paths shall haste to thee O Agni. When men adorn the Ancient with oblations, these seek, as on two chariot-seats, the dwelling.

verses.sa:
मित्रश्च तुभ्यं वरुणः सहस्वोऽग्ने विश्वे मरुतः सुम्नमर्चन् ।
यच्छोचिषा सहसस्पुत्र तिष्ठा अभि क्षितीः प्रथयन् त्सूर्यो नॄन्॥
verses.tr: mitraśca tubhyaṃ varuṇaḥ sahasvo'gne viśve marutaḥ sumnamarcan yacchociṣā sahasasputra tiṣṭhā abhi kṣitīḥ prathayan tsūryo nṝn
verses.en: To thee, strong Agni! Varuna and Mitra and all the Maruts sang a song of triumph, What time unto the people's lands thou camest, spreading them as the Sun of men, with lustre.

verses.sa:
वयं ते अद्य ररिमा हि काममुत्तानहस्ता नमसोपसद्य ।
यजिष्ठेन मनसा यक्षि देवानस्रेधता मन्मना विप्रो अग्ने॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ te adya rarimā hi kāmamuttānahastā namasopasadya yajiṣṭhena manasā yakṣi devānasredhatā manmanā vipro agne
verses.en: Approaching with raised hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing. Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit, a Priest with no unfriendly thought, O Agni.

verses.sa:
त्वद्धि पुत्र सहसो वि पूर्वीर्देवस्य यन्त्यूतयो वि वाजाः ।
त्वं देहि सहस्रिणं रयिं नोऽद्रोघेण वचसा सत्यमग्ने॥
verses.tr: tvaddhi putra sahaso vi pūrvīrdevasya yantyūtayo vi vājāḥ tvaṃ dehi sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ no'drogheṇa vacasā satyamagne
verses.en: For, Son of Strength, from thee come many succours, and powers abundant that a God possesses. Agni, to us with speech that hath no falsehood grant riches, real, to be told in thousands.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं दक्ष कविक्रतो यानीमा देव मर्तासो अध्वरे अकर्म ।
त्वं विश्वस्य सुरथस्य बोधि सर्वं तदग्ने अमृत स्वदेह॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ dakṣa kavikrato yānīmā deva martāso adhvare akarma tvaṃ viśvasya surathasya bodhi sarvaṃ tadagne amṛta svadeha
verses.en: Whatever, God, in sacrifice we mortals have wrought is all for thee, strong, wise of purpose! Be thou the Friend of each good chariot's master. All this enjoy thou here, immortal Agni.

verses.sa:
वि पाजसा पृथुना शोशुचानो बाधस्व द्विषो रक्षसो अमीवाः ।
सुशर्मणो बृहतः शर्मणि स्यामग्नेरहं सुहवस्य प्रणीतौ॥
verses.tr: vi pājasā pṛthunā śośucāno bādhasva dviṣo rakṣaso amīvāḥ suśarmaṇo bṛhataḥ śarmaṇi syāmagnerahaṃ suhavasya praṇītau
verses.en: Resplendent with thy wide-extending lustre, dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate us May lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, the easily-invoked, the good Protector.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ त्वं सूर उदिते बोधि गोपाः ।
जन्मेव नित्यं तनयं जुषस्व स्तोमं मे अग्ने तन्वा सुजात॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau tvaṃ sūra udite bodhi gopāḥ janmeva nityaṃ tanayaṃ juṣasva stomaṃ me agne tanvā sujāta
verses.en: Be thou To us, while now the morn is breaking, be thou a guardian when the Sun hath mounted.. Accept, as men accept a true-born infant, my laud, O Agni nobly born in body.

verses.sa:
त्वं नृचक्षा वृषभानु पूर्वीः कृष्णास्वग्ने अरुषो वि भाहि ।
वसो नेषि च पर्षि चात्यंहः कृधी नो राय उशिजो यविष्ठ॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ nṛcakṣā vṛṣabhānu pūrvīḥ kṛṣṇāsvagne aruṣo vi bhāhi vaso neṣi ca parṣi cātyaṃhaḥ kṛdhī no rāya uśijo yaviṣṭha
verses.en: Bull, who beholdest men, through many mornings, among the dark ones shine forth red, O Agni. Lead us, good Lord, and bear us over trouble: Help us who long, Most Youthful God, to riches.

verses.sa:
अषाळहो अग्ने वृषभो दिदीहि पुरो विश्वाः सौभगा संजिगीवान् ।
यज्ञस्य नेता प्रथमस्य पायोर्जातवेदो बृहतः सुप्रणीते॥
verses.tr: aṣāḻaho agne vṛṣabho didīhi puro viśvāḥ saubhagā saṃjigīvān yajñasya netā prathamasya pāyorjātavedo bṛhataḥ supraṇīte
verses.en: Shine forth, a Bull invincible, O Agni, winning by conquest all the forts and treasures, Thou Jatavedas who art skilled in guiding, the chief high saving sacrifice's Leader.

verses.sa:
अच्छिद्रा शर्म जरितः पुरूणि देवाँ अच्छा दीद्यानः सुमेधाः ।
रथो न सस्निरभि वक्षि वाजमग्ने त्वं रोदसी नः सुमेके॥
verses.tr: acchidrā śarma jaritaḥ purūṇi devāṃ acchā dīdyānaḥ sumedhāḥ ratho na sasnirabhi vakṣi vājamagne tvaṃ rodasī naḥ sumeke
verses.en: Lighting Gods hither, Agni, wisest Singer, bring thou to us many and flawless shelters. Bring vigour, like a car that gathers booty: bring us, O Agni, beauteous Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
प्र पीपय वृषभ जिन्व वाजानग्ने त्वं रोदसी नः सुदोघे ।
देवेभिर्देव सुरुचा रुचानो मा नो मर्तस्य दुर्मतिः परि ष्ठात्॥
verses.tr: pra pīpaya vṛṣabha jinva vājānagne tvaṃ rodasī naḥ sudoghe devebhirdeva surucā rucāno mā no martasya durmatiḥ pari ṣṭhāt
verses.en: Swell, O thou Bull and give those powers an impulse, e'en Earth and Heaven who yield their milk in plenty, Shining, O God, with Gods in clear effulgence. Let not a mortal's evil will obstruct us.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावा ऽग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे॥
verses.tr: iḻāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvā 'gne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme
verses.en: Agni, as holy food to thine invoker, give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels. To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निः सुवीर्यस्येशे महः सौभगस्य ।
राय ईशे स्वपत्यस्य गोमत ईशे वृत्रहथानाम्॥
verses.tr: ayamagniḥ suvīryasyeśe mahaḥ saubhagasya rāya īśe svapatyasya gomata īśe vṛtrahathānām
verses.en: This Agni is the Lord of great felicity and hero Strength; Lord of wealth in herds of kine; Lord of the battles with the foe.

verses.sa:
इमं नरो मरुतः सश्चता वृधं यस्मिन् रायः शेवृधासः ।
अभि ये सन्ति पृतनासु दूढ्यो विश्वाहा शत्रुमादभुः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ naro marutaḥ saścatā vṛdhaṃ yasmin rāyaḥ śevṛdhāsaḥ abhi ye santi pṛtanāsu dūḍhyo viśvāhā śatrumādabhuḥ
verses.en: Wait, Maruts, Heroes, upon him the Prosperer in whom is bliss-increasing wealth; Who in fights ever conquer evil-hearted men, who overcome the enemy.

verses.sa:
स त्वं नो रायः शिशीहि मीढ्वो अग्ने सुवीर्यस्य ।
तुविद्युम्न वर्षिष्ठस्य प्रजावतोऽनमीवस्य शुष्मिणः॥
verses.tr: sa tvaṃ no rāyaḥ śiśīhi mīḍhvo agne suvīryasya tuvidyumna varṣiṣṭhasya prajāvato'namīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ
verses.en: As such, O Agni, deal us wealth and hero might, O Bounteous One! Most lofty, very glorious, rich in progeny, free from disease and full of power.

verses.sa:
चक्रिर्यो विश्वा भुवनाभि सासहिश्चक्रिर्देवेष्वा दुवः ।
आ देवेषु यतत आ सुवीर्य आ शंस उत नृणाम्॥
verses.tr: cakriryo viśvā bhuvanābhi sāsahiścakrirdeveṣvā duvaḥ ā deveṣu yatata ā suvīrya ā śaṃsa uta nṛṇām
verses.en: He who made all that lives, who passes all in might, who orders service to the Gods, He works among the Gods, he works in hero strength, yea, also in the praise of men.

verses.sa:
मा नो अग्नेऽमतये मावीरतायै रीरधः ।
मागोतायै सहसस्पुत्र मा निदेऽप द्वेषांस्या कृधि॥
verses.tr: mā no agne'mataye māvīratāyai rīradhaḥ māgotāyai sahasasputra mā nide'pa dveṣāṃsyā kṛdhi
verses.en: Give us not up to indigence, Agni, nor want of hero sons, Nor, Son of Strength, to lack of cattle, nor to blame. Drive. thou our enemies away.

verses.sa:
शग्धि वाजस्य सुभग प्रजावतोऽग्ने बृहतो अध्वरे ।
सं राया भूयसा सृज मयोभुना तुविद्युम्न यशस्वता॥
verses.tr: śagdhi vājasya subhaga prajāvato'gne bṛhato adhvare saṃ rāyā bhūyasā sṛja mayobhunā tuvidyumna yaśasvatā
verses.en: Help us to strength, blest Agni! rich in progeny, abundant, in our sacrifice. Flood us with riches yet more plenteous, bringing weal, with high renown, most Glorious One!

verses.sa:
समिध्यमानः प्रथमानु धर्मा समक्तुभिरज्यते विश्ववारः ।
शोचिष्केशो घृतनिर्णिक् पावकः सुयज्ञो अग्निर्यजथाय देवान्॥
verses.tr: samidhyamānaḥ prathamānu dharmā samaktubhirajyate viśvavāraḥ śociṣkeśo ghṛtanirṇik pāvakaḥ suyajño agniryajathāya devān
verses.en: Duly enkindled after ancient customs, bringing all treasures, he is balmed with unguents,- Flame-haired, oil-clad, the purifying Agni, skilled in fair rites, to bring the Gods for worship.

verses.sa:
यथायजो होत्रमग्ने पृथिव्या यथा दिवो जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् ।
एवानेन हविषा यक्षि देवान् मनुष्वद् यज्ञं प्र तिरेममद्य॥
verses.tr: yathāyajo hotramagne pṛthivyā yathā divo jātavedaścikitvān evānena haviṣā yakṣi devān manuṣvad yajñaṃ pra tiremamadya
verses.en: As thou, O Agni, skillful Jatavedas, hast sacrificed as Priest of Earth, of Heaven, So with this offering bring the Gods, and prosper this sacrifice today as erst for Manu.

verses.sa:
त्रीण्यायूंषि तव जातवेदस्तिस्र आजानीरुषसस्ते अग्ने ।
ताभिर्देवानामवो यक्षि विद्वानथा भव यजमानाय शं योः॥
verses.tr: trīṇyāyūṃṣi tava jātavedastisra ājānīruṣasaste agne tābhirdevānāmavo yakṣi vidvānathā bhava yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ
verses.en: Three are thy times of life, O Jatavedas, and the three mornings are thy births, O Agni. With these, well-knowing, grant the Gods' kind favour, and help in stir aid stress the man who worships.

verses.sa:
अग्निं सुदीतिं सुदृशं गृणन्तो नमस्यामस्त्वेड्यं जातवेदः ।
त्वां दूतमरतिं हव्यवाहं देवा अकृण्वन्नमृतस्य नाभिम्॥
verses.tr: agniṃ sudītiṃ sudṛśaṃ gṛṇanto namasyāmastveḍyaṃ jātavedaḥ tvāṃ dūtamaratiṃ havyavāhaṃ devā akṛṇvannamṛtasya nābhim
verses.en: Agni most bright and fair with song we honour, yea, the adorable, O Jatavedas. Thee, envoy, messenger, oblation-bearer, the Gods have made centre of life eternal.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वद्धोता पूर्वो अग्ने यजीयान् द्विता च सत्ता स्वधया च शम्भुः ।
तस्यानु धर्म प्र यजा चिकित्वोऽथ नो धा अध्वरं देववीतौ॥
verses.tr: yastvaddhotā pūrvo agne yajīyān dvitā ca sattā svadhayā ca śambhuḥ tasyānu dharma pra yajā cikitvo'tha no dhā adhvaraṃ devavītau
verses.en: That Priest before thee, yet more skilled in worship, stablished of old, healthgiver by his nature,- After his custom offer, thou who knowest, and lay our sacrifice where Gods may taste it.

verses.sa:
भवा नो अग्ने सुमना उपेतौ सखेव सख्ये पितरेव साधुः ।
पुरुद्रुहो हि क्षितयो जनानां प्रति प्रतीचीर्दहतादरातीः॥
verses.tr: bhavā no agne sumanā upetau sakheva sakhye pitareva sādhuḥ purudruho hi kṣitayo janānāṃ prati pratīcīrdahatādarātīḥ
verses.en: Agni, be kind to us when we approach thee good as a friend to friend, as sire and mother. The races of mankind are great oppressors burn up malignity that strives against us.

verses.sa:
तपो ष्वग्ने अन्तराँ अमित्रान् तपा शंसमररुषः परस्य ।
तपो वसो चिकितानो अचित्तान् वि ते तिष्ठन्तामजरा अयासः॥
verses.tr: tapo ṣvagne antarāṃ amitrān tapā śaṃsamararuṣaḥ parasya tapo vaso cikitāno acittān vi te tiṣṭhantāmajarā ayāsaḥ
verses.en: Agni, burn up the unfriendly who are near us, burn thou the foeman's curse who pays no worship. Burn, Vasu, thou who markest well, the foolish: let thine eternal nimble beams surround thee.

verses.sa:
इध्मेनाग्न इच्छमानो घृतेन जुहोमि हव्यं तरसे बलाय ।
यावदीशे ब्रह्मणा वन्दमान इमां धियं शतसेयाय देवीम्॥
verses.tr: idhmenāgna icchamāno ghṛtena juhomi havyaṃ tarase balāya yāvadīśe brahmaṇā vandamāna imāṃ dhiyaṃ śataseyāya devīm
verses.en: With fuel, Agni, and with oil, desirous, mine offering I present for strength and conquest, With prayer, so far as I have power, adoring-this hymn divine to gain a hundred treasures.

verses.sa:
उच्छोचिषा सहसस्पुत्र स्तुतो बृहद् वयः शशमानेषु धेहि ।
रेवदग्ने विश्वामित्रेषु शं योर्मर्मृज्मा ते तन्वं१ भूरि कृत्वः॥
verses.tr: ucchociṣā sahasasputra stuto bṛhad vayaḥ śaśamāneṣu dhehi revadagne viśvāmitreṣu śaṃ yormarmṛjmā te tanvaṃ1 bhūri kṛtvaḥ
verses.en: Give with thy glow, thou Son of Strength, when lauded, great vital power to those who toil to serve thee. Give richly, Agni, to the Visvamitras in rest and stir. Oft have we decked thy body.

verses.sa:
कृधि रत्नं सुसनितर्धनानां स घेदग्ने भवसि यत् समिद्धः ।
स्तोतुर्दुरोणे सुभगस्य रेवत् सृप्रा करस्ना दधिषे वपूंषि॥
verses.tr: kṛdhi ratnaṃ susanitardhanānāṃ sa ghedagne bhavasi yat samiddhaḥ stoturduroṇe subhagasya revat sṛprā karasnā dadhiṣe vapūṃṣi
verses.en: Give us, O liberal Lord, great store of riches, for, Agni, such art thou when duly kindled. Thou in the happy singer's home bestowest, amply with arms extended, things of beauty.

verses.sa:
अग्निं होतारं प्र वृणे मियेधे गृत्सं कविं विश्वविदममूरम् ।
स नो यक्षद् देवताता यजीयान् राये वाजाय वनते मघानि॥
verses.tr: agniṃ hotāraṃ pra vṛṇe miyedhe gṛtsaṃ kaviṃ viśvavidamamūram sa no yakṣad devatātā yajīyān rāye vājāya vanate maghāni
verses.en: How, quick, sage, infallible, all-knowing, I choose to be our Priest at this oblation. In our Gods' service he, best skilled, shall worship: may he obtain us boons for strength and riches.

verses.sa:
प्र ते अग्ने हविष्मतीमियर्म्यच्छा सुद्युम्नां रातिनीं घृताचीम् ।
प्रदक्षिणिद् देवतातिमुराणः सं रातिभिर्वसुभिर्यज्ञमश्रेत्॥
verses.tr: pra te agne haviṣmatīmiyarmyacchā sudyumnāṃ rātinīṃ ghṛtācīm pradakṣiṇid devatātimurāṇaḥ saṃ rātibhirvasubhiryajñamaśret
verses.en: Agni, to thee I lift the oil-fed ladle, bright, with an offering, bearing our oblation. From the right hand, choosing the Gods' attendance, he with rich presents hath arranged the worship.

verses.sa:
स तेजीयसा मनसा त्वोत उत शिक्ष स्वपत्यस्य शिक्षोः ।
अग्ने रायो नृतमस्य प्रभूतौ भूयाम ते सुष्टुतयश्च वस्वः॥
verses.tr: sa tejīyasā manasā tvota uta śikṣa svapatyasya śikṣoḥ agne rāyo nṛtamasya prabhūtau bhūyāma te suṣṭutayaśca vasvaḥ
verses.en: Of keenest spirit is the man thou aidest give us good offspring, thou who givest freely. In power of wealth most rich in men. O Agni, of thee, the Good, may we sing forth fair praises.

verses.sa:
भूरीणि हि त्वे दधिरे अनीका ऽग्ने देवस्य यज्यवो जनासः ।
स आ वह देवतातिं यविष्ठ शर्धो यदद्य दिव्यं यजासि॥
verses.tr: bhūrīṇi hi tve dadhire anīkā 'gne devasya yajyavo janāsaḥ sa ā vaha devatātiṃ yaviṣṭha śardho yadadya divyaṃ yajāsi
verses.en: Men as they worship thee the God, O Agni, have set on thee full many a brilliant, aspect. So bring Most Youthful One, the Gods' asserrigly, the Heavenly Host which thou to-day shalt honour.

verses.sa:
यत् त्वा होतारमनजन् मियेधे निषादयन्तो यजथाय देवाः ।
स त्वं नो अग्नेऽवितेह बोध्यधि श्रवांसि धेहि नस्तनूषु॥
verses.tr: yat tvā hotāramanajan miyedhe niṣādayanto yajathāya devāḥ sa tvaṃ no agne'viteha bodhyadhi śravāṃsi dhehi nastanūṣu
verses.en: When Gods anoint thee Priest at their oblation, and seat thee for thy task as Sacrificer, O Agni, be thou here our kind defender, and to ourselves vouchsafe the gift of glory.

verses.sa:
अग्निमुषसमश्विना दधिक्रां व्युष्टिषु हवते वह्निरुक्थैः ।
सुज्योतिषो नः शृण्वन्तु देवाः सजोषसो अध्वरं वावशानाः॥
verses.tr: agnimuṣasamaśvinā dadhikrāṃ vyuṣṭiṣu havate vahnirukthaiḥ sujyotiṣo naḥ śṛṇvantu devāḥ sajoṣaso adhvaraṃ vāvaśānāḥ
verses.en: With lauds at break of morn the priest invoketh Agni, Dawn, Dadhikras, and both the Asvins. With one consent the Gods whose light is splendid, longing to taste our sacrifice, shall hear us.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्री ते वाजिना त्री षधस्था तिस्रस्ते जिह्वा ऋतजात पूर्वीः ।
तिस्र उ ते तन्वो देववातास्ताभिर्नः पाहि गिरो अप्रयुच्छन्॥
verses.tr: agne trī te vājinā trī ṣadhasthā tisraste jihvā ṛtajāta pūrvīḥ tisra u te tanvo devavātāstābhirnaḥ pāhi giro aprayucchan
verses.en: Three are thy powers, O Agni, three thy stations, three are thy tongues, yea, many, Child of Order! Three bodies hast thou which the Gods delight in: with these protect our hymns with care unceasing.

verses.sa:
अग्ने भूरीणि तव जातवेदो देव स्वधावोऽमृतस्य नाम ।
याश्च माया मायिनां विश्वमिन्व त्वे पूर्वीः संदधुः पृष्टबन्धो॥
verses.tr: agne bhūrīṇi tava jātavedo deva svadhāvo'mṛtasya nāma yāśca māyā māyināṃ viśvaminva tve pūrvīḥ saṃdadhuḥ pṛṣṭabandho
verses.en: O Agni, many are the names thou bearest, immortal, God, Divine, and Jatavedas. And many charms of charmers, All-Inspirer! have they laid in thee, Lord of true attendants!

verses.sa:
अग्निर्नेता भग इव क्षितीनां दैवीनां देव ऋतुपा ऋतावा ।
स वृत्रहा सनयो विश्ववेदाः पर्षद् विश्वाति दुरिता गृणन्तम्॥
verses.tr: agnirnetā bhaga iva kṣitīnāṃ daivīnāṃ deva ṛtupā ṛtāvā sa vṛtrahā sanayo viśvavedāḥ parṣad viśvāti duritā gṛṇantam
verses.en: Agni, like Bhaga, leads the godly people, he who is true to Law and guards the seasons. Ancient, all-knowing, he the Vrtra-slayer shall bear the singer safe through every trouble.

verses.sa:
दधिक्रामग्निमुषसं च देवीं बृहस्पतिं सवितारं च देवम् ।
अश्विना मित्रावरुणा भगं च वसून् रुद्राँ आदित्याँ इह हुवे॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāmagnimuṣasaṃ ca devīṃ bṛhaspatiṃ savitāraṃ ca devam aśvinā mitrāvaruṇā bhagaṃ ca vasūn rudrāṃ ādityāṃ iha huve
verses.en: I call on Savitar the God, on Morning, Brhaspati, and Dadhikras, and Agni, On Varuna and Mitra, on the Asvins, Bhaga, the Vasus, Rudras and Adityas.

verses.sa:
इमं नो यज्ञममृतेषु धेहीमा हव्या जातवेदो जुषस्व ।
स्तोकानामग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य होतः प्राशान प्रथमो निषद्य॥
verses.tr: imaṃ no yajñamamṛteṣu dhehīmā havyā jātavedo juṣasva stokānāmagne medaso ghṛtasya hotaḥ prāśāna prathamo niṣadya
verses.en: Set this our sacrifice among the Immortals: be pleased with these our presents, Jatavedas. O Priest, O Agni, sit thee down before us, and first enjoy the drops of oil and fatness.

verses.sa:
घृतवन्तः पावक ते स्तोकाः श्चोतन्ति मेदसः ।
स्वधर्मन् देववीतये श्रेष्ठं नो धेहि वार्यम्॥
verses.tr: ghṛtavantaḥ pāvaka te stokāḥ ścotanti medasaḥ svadharman devavītaye śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryam
verses.en: For thee, O Purifier, flow the drops of fatness rich in oil. After thy wont vouchsafe to us the choicest boon that Gods may feast.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं स्तोका घृतश्चुतोऽग्ने विप्राय सन्त्य ।
ऋषिः श्रेष्ठः समिध्यसे यज्ञस्य प्राविता भव॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ stokā ghṛtaścuto'gne viprāya santya ṛṣiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ samidhyase yajñasya prāvitā bhava
verses.en: Agni, Most Excellent! for thee the Sage are drops that drip with oil. Thou art enkindled as the best of Seers. Help thou the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं श्चोतन्त्यध्रिगो शचीवः स्तोकासो अग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य ।
कविशस्तो बृहता भानुनागा हव्या जुषस्व मेधिर॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ ścotantyadhrigo śacīvaḥ stokāso agne medaso ghṛtasya kaviśasto bṛhatā bhānunāgā havyā juṣasva medhira
verses.en: To thee, O Agni, mighty and resistless, to thee stream forth the drops of oil and fatness. With great light art thou come, O praised by poets! Accept our offering, O thou Sage.

verses.sa:
ओजिष्ठं ते मध्यतो मेद उद्भृतं प्र ते वयं ददामहे ।
श्चोतन्ति ते वसो स्तोका अधि त्वचि प्रति तान् देवशो विहि॥
verses.tr: ojiṣṭhaṃ te madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ pra te vayaṃ dadāmahe ścotanti te vaso stokā adhi tvaci prati tān devaśo vihi
verses.en: Fatness exceeding rich, extracted from the midst,-this as our gift we offer thee. Excellent God, the drops run down upon thy skin. Deal them to each among the Gods.

verses.sa:
अयं सो अग्निर्यस्मिन् त्सोममिन्द्रः सुतं दधे जठरे वावशानः ।
सहस्रिणं वाजमत्यं न सप्तिं ससवान् त्सन् त्स्तूयसे जातवेदः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ so agniryasmin tsomamindraḥ sutaṃ dadhe jaṭhare vāvaśānaḥ sahasriṇaṃ vājamatyaṃ na saptiṃ sasavān tsan tstūyase jātavedaḥ
verses.en: This is that Agni whence the longing Indra took the pressed Soma deep within his body. Winner of spoils in thousands, like a courser, with praise art thou exalted, Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
अग्ने यत् ते दिवि वर्चः पृथिव्यां यदोषधीष्वप्स्वा यजत्र ।
