verses.en: The Mother of the Twins hath borne Twin Children: my tongue's tip raised itself and rested silent. Killing the darkness at the light's foundation, the Couple newly born attain their beauty.

verses.sa:
नकिरेषां निन्दिता मर्त्येषु ये अस्माकं पितरो गोषु योधाः ।
इन्द्र एषां दृंहिता माहिनावानुद् गोत्राणि ससृजे दंसनावान्॥
verses.tr: nakireṣāṃ ninditā martyeṣu ye asmākaṃ pitaro goṣu yodhāḥ indra eṣāṃ dṛṃhitā māhināvānud gotrāṇi sasṛje daṃsanāvān
verses.en: Not one is found among them, none of mortals, to blame our sires who fought to win the cattle. Their strengthener was Indra the Majestic he spread their stalls of kine the Wonder-Worker.

verses.sa:
सखा ह यत्र सखिभिर्नवग्वैरभिज्ञ्वा सत्वभिर्गा अनुग्मन् ।
सत्यं तदिन्द्रो दशभिर्दशग्वैः सूर्यं विवेद तमसि क्षियन्तम्॥
verses.tr: sakhā ha yatra sakhibhirnavagvairabhijñvā satvabhirgā anugman satyaṃ tadindro daśabhirdaśagvaiḥ sūryaṃ viveda tamasi kṣiyantam
verses.en: Where as a Friend with friendly men, Navagvas, with heroes, on his knees he sought the cattle. There, verily with ten Dasagvas Indra found the Sun lying hidden in the darkness.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मधु सम्भृतमुस्रियायां पद्वद् विवेद शफवन्नमे गोः ।
गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळहमप्सु हस्ते दधे दक्षिणे दक्षिणावान्॥
verses.tr: indro madhu sambhṛtamusriyāyāṃ padvad viveda śaphavanname goḥ guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḻahamapsu haste dadhe dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇāvān
verses.en: Indra found meath collected in the milch-cow, by foot and hoof, in the cow's place of pasture. That which lay secret, hidden in the waters, he held in his right hand, the rich rewarder.

verses.sa:
ज्योतिर्वृणीत तमसो विजानन्नारे स्याम दुरितादभीके ।
इमा गिरः सोमपाः सोमवृद्ध जुषस्वेन्द्र पुरुतमस्य कारोः॥
verses.tr: jyotirvṛṇīta tamaso vijānannāre syāma duritādabhīke imā giraḥ somapāḥ somavṛddha juṣasvendra purutamasya kāroḥ
verses.en: He took the light, discerning it from darkness: may we be far removed from all misfortune. These songs, O Soma-drinker, cheered by Soma, Indra, accept from thy most zealous poet.

verses.sa:
ज्योतिर्यज्ञाय रोदसी अनु ष्यादारे स्याम दुरितस्य भूरेः ।
भूरि चिद्धि तुजतो मर्त्यस्य सुपारासो वसवो बर्हणावत्॥
verses.tr: jyotiryajñāya rodasī anu ṣyādāre syāma duritasya bhūreḥ bhūri ciddhi tujato martyasya supārāso vasavo barhaṇāvat
verses.en: Let there be light through both the worlds for worship: may we be far from most overwhelming evil. Great woe comes even from the hostile mortal, piled up; but good at rescue are the Vasus.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन् भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
verses.en: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered, The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa: इन्द्र त्वा वृषभं वयं सुते सोमे हवामहे । स पाहि मध्वो अन्धसः॥
verses.tr: indra tvā vṛṣabhaṃ vayaṃ sute some havāmahe sa pāhi madhvo andhasaḥ
verses.en: Thee, Indra, we invoke, the Bull, what time the Soma is expressed. So drink thou of the savoury juice.

verses.sa: इन्द्र क्रतुविदं सुतं सोमं हर्य पुरुष्टुत । पिबा वृषस्व तातृपिम्॥
verses.tr: indra kratuvidaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ harya puruṣṭuta pibā vṛṣasva tātṛpim
verses.en: Indra, whom many laud, accept the strength-conferring Soma juice: Quaff, pour down drink that satisfies.

verses.sa: इन्द्र प्र णो धितावानं यज्ञं विश्वेभिर्देवेभिः । तिर स्तवान विश्पते॥
verses.tr: indra pra ṇo dhitāvānaṃ yajñaṃ viśvebhirdevebhiḥ tira stavāna viśpate
verses.en: Indra, with all the Gods promote our wealth-bestowing sacrifice, Thou highly-lauded Lord of men.

verses.sa: इन्द्र सोमाः सुता इमे तव प्र यन्ति सत्पते । क्षयं चन्द्रास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: indra somāḥ sutā ime tava pra yanti satpate kṣayaṃ candrāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: Lord of the brave, to thee proceed these drops of Soma juice expressed, The bright drops to thy dwelling-place.

verses.sa: दधिष्वा जठरे सुतं सोममिन्द्र वरेण्यम् । तव द्युक्षास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: dadhiṣvā jaṭhare sutaṃ somamindra vareṇyam tava dyukṣāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: Within thy belly, Indra, take juice, Soma the most excellent: Thine are the drops celestial.

verses.sa: गिर्वणः पाहि नः सुतं मधोर्धाराभिरज्यसे । इन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः॥
verses.tr: girvaṇaḥ pāhi naḥ sutaṃ madhordhārābhirajyase indra tvādātamidyaśaḥ
verses.en: Drink our libation, Lord of hymns: with streams of meath thou art bedewed Our glory, Indra, is thy gift.

verses.sa: अभि द्युम्नानि वनिन इन्द्रं सचन्ते अक्षिता । पीत्वी सोमस्य वावृधे॥
verses.tr: abhi dyumnāni vanina indraṃ sacante akṣitā pītvī somasya vāvṛdhe
verses.en: To Indra go the treasures of the worshipper, which never fail: He drinks the Soma and is strong

verses.sa: अर्वावतो न आ गहि परावतश्च वृत्रहन् । इमा जुषस्व नो गिरः॥
verses.tr: arvāvato na ā gahi parāvataśca vṛtrahan imā juṣasva no giraḥ
verses.en: From far away, from near at hand, O Vrtra-slayer, come to us: Accept the songs we sing to thee.

verses.sa: यदन्तरा परावतमर्वावतं च हूयसे । इन्द्रेह तत आ गहि॥
verses.tr: yadantarā parāvatamarvāvataṃ ca hūyase indreha tata ā gahi
verses.en: When from the space between the near and far thou art invoked by us, Thence, Indra. come thou hitherward.

verses.sa: आ तू न इन्द्र मद्र्यग्घुवानः सोमपीतये । हरिभ्यां याह्यद्रिवः॥
verses.tr: ā tū na indra madryagghuvānaḥ somapītaye haribhyāṃ yāhyadrivaḥ
verses.en: Invoked to drink the Soma juice, come with thy Bay Steeds, Thunder-armed Come, Indra, hitherward to me.

verses.sa: सत्तो होता न ऋत्वियस्तिस्तिरे बर्हिरानुषक् । अयुज्रन्प्रातरद्रयः॥
verses.tr: satto hotā na ṛtviyastistire barhirānuṣak ayujranprātaradrayaḥ
verses.en: Our priest is seated, true to time; the grass is regularly strewn; The pressing-stones were set at morn.

verses.sa: इमा ब्रह्म ब्रह्मवाहः क्रियन्त आ बर्हिः सीद । वीहि शूर पुरोळाशम्॥
verses.tr: imā brahma brahmavāhaḥ kriyanta ā barhiḥ sīda vīhi śūra puroḻāśam
verses.en: These prayers, O thou who hearest prayer are offered: seat thee on the grass. Hero, enjoy the offered cake.

verses.sa: रारन्धि सवनेषु ण एषु स्तोमेषु वृत्रहन् । उक्थेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः॥
verses.tr: rārandhi savaneṣu ṇa eṣu stomeṣu vṛtrahan uktheṣvindra girvaṇaḥ
verses.en: O Vrtra-slayer, be thou pleased with these libations, with these hymns, Song-loving Indra, with our lauds.

verses.sa: मतयः सोमपामुरुं रिहन्ति शवसस्पतिम् । इन्द्रं वत्सं न मातरः॥
verses.tr: matayaḥ somapāmuruṃ rihanti śavasaspatim indraṃ vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ
verses.en: Our hymns caress the Lord of Strength, vast, drinker of the Soma's juice, Indra, as mother-cows their calf.

verses.sa: स मन्दस्वा ह्यन्धसो राधसे तन्वा महे । न स्तोतारं निदे करः॥
verses.tr: sa mandasvā hyandhaso rādhase tanvā mahe na stotāraṃ nide karaḥ
verses.en: Delight thee with the juice we pour for thine own great munificence: Yield not thy singer to reproach.

verses.sa: वयमिन्द्र त्वायवो हविष्मन्तो जरामहे । उत त्वमस्मयुर्वसो॥
verses.tr: vayamindra tvāyavo haviṣmanto jarāmahe uta tvamasmayurvaso
verses.en: We, Indra, dearly loving thee, bearing oblation, sing thee hymns Thou, Vasu, dearly lovest us.

verses.sa: मारे अस्मद् वि मुमुचो हरिप्रियार्वाङ् याहि । इन्द्र स्वधावो मत्स्वेह॥
verses.tr: māre asmad vi mumuco haripriyārvāṅ yāhi indra svadhāvo matsveha
verses.en: O thou to whom thy Bays are dear, loose not thy Horses far from us: Here glad thee, Indra, Lord divine.

verses.sa: अर्वाञ्चं त्वा सुखे रथे वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । घृतस्नू बर्हिरासदे॥
verses.tr: arvāñcaṃ tvā sukhe rathe vahatāmindra keśinā ghṛtasnū barhirāsade
verses.en: May long-maned Coursers, dropping oil, bring thee on swift car hitherward, Indra, to seat thee on the grass.

verses.sa: उप नः सुतमा गहि सोममिन्द्र गवाशिरम् । हरिभ्यां यस्ते अस्मयुः॥
verses.tr: upa naḥ sutamā gahi somamindra gavāśiram haribhyāṃ yaste asmayuḥ
verses.en: Come to the juice that we have pressed, to Sorna, Indra, bleat with milk: Come, favouring us, thy Bay-drawn car!

verses.sa: तमिन्द्र मदमा गहि बर्हिःष्ठां ग्रावभिः सुतम् । कुविन्न्वस्य तृप्णवः॥
verses.tr: tamindra madamā gahi barhiḥṣṭhāṃ grāvabhiḥ sutam kuvinnvasya tṛpṇavaḥ
verses.en: Come, Indra, to this gladdening drink, placed on the grass, pressed out with stones: Wilt thou not drink thy fill thereof?

verses.sa: इन्द्रमित्था गिरो ममाच्छागुरिषिता इतः । आवृते सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: indramitthā giro mamācchāguriṣitā itaḥ āvṛte somapītaye
verses.en: To Indra have my songs of praise gone forth, thus rapidly sent hence, To turn him to the Soma-draught.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये स्तोमैरिह हवामहे । उक्थेभिः कुविदागमत्॥
verses.tr: indraṃ somasya pītaye stomairiha havāmahe ukthebhiḥ kuvidāgamat
verses.en: Hither with songs of praise we call Indra to drink the Soma juice: Will he not come to us by lauds?

verses.sa: इन्द्र सोमाः सुता इमे तान् दधिष्व शतक्रतो । जठरे वाजिनीवसो॥
verses.tr: indra somāḥ sutā ime tān dadhiṣva śatakrato jaṭhare vājinīvaso
verses.en: Indra, these Somas are expressed. Take them within thy belly, Lord Of Hundred Powers, thou Prince of Wealth.

verses.sa: विद्मा हि त्वा धनंजयं वाजेषु दधृषं कवे । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे॥
verses.tr: vidmā hi tvā dhanaṃjayaṃ vājeṣu dadhṛṣaṃ kave adhā te sumnamīmahe
verses.en: We know thee winner of the spoil, and resolute in battles, Sage! Therefore thy blessing we implore.

verses.sa: इममिन्द्र गवाशिरं यवाशिरं च नः पिब । आगत्या वृषभिः सुतम्॥
verses.tr: imamindra gavāśiraṃ yavāśiraṃ ca naḥ piba āgatyā vṛṣabhiḥ sutam
verses.en: Borne hither by thy Stallions, drink, Indra, this juice which we have pressed, Mingled with barley and with milk.

verses.sa: तुभ्येदिन्द्र स्व ओक्ये३ सोमं चोदामि पीतये । एष रारन्तु ते हृदि॥
verses.tr: tubhyedindra sva okye3 somaṃ codāmi pītaye eṣa rārantu te hṛdi
verses.en: Indra, for thee, in thine own place, I urge the Soma for thy draught: Deep in thy heart let it remain,

verses.sa: त्वां सुतस्य पीतये प्रत्नमिन्द्र हवामहे । कुशिकासो अवस्यवः॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ sutasya pītaye pratnamindra havāmahe kuśikāso avasyavaḥ
verses.en: We call on thee, the Ancient One, Indra, to drink the Soma juice, We Kusikas who seek thine aid.

verses.sa:
आ याह्यर्वाङुप वन्धुरेष्ठास्तवेदनु प्रदिवः सोमपेयम् ।
प्रिया सखाया वि मुचोप बर्हिस्त्वामिमे हव्यवाहो हवन्ते॥
verses.tr: ā yāhyarvāṅupa vandhureṣṭhāstavedanu pradivaḥ somapeyam priyā sakhāyā vi mucopa barhistvāmime havyavāho havante
verses.en: Mounted upon thy chariot-seat approach us: thine is the Soma-draught from days aforetime. Loose for the sacred grass thy dear companions. These men who bring oblation call thee hither.

verses.sa:
आ याहि पूर्वीरति चर्षणीराँ अर्य आशिष उप नो हरिभ्याम् ।
इमा हि त्वा मतयः स्तोमतष्टा इन्द्र हवन्ते सख्यं जुषाणाः॥
verses.tr: ā yāhi pūrvīrati carṣaṇīrāṃ arya āśiṣa upa no haribhyām imā hi tvā matayaḥ stomataṣṭā indra havante sakhyaṃ juṣāṇāḥ
verses.en: Come our true Friend, passing by many people; come with thy two Bay Steeds to our devotions; For these our hymns are calling thee, O Indra, hymns formed for praise, soliciting thy friendship.

verses.sa:
आ नो यज्ञं नमोवृधं सजोषा इन्द्र देव हरिभिर्याहि तूयम् ।
अहं हि त्वा मतिभिर्जोहवीमि घृतप्रयाः सधमादे मधूनाम्॥
verses.tr: ā no yajñaṃ namovṛdhaṃ sajoṣā indra deva haribhiryāhi tūyam ahaṃ hi tvā matibhirjohavīmi ghṛtaprayāḥ sadhamāde madhūnām
verses.en: Pleased, with thy Bay Steeds, Indra, God, come quickly to this our sacrifice that heightens worship; For with my thoughts, presenting oil to feed thee, I call thee to the feast of sweet libations.

verses.sa:
आ च त्वामेता वृषणा वहातो हरी सखाया सुधुरा स्वङ्गा ।
धानावदिन्द्रः सवनं जुषाणः सखा सख्युः शृणवद् वन्दनानि॥
verses.tr: ā ca tvāmetā vṛṣaṇā vahāto harī sakhāyā sudhurā svaṅgā dhānāvadindraḥ savanaṃ juṣāṇaḥ sakhā sakhyuḥ śṛṇavad vandanāni
verses.en: Yea, let thy two Bay Stallions bear thee hither, well limbed and good to draw, thy dear companions. Pleased with the corn-blent offering which we bring thee, may Indra, Friend, hear his friend's adoration.

verses.sa:
कुविन्मा गोपां करसे जनस्य कुविद् राजानं मघवन्नृजीषिन् ।
कुविन्म ऋषिं पपिवांसं सुतस्य कुविन्मे वस्वो अमृतस्य शिक्षाः॥
verses.tr: kuvinmā gopāṃ karase janasya kuvid rājānaṃ maghavannṛjīṣin kuvinma ṛṣiṃ papivāṃsaṃ sutasya kuvinme vasvo amṛtasya śikṣāḥ
verses.en: Wilt thou not make me guardian of the people, make me, impetuous Maghavan, their ruler? Make me a Rsi having drunk of Soma? Wilt thou not give me wealth that lasts for ever?

verses.sa:
आ त्वा बृहन्तो हरयो युजाना अर्वागिन्द्र सधमादो वहन्तु ।
प्र ये द्विता दिव ऋञ्जन्त्याताः सुसम्मृष्टासो वृषभस्य मूराः॥
verses.tr: ā tvā bṛhanto harayo yujānā arvāgindra sadhamādo vahantu pra ye dvitā diva ṛñjantyātāḥ susammṛṣṭāso vṛṣabhasya mūrāḥ
verses.en: Yoked to thy chariot, led thy tall Bays, Indra, companions of thy banquet, bear thee hither, Who from of old press to heaven's farthest limits, the Bull's impetuous and well-groomed Horses.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र पिब वृषधूतस्य वृष्ण आ यं ते श्येन उशते जभार ।
यस्य मदे च्यावयसि प्र कृष्टीर्यस्य मदे अप गोत्रा ववर्थ॥
verses.tr: indra piba vṛṣadhūtasya vṛṣṇa ā yaṃ te śyena uśate jabhāra yasya made cyāvayasi pra kṛṣṭīryasya made apa gotrā vavartha
verses.en: Drink of the strong pressed out by strong ones, Indra, that which the Falcon brought thee when thou longedst; In whose wild joy thou stirrest up the people, in whose wild joy thou didst unbar the cow-stalls.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन् भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
verses.en: Call we on Indra, Makhavan, auspicious, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered; The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
अयं ते अस्तु हर्यतः सोम आ हरिभिः सुतः ।
जुषाण इन्द्र हरिभिर्न आ गह्या तिष्ठ हरितं रथम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te astu haryataḥ soma ā haribhiḥ sutaḥ juṣāṇa indra haribhirna ā gahyā tiṣṭha haritaṃ ratham
verses.en: May this delightsome Soma be expressed for thee by tawny stones. Joying thereat, O Indra, with thy Bay Steeds come: ascend thy golden-coloured car.

verses.sa:
हर्यन्नुषसमर्चयः सूर्यं हर्यन्नरोचयः ।
विद्वाँश्चिकित्वान् हर्यश्व वर्धस इन्द्र विश्वा अभि श्रियः॥
verses.tr: haryannuṣasamarcayaḥ sūryaṃ haryannarocayaḥ vidvāṃścikitvān haryaśva vardhasa indra viśvā abhi śriyaḥ
verses.en: In love thou madest Usas glow, in love thou madest Surya shine. Thou, Indra, knowing, thinking, Lord of Tawny Steeds, above all glories waxest great.

verses.sa:
द्यामिन्द्रो हरिधायसं पृथिवीं हरिवर्पसम् ।
अधारयद्धरितोर्भूरि भोजनं ययोरन्तर्हरिश्चरत्॥
verses.tr: dyāmindro haridhāyasaṃ pṛthivīṃ harivarpasam adhārayaddharitorbhūri bhojanaṃ yayorantarhariścarat
verses.en: The heaven with streams of golden hue, earth with her tints of green and gold- The golden Pair yield Indra plenteous nourishment: between them moves the golden One.

verses.sa:
जज्ञानो हरितो वृषा विश्वमा भाति रोचनम् ।
हर्यश्वो हरितं धत्त आयुधमा वज्रं बाह्वोर्हरिम्॥
verses.tr: jajñāno harito vṛṣā viśvamā bhāti rocanam haryaśvo haritaṃ dhatta āyudhamā vajraṃ bāhvorharim
verses.en: When born to life the golden Bull illumines all the realm of light. He takes his golden weapon, Lord of Tawny Steeds, the golden thunder in his arms.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो हर्यन्तमर्जुनं वज्रं शुक्रैरभीवृतम् ।
अपावृणोद्धरिभिरद्रिभिः सुतमुद् गा हरिभिराजत॥
verses.tr: indro haryantamarjunaṃ vajraṃ śukrairabhīvṛtam apāvṛṇoddharibhiradribhiḥ sutamud gā haribhirājata
verses.en: The bright, the well-loved thunderbolt, girt with the bright, Indra disclosed, Disclosed the Soma juice pressed out by tawny stones, with tawny steeds drave forth the kine.

verses.sa:
आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः ।
मा त्वा के चिन्नि यमन्विं न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव ताँ इहि॥
verses.tr: ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi mayūraromabhiḥ mā tvā ke cinni yamanviṃ na pāśino'ti dhanveva tāṃ ihi
verses.en: Come hither, Indra, with Bay Steeds, joyous, with tails like peacocks' plumes. Let no men cheek thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands.

verses.sa:
वृत्रखादो वलंरुजः पुरां दर्मो अपामजः ।
स्थाता रथस्य हर्योरभिस्वर इन्द्रो दृळहा चिदारुजः॥
verses.tr: vṛtrakhādo valaṃrujaḥ purāṃ darmo apāmajaḥ sthātā rathasya haryorabhisvara indro dṛḻahā cidārujaḥ
verses.en: He who slew Vrtra, burst the cloud, brake the strongholds and drave the floods, Indra who mounts his chariot at his Bay Steeds' cry, shatters e'en things that stand most firm.

verses.sa:
गम्भीराँ उदधीँरिव क्रतुं पुष्यसि गा इव ।
प्र सुगोपा यवसं धेनवो यथा ह्रदं कुल्या इवाशत॥
verses.tr: gambhīrāṃ udadhīṃriva kratuṃ puṣyasi gā iva pra sugopā yavasaṃ dhenavo yathā hradaṃ kulyā ivāśata
verses.en: Like pools of water deep and full, like kine thou cherishest thy might; Like the milch-cows that go well-guarded to the mead, like water-brooks that reach the lake.

verses.sa:
आ नस्तुजं रयिं भरांशं न प्रतिजानते ।
वृक्षं पक्वं फलमङ्कीव धूनुहीन्द्र सम्पारणं वसु॥
verses.tr: ā nastujaṃ rayiṃ bharāṃśaṃ na pratijānate vṛkṣaṃ pakvaṃ phalamaṅkīva dhūnuhīndra sampāraṇaṃ vasu
verses.en: Bring thou us wealth with power to strike, our share, 'gainst him who calls it his. Shake, Indra, as with hooks, the tree for ripened fruit, for wealth to satisfy our wish.

verses.sa:
स्वयुरिन्द्र स्वराळसि स्मद्दिष्टिः स्वयशस्तरः ।
स वावृधान ओजसा पुरुष्टुत भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः॥
verses.tr: svayurindra svarāḻasi smaddiṣṭiḥ svayaśastaraḥ sa vāvṛdhāna ojasā puruṣṭuta bhavā naḥ suśravastamaḥ
verses.en: Indra, self-ruling Lord art thou, good Leader, of most glorious fame. So, waxen in thy strength, O thou whom many praise, be thou most swift to hear our call.

verses.sa:
युध्मस्य ते वृषभस्य स्वराज उग्रस्य यूनः स्थविरस्य घृष्वेः ।
अजूर्यतो वज्रिणो वीर्या३णीन्द्र श्रुतस्य महतो महानि॥
verses.tr: yudhmasya te vṛṣabhasya svarāja ugrasya yūnaḥ sthavirasya ghṛṣveḥ ajūryato vajriṇo vīryā3ṇīndra śrutasya mahato mahāni
verses.en: Of thee, the Bull, the Warrior, Sovran Ruler, joyous and fierce, ancient and ever youthful, The undecaying One who wields the thunder, renowned and great, great are the exploits, Indra.

verses.sa:
महाँ असि महिष वृष्ण्येभिर्धनस्पृदुग्र सहमानो अन्यान् ।
एको विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा स योधया च क्षयया च जनान्॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ asi mahiṣa vṛṣṇyebhirdhanaspṛdugra sahamāno anyān eko viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā sa yodhayā ca kṣayayā ca janān
verses.en: Great art thou, Mighty Lord, through manly vigour, O fierce One, gathering spoil, subduing others, Thyself alone the universe's Sovran: so send forth men to combat and to rest them.

verses.sa:
प्र मात्राभी रिरिचे रोचमानः प्र देवेभिर्विश्वतो अप्रतीतः ।
प्र मज्मना दिव इन्द्रः पृथिव्याः प्रोरोर्महो अन्तरिक्षादृजीषी॥
verses.tr: pra mātrābhī ririce rocamānaḥ pra devebhirviśvato apratītaḥ pra majmanā diva indraḥ pṛthivyāḥ prorormaho antarikṣādṛjīṣī
verses.en: He hath surpassed all measure in his brightness, yea, and the Gods, for none may be his equal. Impetuous Indra in his might exceedeth wide vast mid-air and heaven and earth together.

verses.sa:
उरुं गभीरं जनुषाभ्यु१ग्रं विश्वव्यचसमवतं मतीनाम् ।
इन्द्रं सोमासः प्रदिवि सुतासः समुद्रं न स्रवत आ विशन्ति॥
verses.tr: uruṃ gabhīraṃ januṣābhyu1graṃ viśvavyacasamavataṃ matīnām indraṃ somāsaḥ pradivi sutāsaḥ samudraṃ na sravata ā viśanti
verses.en: To Indra, even as rivers to the ocean, flow forth from days of old the Soma juices; To him wide deep and mighty from his birth-time, the well of holy thoughts, all-comprehending.

verses.sa:
यं सोममिन्द्र पृथिवीद्यावा गर्भं न माता बिभृतस्त्वाया ।
तं ते हिन्वन्ति तमु ते मृजन्त्यध्वर्यवो वृषभ पातवा उ॥
verses.tr: yaṃ somamindra pṛthivīdyāvā garbhaṃ na mātā bibhṛtastvāyā taṃ te hinvanti tamu te mṛjantyadhvaryavo vṛṣabha pātavā u
verses.en: The Soma, Indra, which the earth and heaven bear for thee as a mother bears her infant, This they send forth to thee, this, vigorous Hero! Adhvaryus purify for thee to drink of.

verses.sa:
मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र वृषभो रणाय पिबा सोममनुष्वधं मदाय ।
आ सिञ्चस्व जठरे मध्व ऊर्मिं त्वं राजासि प्रदिवः सुतानाम्॥
verses.tr: marutvāṃ indra vṛṣabho raṇāya pibā somamanuṣvadhaṃ madāya ā siñcasva jaṭhare madhva ūrmiṃ tvaṃ rājāsi pradivaḥ sutānām
verses.en: Drink, Indra, Marut-girt, as Bull, the Soma, for joy, for rapture even as thou listest. Pour down the flood of meath within thy belly: thou from of old art King of Soma juices.

verses.sa:
सजोषा इन्द्र सगणो मरुद्भिः सोमं पिब वृत्रहा शूर विद्वान् ।
जहि शत्रूँरप मृधो नुदस्वाथाभयं कृणुहि विश्वतो नः॥
verses.tr: sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān jahi śatrūṃrapa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ
verses.en: Indra, accordant, with the banded Maruts, drink Soma, Hero, as wise Vrtra-slayer. Slay thou our foemen, drive away assailants and make us safe on every side from danger.

verses.sa:
उत ऋतुभिर्ऋतुपाः पाहि सोममिन्द्र देवेभिः सखिभिः सुतं नः ।
याँ आभजो मरुतो ये त्वान्वहन् वृत्रमदधुस्तुभ्यमोजः॥
verses.tr: uta ṛtubhirṛtupāḥ pāhi somamindra devebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ sutaṃ naḥ yāṃ ābhajo maruto ye tvānvahan vṛtramadadhustubhyamojaḥ
verses.en: And, drinker at due seasons, drink in season, Indra, with friendly Gods, our pressed-out Soma. The Maruts following, whom thou madest sharers, gave thee the victory, and thou slewest Vrtra.

verses.sa:
ये त्वाहिहत्ये मघवन्नवर्धन् ये शाम्बरे हरिवो ये गविष्टौ ।
ये त्वा नूनमनुमदन्ति विप्राः पिबेन्द्र सोमं सगणो मरुद्भिः॥
verses.tr: ye tvāhihatye maghavannavardhan ye śāmbare harivo ye gaviṣṭau ye tvā nūnamanumadanti viprāḥ pibendra somaṃ sagaṇo marudbhiḥ
verses.en: Drink Soma, Indra, banded with the Maruts who, Maghavan, strengthened thee at Ahi's slaughter, 'Gainst Sambara, Lord of Bays! in winning cattle, and now rejoice in thee, the holy Singers.

verses.sa:
मरुत्वन्तं वृषभं वावृधानमकवारिं दिव्यं शासमिन्द्रम् ।
विश्वासाहमवसे नूतनायोग्रं सहोदामिह तं हुवेम॥
verses.tr: marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānamakavāriṃ divyaṃ śāsamindram viśvāsāhamavase nūtanāyograṃ sahodāmiha taṃ huvema
verses.en: The Bull whose strength hath waxed, whom Maruts follow, free-giving Indra, the celestial Ruler, Mighty, all-conquering, the victory-giver, him let us call to grant us new protection.

verses.sa:
सद्यो ह जातो वृषभः कनीनः प्रभर्तुमावदन्धसः सुतस्य ।
साधोः पिब प्रतिकामं यथा ते रसाशिरः प्रथमं सोम्यस्य॥
verses.tr: sadyo ha jāto vṛṣabhaḥ kanīnaḥ prabhartumāvadandhasaḥ sutasya sādhoḥ piba pratikāmaṃ yathā te rasāśiraḥ prathamaṃ somyasya
verses.en: Soon as the young Bull sprang into existence he longed to taste the pressed-out Soma's liquor. Drink thou thy fill, according to thy longing, first, of the goodly mixture blent with Soma.

verses.sa:
यज्जायथास्तदहरस्य कामेंऽशोः पीयूषमपिबो गिरिष्ठाम् ।
तं ते माता परि योषा जनित्री महः पितुर्दम आसिञ्चदग्रे॥
verses.tr: yajjāyathāstadaharasya kāmeṃ'śoḥ pīyūṣamapibo giriṣṭhām taṃ te mātā pari yoṣā janitrī mahaḥ piturdama āsiñcadagre
verses.en: That day when thou wast born thou, fain to taste it, drankest the plant's milk which the mountains nourish. That milk thy Mother first, the Dame who bare thee, poured for thee in thy mighty Father's dwelling.

verses.sa:
उपस्थाय मातरमन्नमैट्ट तिग्ममपश्यदभि सोममूधः ।
प्रयावयन्नचरद् गृत्सो अन्यान् महानि चक्रे पुरुधप्रतीकः॥
verses.tr: upasthāya mātaramannamaiṭṭa tigmamapaśyadabhi somamūdhaḥ prayāvayannacarad gṛtso anyān mahāni cakre purudhapratīkaḥ
verses.en: Desiring food he came unto his Mother, and on her breast beheld the pungent Soma. Wise, he moved on, keeping aloof the others, and wrought great exploits in his varied aspects.

verses.sa:
उग्रस्तुराषाळभिभूत्योजा यथावशं तन्वं चक्र एषः ।
त्वष्टारमिन्द्रो जनुषाभिभूयाऽऽमुष्या सोममपिबच्चमूषु॥
verses.tr: ugrasturāṣāḻabhibhūtyojā yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ cakra eṣaḥ tvaṣṭāramindro januṣābhibhūyā''muṣyā somamapibaccamūṣu
verses.en: Fierce, quickly conquering, of surpassing vigour, he framed his body even as he listed. E'en from his birth-time Indra conquered Tvastar, bore off the Soma and in beakers drank it.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन् भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
verses.en: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered; The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
शंसा महामिन्द्रं यस्मिन् विश्वा आ कृष्टयः सोमपाः काममव्यन् ।
यं सुक्रतुं धिषणे विभ्वतष्टं घनं वृत्राणां जनयन्त देवाः॥
verses.tr: śaṃsā mahāmindraṃ yasmin viśvā ā kṛṣṭayaḥ somapāḥ kāmamavyan yaṃ sukratuṃ dhiṣaṇe vibhvataṣṭaṃ ghanaṃ vṛtrāṇāṃ janayanta devāḥ
verses.en: Great Indra will I laud, in whom all people who drink the Soma have attained their longing; Whom, passing wise, Gods, Heaven and Earth, engendered, formed by a Master's hand, to crush the Vrtras.

verses.sa:
यं नु नकिः पृतनासु स्वराजं द्विता तरति नृतमं हरिष्ठाम् ।
इनतमः सत्वभिर्यो ह शूषैः पृथुज्रया अमिनादायुर्दस्योः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ nu nakiḥ pṛtanāsu svarājaṃ dvitā tarati nṛtamaṃ hariṣṭhām inatamaḥ satvabhiryo ha śūṣaiḥ pṛthujrayā aminādāyurdasyoḥ
verses.en: Whom, most heroic, borne by Tawny Coursers, verily none subdueth in the battle; Who, reaching far, most vigorous, hath shortened the Dasyu's life with Warriors bold of spirit.

verses.sa:
सहावा पृत्सु तरणिर्नार्वा व्यानशी रोदसी मेहनावान् ।
भगो न कारे हव्यो मतीनां पितेव चारुः सुहवो वयोधाः॥
verses.tr: sahāvā pṛtsu taraṇirnārvā vyānaśī rodasī mehanāvān bhago na kāre havyo matīnāṃ piteva cāruḥ suhavo vayodhāḥ
verses.en: Victor in fight, swift mover like a warhorse, pervading both worlds, rainer down of blessings, To be invoked in war like Bhaga, Father, as 'twere, of hymns, fair, prompt to hear, strength-giver.

verses.sa:
धर्ता दिवो रजसस्पृष्ट ऊर्ध्वो रथो न वायुर्वसुभिर्नियुत्वान् ।
क्षपां वस्ता जनिता सूर्यस्य विभक्ता भागं धिषणेव वाजम्॥
verses.tr: dhartā divo rajasaspṛṣṭa ūrdhvo ratho na vāyurvasubhirniyutvān kṣapāṃ vastā janitā sūryasya vibhaktā bhāgaṃ dhiṣaṇeva vājam
verses.en: Supporting heaven, the high back of the region, his car is Vayu with his team of Vasus. Illumining the nights, the Sun's creator, like Dhisana he deals forth strength and riches.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन् भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
verses.en: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered; The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers treasure.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः स्वाहा पिबतु यस्य सोम आगत्या तुम्रो वृषभो मरुत्वान् ।
ओरुव्यचाः पृणतामेभिरन्नैरास्य हविस्तन्व१ः काममृध्याः॥
verses.tr: indraḥ svāhā pibatu yasya soma āgatyā tumro vṛṣabho marutvān oruvyacāḥ pṛṇatāmebhirannairāsya havistanva1ḥ kāmamṛdhyāḥ
verses.en: Let Indra drink, All-hail! for his is Soma,-the mighty Bull come, girt by Maruts, hither. Far-reaching, let him fill him with these viands, and let our offering sate his body's longing.

verses.sa:
आ ते सपर्यू जवसे युनज्मि ययोरनु प्रदिवः श्रुष्टिमावः ।
इह त्वा धेयुर्हरयः सुशिप्र पिबा त्व१स्य सुषुतस्य चारोः॥
verses.tr: ā te saparyū javase yunajmi yayoranu pradivaḥ śruṣṭimāvaḥ iha tvā dheyurharayaḥ suśipra pibā tva1sya suṣutasya cāroḥ
verses.en: I yoke thy pair of trusty Steeds for swiftness, whose faithful service from of old thou lovest. Here, fair of cheek! let thy Bay Coursers place thee: drink of this lovely welleffused libation.

verses.sa:
गोभिर्मिमिक्षुं दधिरे सुपारमिन्द्रं ज्यैष्ठ्याय धायसे गृणानाः ।
मन्दानः सोमं पपिवाँ ऋजीषिन् त्समस्मभ्यं पुरुधा गा इषण्य॥
verses.tr: gobhirmimikṣuṃ dadhire supāramindraṃ jyaiṣṭhyāya dhāyase gṛṇānāḥ mandānaḥ somaṃ papivāṃ ṛjīṣin tsamasmabhyaṃ purudhā gā iṣaṇya
verses.en: With milk they made Indra their good Preserver, lauding for help and rule the bounteous rainer. Impetuous God, when thou hast drunk the Soma, enraptured send us cattle in abundance.

verses.sa:
इमं कामं मन्दया गोभिरश्वैश्चन्द्रवता राधसा पप्रथश्च ।
स्वर्यवो मतिभिस्तुभ्यं विप्रा इन्द्राय वाहः कुशिकासो अक्रन्॥
verses.tr: imaṃ kāmaṃ mandayā gobhiraśvaiścandravatā rādhasā paprathaśca svaryavo matibhistubhyaṃ viprā indrāya vāhaḥ kuśikāso akran
verses.en: With kine and horses satisfy this longing with very splendid bounty still extend it. Seeking the light, with hymns to thee, O Indra, the Kusikas have brought their gift, the singers.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन् भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम्॥
verses.tr: śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasmin bhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām
verses.en: Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered; The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
चर्षणीधृतं मघवानमुक्थ्य१मिन्द्रं गिरो बृहतीरभ्यनूषत ।
वावृधानं पुरुहूतं सुवृक्तिभिरमर्त्यं जरमाणं दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: carṣaṇīdhṛtaṃ maghavānamukthya1mindraṃ giro bṛhatīrabhyanūṣata vāvṛdhānaṃ puruhūtaṃ suvṛktibhiramartyaṃ jaramāṇaṃ divedive
verses.en: High hymns have sounded forth the praise of Maghavan, supporter of mankind, of Indra meet for lauds; Him who hath waxen great, invoked with beauteous songs, Immortal One, whose praise each day is sung aloud.

verses.sa:
शतक्रतुमर्णवं शाकिनं नरं गिरो म इन्द्रमुप यन्ति विश्वतः ।
वाजसनिं पूर्भिदं तूर्णिमप्तुरं धामसाचमभिषाचं स्वर्विदम्॥
verses.tr: śatakratumarṇavaṃ śākinaṃ naraṃ giro ma indramupa yanti viśvataḥ vājasaniṃ pūrbhidaṃ tūrṇimapturaṃ dhāmasācamabhiṣācaṃ svarvidam
verses.en: To Indra from all sides go forth my songs of praise, the Lord of Hundred Powers, strong, Hero, like the sea, Swift, winner of the booty, breaker-down of forts, faithful and ever-glorious, finder of the light.

verses.sa:
आकरे वसोर्जरिता पनस्यतेऽनेहसः स्तुभ इन्द्रो दुवस्यति ।
विवस्वतः सदन आ हि पिप्रिये सत्रासाहमभिमातिहनं स्तुहि॥
verses.tr: ākare vasorjaritā panasyate'nehasaḥ stubha indro duvasyati vivasvataḥ sadana ā hi pipriye satrāsāhamabhimātihanaṃ stuhi
verses.en: Where battle's spoil is piled the singer winneth praise, for Indra taketh care of matchless worshippers. He in Vivasvan's dwelling findeth his delight: praise thou the ever-conquering slayer of the foe.

verses.sa:
नृणामु त्वा नृतमं गीर्भिरुक्थैरभि प्र वीरमर्चता सबाधः ।
सं सहसे पुरुमायो जिहीते नमो अस्य प्रदिव एक ईशे॥
verses.tr: nṛṇāmu tvā nṛtamaṃ gīrbhirukthairabhi pra vīramarcatā sabādhaḥ saṃ sahase purumāyo jihīte namo asya pradiva eka īśe
verses.en: Thee, valorous, most heroic of the heroes, shall the priests glorify with song and praises. Full of all wondrous power he goes to conquest: worship is his, sole Lord from days aforetime.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीरस्य निष्षिधो मर्त्येषु पुरू वसूनि पृथिवी बिभर्ति ।
इन्द्राय द्याव ओषधीरुतापो रयिं रक्षन्ति जीरयो वनानि॥
verses.tr: pūrvīrasya niṣṣidho martyeṣu purū vasūni pṛthivī bibharti indrāya dyāva oṣadhīrutāpo rayiṃ rakṣanti jīrayo vanāni
verses.en: Abundant are the gifts he gives to mortals: for him the earth bears a rich store of treasures. The heavens, the growing plants, the living waters, the forest trees preserve their wealth for Indra.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं ब्रह्माणि गिर इन्द्र तुभ्यं सत्रा दधिरे हरिवो जुषस्व ।
बोध्या३पिरवसो नूतनस्य सखे वसो जरितृभ्यो वयो धाः॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ brahmāṇi gira indra tubhyaṃ satrā dadhire harivo juṣasva bodhyā3piravaso nūtanasya sakhe vaso jaritṛbhyo vayo dhāḥ
verses.en: To thee, O Indra, Lord of Bays, for ever are offered prayers and songs: accept them gladly. As Kinsman think thou of some fresh assistance; good Friend, give strength and life to those who praise thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र मरुत्व इह पाहि सोमं यथा शार्याते अपिबः सुतस्य ।
तव प्रणीती तव शूर शर्मन्ना विवासन्ति कवयः सुयज्ञाः॥
verses.tr: indra marutva iha pāhi somaṃ yathā śāryāte apibaḥ sutasya tava praṇītī tava śūra śarmannā vivāsanti kavayaḥ suyajñāḥ
verses.en: Here, Indra, drink thou Soma with the Maruts, as thou didst drink the juice beside Saryata. Under thy guidance, in thy keeping, Hero, the singers serve, skilled in fair sacrifices.

verses.sa:
स वावशान इह पाहि सोमं मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सखिभिः सुतं नः ।
जातं यत्त्वा परि देवा अभूषन् महे भराय पुरुहूत विश्वे॥
verses.tr: sa vāvaśāna iha pāhi somaṃ marudbhirindra sakhibhiḥ sutaṃ naḥ jātaṃ yattvā pari devā abhūṣan mahe bharāya puruhūta viśve
verses.en: So eagerly desirous drink the Soma, our juice, O Indra, with thy friends the Maruts, Since at thy birth all Deities adorned thee for the great fight, O thou invoked of many.

verses.sa:
अप्तूर्ये मरुत आपिरेषोऽमन्दन्निन्द्रमनु दातिवाराः ।
तेभिः साकं पिबतु वृत्रखादः सुतं सोमं दाशुषः स्वे सधस्थे॥
verses.tr: aptūrye maruta āpireṣo'mandannindramanu dātivārāḥ tebhiḥ sākaṃ pibatu vṛtrakhādaḥ sutaṃ somaṃ dāśuṣaḥ sve sadhasthe
verses.en: He was your comrade in your zeal, O Maruts: they, rich in noble gifts, rejoiced in Indra. With them together let the Vrtra-slayer drink in his home the worshipper's libation.

verses.sa: इदं ह्यन्वोजसा सुतं राधानां पते । पिबा त्व१स्य गिर्वणः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ hyanvojasā sutaṃ rādhānāṃ pate pibā tva1sya girvaṇaḥ
verses.en: So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been pressed for thee with strength Drink of it, thou who lovest song.

verses.sa: यस्ते अनु स्वधामसत्सुते नि यच्छ तन्वम् । स त्वा ममत्तु सोम्यम्॥
verses.tr: yaste anu svadhāmasatsute ni yaccha tanvam sa tvā mamattu somyam
verses.en: Incline thy body to this juice which suits thy Godlike nature well: May it cheer thee who lovest it.

verses.sa: प्र ते अश्नोतु कुक्ष्योः प्रेन्द्र ब्रह्मणा शिरः । प्र बाहू शूर राधसे॥
verses.tr: pra te aśnotu kukṣyoḥ prendra brahmaṇā śiraḥ pra bāhū śūra rādhase
verses.en: Brave Indra, let it work through both thy flanks, and through thy head by prayer, And through thine arms, to prosper us.

verses.sa: धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम् । इन्द्र प्रातर्जुषस्व नः॥
verses.tr: dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam indra prātarjuṣasva naḥ
verses.en: Indra, accept at break of day our Soma mixt with roasted corn, With groats with cake, with eulogies.

verses.sa: पुरोळाशं पचत्यं जुषस्वेन्द्रा गुरस्व च । तुभ्यं हव्यानि सिस्रते॥
verses.tr: puroḻāśaṃ pacatyaṃ juṣasvendrā gurasva ca tubhyaṃ havyāni sisrate
verses.en: Accept, O Indra, and enjoy the well-dressed sacrificial cake: Oblations are poured forth to thee.

verses.sa: पुरोळाशं च नो घसो जोषयासे गिरश्च नः । वधूयुरिव योषणाम्॥
verses.tr: puroḻāśaṃ ca no ghaso joṣayāse giraśca naḥ vadhūyuriva yoṣaṇām
verses.en: Consume our sacrificial cake, accept the songs of praise we sing, As he who woes accepts his bride.

verses.sa: पुरोळाशं सनश्रुत प्रातःसावे जुषस्व नः । इन्द्र क्रतुर्हि ते बृहन्॥
verses.tr: puroḻāśaṃ sanaśruta prātaḥsāve juṣasva naḥ indra kraturhi te bṛhan
verses.en: Famed from of old, accept the cake at our libation poured at dawn, For great, O Indra, is thy power.

verses.sa:
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य धानाः पुरोळाशमिन्द्र कृष्वेह चारुम् ।
प्र यत् स्तोता जरिता तूर्ण्यर्थो वृषायमाण उप गीर्भिरीट्टे॥
verses.tr: mādhyaṃdinasya savanasya dhānāḥ puroḻāśamindra kṛṣveha cārum pra yat stotā jaritā tūrṇyartho vṛṣāyamāṇa upa gīrbhirīṭṭe
verses.en: Let roasted corn of our midday libation, and sacrificial cake here please thee, Indra, What time the lauding singer, keen of purpose and eager as a bull, with hymns implores thee.

verses.sa:
तृतीये धानाः सवने पुरुष्टुत पुरोळाशमाहुतं मामहस्व नः ।
ऋभुमन्तं वाजवन्तं त्वा कवे प्रयस्वन्त उप शिक्षेम धीतिभिः॥
verses.tr: tṛtīye dhānāḥ savane puruṣṭuta puroḻāśamāhutaṃ māmahasva naḥ ṛbhumantaṃ vājavantaṃ tvā kave prayasvanta upa śikṣema dhītibhiḥ
verses.en: At the third sacrifice, O thou whom many praise, give glory to the roasted corn and holy cake. With offered viands and with songs may we assist thee, Sage, whom Vaja and the Rbhus wait upon.

verses.sa:
पूषण्वते ते चकृमा करम्भं हरिवते हर्यश्वाय धानाः ।
अपूपमद्धि सगणो मरुद्भिः सोमं पिब वृत्रहा शूर विद्वान्॥
verses.tr: pūṣaṇvate te cakṛmā karambhaṃ harivate haryaśvāya dhānāḥ apūpamaddhi sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān
verses.en: The groats have we prepared for thee with Pusan, corn for thee, Lord of Bay Steeds, with thy horses. Eat thou the meal-cake, banded with the Maruts, wise Hero, Vrtra-slayer, drink the Soma.

verses.sa:
प्रति धाना भरत तूयमस्मै पुरोळाशं वीरतमाय नृणाम् ।
दिवेदिवे सदृशीरिन्द्र तुभ्यं वर्धन्तु त्वा सोमपेयाय धृष्णो॥
verses.tr: prati dhānā bharata tūyamasmai puroḻāśaṃ vīratamāya nṛṇām divedive sadṛśīrindra tubhyaṃ vardhantu tvā somapeyāya dhṛṣṇo
verses.en: Bring forth the roasted corn to meet him quickly, cake for the bravest Hero mid the heroes. Indra, may hymns accordant with thee daily strengthen thee, Bold One, for the draught of Soma.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रापर्वता बृहता रथेन वामीरिष आ वहतं सुवीराः ।
वीतं हव्यान्यध्वरेषु देवा वर्धेथां गीर्भिरिळया मदन्ता॥
verses.tr: indrāparvatā bṛhatā rathena vāmīriṣa ā vahataṃ suvīrāḥ vītaṃ havyānyadhvareṣu devā vardhethāṃ gīrbhiriḻayā madantā
verses.en: On a high car, O Parvata and Indra, bring pleasant viands, with brave heroes, hither. Enjoy the gifts, Gods, at our sacrifices wax strong by hymns, rejoice in our oblation.

verses.sa:
तिष्ठा सु कं मघवन् मा परा गाः सोमस्य नु त्वा सुषुतस्य यक्षि ।
पितुर्न पुत्रः सिचमा रभे त इन्द्र स्वादिष्ठया गिरा शचीवः॥
verses.tr: tiṣṭhā su kaṃ maghavan mā parā gāḥ somasya nu tvā suṣutasya yakṣi piturna putraḥ sicamā rabhe ta indra svādiṣṭhayā girā śacīvaḥ
verses.en: Stay still, O Maghavan, advance no farther. a draught of well-pressed Soma will I give thee. With sweetest song I grasp, O Mighty Indra, thy garment's hem as a child grasps his father's.

verses.sa:
शंसावाध्वर्यो प्रति मे गृणीहीन्द्राय वाहः कृणवाव जुष्टम् ।
एदं बर्हिर्यजमानस्य सीदाथा च भूदुक्थमिन्द्राय शस्तम्॥
verses.tr: śaṃsāvādhvaryo prati me gṛṇīhīndrāya vāhaḥ kṛṇavāva juṣṭam edaṃ barhiryajamānasya sīdāthā ca bhūdukthamindrāya śastam
verses.en: Adhvaryu, sing we both; sing thou in answer: make we a laud acceptable to Indra. Upon this sacrificer's grass he seated: to Indra shall our eulogy be uttered.

verses.sa:
जायेदस्तं मघवन् त्सेदु योनिस्तदित् त्वा युक्ता हरयो वहन्तु ।
यदा कदा च सुनवाम सोममग्निष्ट्वा दूतो धन्वात्यच्छ॥
verses.tr: jāyedastaṃ maghavan tsedu yonistadit tvā yuktā harayo vahantu yadā kadā ca sunavāma somamagniṣṭvā dūto dhanvātyaccha
verses.en: A wife, O Maghavan is home and dwelling: so let thy Bay Steeds yoked convey thee hither. Whenever we press out for thee the Soma, let Agni as our Herald speed to call thee.

verses.sa:
परा याहि मघवन्ना च याहीन्द्र भ्रातरुभयत्रा ते अर्थम् ।
यत्रा रथस्य बृहतो निधानं विमोचनं वाजिनो रासभस्य॥
verses.tr: parā yāhi maghavannā ca yāhīndra bhrātarubhayatrā te artham yatrā rathasya bṛhato nidhānaṃ vimocanaṃ vājino rāsabhasya
verses.en: Depart, O Maghavan; again come hither: both there and here thy goat is Indra, Brother, Where thy tall chariot hath a place to rest in, and where thou loosest thy loud-neighing Courser.

verses.sa:
अपाः सोममस्तमिन्द्र प्र याहि कल्याणीर्जाया सुरणं गृहे ते ।
यत्रा रथस्य बृहतो निधानं विमोचनं वाजिनो दक्षिणावत्॥
verses.tr: apāḥ somamastamindra pra yāhi kalyāṇīrjāyā suraṇaṃ gṛhe te yatrā rathasya bṛhato nidhānaṃ vimocanaṃ vājino dakṣiṇāvat
verses.en: Thou hast drunk Soma, Indra, turn thee homeward; thy joy is in thy home, thy gracious Consort; Where thy tall chariot hath a place to rest in, and thy strong Courser is set free with guerdon.

verses.sa:
इमे भोजा अङ्गिरसो विरूपा दिवस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीराः ।
विश्वामित्राय ददतो मघानि सहस्रसावे प्र तिरन्त आयुः॥
verses.tr: ime bhojā aṅgiraso virūpā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ viśvāmitrāya dadato maghāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ
verses.en: Bounteous are these, Angirases, Virupas: the Asura's Heroes and the Sons of Heaven. They, giving store of wealth to Visvamitra, prolong his life through countless Soma-pressings.

verses.sa:
रूपंरूपं मघवा बोभवीति मायाः कृण्वानस्तन्वं१ परि स्वाम् ।
त्रिर्यद् दिवः परि मुहूर्तमागात् स्वैर्मन्त्रैरनृतुपा ऋतावा॥
verses.tr: rūpaṃrūpaṃ maghavā bobhavīti māyāḥ kṛṇvānastanvaṃ1 pari svām triryad divaḥ pari muhūrtamāgāt svairmantrairanṛtupā ṛtāvā
verses.en: Maghavan weareth every shape at pleasure, effecting magic changes in his body, Holy One, drinker out of season, coming thrice, in a moment, through fit prayers, from heaven.

verses.sa:
महाँ ऋषिर्देवजा देवजूतोऽस्तभ्नात् सिन्धुमर्णवं नृचक्षाः ।
विश्वामित्रो यदवहत् सुदासमप्रियायत कुशिकेभिरिन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ ṛṣirdevajā devajūto'stabhnāt sindhumarṇavaṃ nṛcakṣāḥ viśvāmitro yadavahat sudāsamapriyāyata kuśikebhirindraḥ
verses.en: The mighty sage, God-born and God-incited, who looks on men, restrained the billowy river. When Visvamitra was Sudas's escort, then Indra through the Kusikas grew friendly.

verses.sa:
हंसा इव कृणुथ श्लोकमद्रिभिर्मदन्तो गीर्भिरध्वरे सुते सचा ।
देवेभिर्विप्रा ऋषयो नृचक्षसो वि पिबध्वं कुशिकाः सोम्यं मधु॥
verses.tr: haṃsā iva kṛṇutha ślokamadribhirmadanto gīrbhiradhvare sute sacā devebhirviprā ṛṣayo nṛcakṣaso vi pibadhvaṃ kuśikāḥ somyaṃ madhu
verses.en: Like swans, prepare a song of praise with pressing-stones, glad in your hymns with juice poured forth in sacrifice. Ye singers, with the Gods, sages who look on men, ye Kutikas drink up the Soma's savoury meath.

verses.sa:
उप प्रेत कुशिकाश्चेतयध्वमश्वं राये प्र मुञ्चता सुदासः ।
राजा वृत्रं जङ्घनत् प्रागपागुदगथा यजाते वर आ पृथिव्याः॥
verses.tr: upa preta kuśikāścetayadhvamaśvaṃ rāye pra muñcatā sudāsaḥ rājā vṛtraṃ jaṅghanat prāgapāgudagathā yajāte vara ā pṛthivyāḥ
verses.en: Come forward, Kusikas, and be attentive; let loose Sudas's horse to win him riches. East, west, and north, let the King slay the foeman, then at earth's choicest place perform his worship.

verses.sa:
य इमे रोदसी उभे अहमिन्द्रमतुष्टवम् ।
विश्वामित्रस्य रक्षति ब्रह्मेदं भारतं जनम्॥
verses.tr: ya ime rodasī ubhe ahamindramatuṣṭavam viśvāmitrasya rakṣati brahmedaṃ bhārataṃ janam
verses.en: Praises to Indra have I sung, sustainer of this earth and heaven. This prayer of Visvamitra keeps secure the race of Bharatas.

verses.sa: विश्वामित्रा अरासत ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे । करदिन्नः सुराधसः॥
verses.tr: viśvāmitrā arāsata brahmendrāya vajriṇe karadinnaḥ surādhasaḥ
verses.en: The Visvamitras have sung forth this prayer to Indra Thunder-aimed: So let him make us prosperous.

verses.sa:
किं ते कृण्वन्ति कीकटेषु गावो नाशिरं दुह्रे न तपन्ति घर्मम् ।
आ नो भर प्रमगन्दस्य वेदो नैचाशाखं मघवन् रन्धया नः॥
verses.tr: kiṃ te kṛṇvanti kīkaṭeṣu gāvo nāśiraṃ duhre na tapanti gharmam ā no bhara pramagandasya vedo naicāśākhaṃ maghavan randhayā naḥ
verses.en: Among the Kikatas what do thy cattle? They pour no milky draught, they heat no caldron. Bring thou to us the wealth of Pramaganda; give up to us, O Maghavan, the low-born.

verses.sa:
ससर्परीरमतिं बाधमाना बृहन्मिमाय जमदग्निदत्ता ।
आ सूर्यस्य दुहिता ततान श्रवो देवेष्वमृतमजुर्यम्॥
verses.tr: sasarparīramatiṃ bādhamānā bṛhanmimāya jamadagnidattā ā sūryasya duhitā tatāna śravo deveṣvamṛtamajuryam
verses.en: Sasarpari, the gift of Jamadagnis, hath lowed with mighty voice dispelling famine. The Daughter of the Sun hath spread our glory among the Gods, imperishable, deathless.

verses.sa:
ससर्परीरभरत् तूयमेभ्योऽधि श्रवः पाञ्चजन्यासु कृष्टिषु ।
सा पक्ष्या३ नव्यमायुर्दधाना यां मे पलस्तिजमदग्नयो ददुः॥
verses.tr: sasarparīrabharat tūyamebhyo'dhi śravaḥ pāñcajanyāsu kṛṣṭiṣu sā pakṣyā3 navyamāyurdadhānā yāṃ me palastijamadagnayo daduḥ
verses.en: Sasarpari brought glory speedily to these, over the generations of the Fivefold Race; Daughter of Paksa, she bestows new vital power, she whom the ancient Jamadagnis gave to me.

verses.sa:
स्थिरौ गावौ भवतां वीळुरक्षो मेषा वि वर्हि मा युगं वि शारि ।
इन्द्रः पातल्ये ददतां शरीतोररिष्टनेमे अभि नः सचस्व॥
verses.tr: sthirau gāvau bhavatāṃ vīḻurakṣo meṣā vi varhi mā yugaṃ vi śāri indraḥ pātalye dadatāṃ śarītorariṣṭaneme abhi naḥ sacasva
verses.en: Strong be the pair of oxen, firm the axles, let not the pole slip nor the yoke be broken. May Indra, keep the yoke-pins from decaying: attend us, thou whose fellies are uninjured.

verses.sa:
बलं धेहि तनूषु नो बलमिन्द्रानळुत्सु नः ।
बलं तोकाय तनयाय जीवसे त्वं हि बलदा असि॥
verses.tr: balaṃ dhehi tanūṣu no balamindrānaḻutsu naḥ balaṃ tokāya tanayāya jīvase tvaṃ hi baladā asi
verses.en: O Indra, give our bodies strength, strength to the bulls who draw the wains, Strength to our seed and progeny that they may live, for thou art he who giveth strength.

verses.sa:
अभि व्ययस्व खदिरस्य सारमोजो धेहि स्पन्दने शिंशपायाम् ।
अक्ष वीळो वीळित वीळयस्व मा यामादस्मादव जीहिपो नः॥
verses.tr: abhi vyayasva khadirasya sāramojo dhehi spandane śiṃśapāyām akṣa vīḻo vīḻita vīḻayasva mā yāmādasmādava jīhipo naḥ
verses.en: Enclose thee in the heart of Khayar timber, in the car wrought of Sinsapa put firmness. Show thyself strong, O Axle, fixed and strengthened: throw us not from the car whereon we travel.

verses.sa:
अयमस्मान् वनस्पतिर्मा च हा मा च रीरिषत् ।
स्वस्त्या गृहेभ्य आवसा आ विमोचनात्॥
verses.tr: ayamasmān vanaspatirmā ca hā mā ca rīriṣat svastyā gṛhebhya āvasā ā vimocanāt
verses.en: Let not this sovran of the wood leave us forlorn or injure us. Safe may we be until we reach our homes and rest us and unyoke.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रोतिभिर्बहुलाभिर्नो अद्य याच्छ्रेष्ठाभिर्मघवञ्छूर जिन्व ।
यो नो द्वेष्ट्यधरः सस्पदीष्ट यमु द्विष्मस्तमु प्राणो जहातु॥
verses.tr: indrotibhirbahulābhirno adya yācchreṣṭhābhirmaghavañchūra jinva yo no dveṣṭyadharaḥ saspadīṣṭa yamu dviṣmastamu prāṇo jahātu
verses.en: With various aids this day come to us, Indra, with best aids speed us, Maghavan, thou Hero. Let him who hateth us fall headlong downward: him whom we hate let vital breath abandon.

verses.sa:
परशुं चिद् वि तपति शिम्बलं चिद् वि वृश्चति ।
उखा चिदिन्द्र येषन्ती प्रयस्ता फेनमस्यति॥
verses.tr: paraśuṃ cid vi tapati śimbalaṃ cid vi vṛścati ukhā cidindra yeṣantī prayastā phenamasyati
verses.en: He heats his very axe, and then cuts a mere Semal blossom off. O Indra, like a caldron cracked and seething, so he pours out foam.

verses.sa:
न सायकस्य चिकिते जनासो लोधं नयन्ति पशु मन्यमानाः ।
नावाजिनं वाजिना हासयन्ति न गर्दभं पुरो अश्वान्नयन्ति॥
verses.tr: na sāyakasya cikite janāso lodhaṃ nayanti paśu manyamānāḥ nāvājinaṃ vājinā hāsayanti na gardabhaṃ puro aśvānnayanti
verses.en: Men notice not the arrow, O ye people; they bring the red beast deeming it a bullock. A sluggish steed men run not with the courser, nor ever lead an ass before a charger.

verses.sa:
इम इन्द्र भरतस्य पुत्रा अपपित्वं चिकितुर्न प्रपित्वम् ।
हिन्वन्त्यश्वमरणं न नित्यं ज्यावाजं परि णयन्त्याजौ॥
verses.tr: ima indra bharatasya putrā apapitvaṃ cikiturna prapitvam hinvantyaśvamaraṇaṃ na nityaṃ jyāvājaṃ pari ṇayantyājau
verses.en: These men, the sons of Bharata, O Indra, regard not severance or close connexion. They urge their own steed as it were another's, and take him, swift as the bow's string, to battle.

verses.sa:
इमं महे विदथ्याय शूषं शश्वत् कृत्व ईड्याय प्र जभ्रुः ।
शृणोतु नो दम्येभिरनीकैः शृणोत्वग्निर्दिव्यैरजस्रः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ mahe vidathyāya śūṣaṃ śaśvat kṛtva īḍyāya pra jabhruḥ śṛṇotu no damyebhiranīkaiḥ śṛṇotvagnirdivyairajasraḥ
verses.en: To him adorable, mighty, meet for synods, this strengthening hymn, unceasing, have they offered. May Agni hear us with his homely splendours, hear us, Eternal One, with heavenly lustre.

verses.sa:
महि महे दिवे अर्चा पृथिव्यै कामो म इच्छञ्चरति प्रजानन् ।
ययोर्ह स्तोमे विदथेषु देवाः सपर्यवो मादयन्ते सचायोः॥
verses.tr: mahi mahe dive arcā pṛthivyai kāmo ma icchañcarati prajānan yayorha stome vidatheṣu devāḥ saparyavo mādayante sacāyoḥ
verses.en: To mighty Heaven and Earth I sing forth loudly: my wish goes out desirous and well knowing Both, at whose laud in synods, showing favour, the Gods rejoice them with the living mortal.

verses.sa:
युवोर्ऋतं रोदसी सत्यमस्तु महे षु णः सुविताय प्र भूतम् ।
इदं दिवे नमो अग्ने पृथिव्यै सपर्यामि प्रयसा यामि रत्नम्॥
verses.tr: yuvorṛtaṃ rodasī satyamastu mahe ṣu ṇaḥ suvitāya pra bhūtam idaṃ dive namo agne pṛthivyai saparyāmi prayasā yāmi ratnam
verses.en: O Heaven and Earth, may your great law he faithful: he ye our leaders for our high advantage. To Heaven and Earth I offer this my homage, with food, O Agni, as I pray for riches.

verses.sa:
उतो हि वां पूर्व्या आविविद्र ऋतावरी रोदसी सत्यवाचः ।
नरश्चिद् वां समिथे शूरसातौ ववन्दिरे पृथिवि वेविदानाः॥
verses.tr: uto hi vāṃ pūrvyā āvividra ṛtāvarī rodasī satyavācaḥ naraścid vāṃ samithe śūrasātau vavandire pṛthivi vevidānāḥ
verses.en: Yea, holy Heaven and Earth, the ancient sages whose word was ever true had power to find you; And brave men in the fight where heroes conquer, O Earth, have known you well and paid you honour.

verses.sa:
को अद्धा वेद क इह प्र वोचद्देवाँ अच्छा पथ्या३ का समेति ।
ददृश्र एषामवमा सदांसि परेषु या गुह्येषु व्रतेषु॥
verses.tr: ko addhā veda ka iha pra vocaddevāṃ acchā pathyā3 kā sameti dadṛśra eṣāmavamā sadāṃsi pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu
verses.en: What pathway leadeth to the Gods? Who knoweth this of a truth, and who will now declare it? Seen are their lowest dwelling-places only, but they are in remote and secret regions.

verses.sa:
कविर्नृचक्षा अभि षीमचष्ट ऋतस्य योना विघृते मदन्ती ।
नाना चक्राते सदनं यथा वेः समानेन क्रतुना संविदाने॥
verses.tr: kavirnṛcakṣā abhi ṣīmacaṣṭa ṛtasya yonā vighṛte madantī nānā cakrāte sadanaṃ yathā veḥ samānena kratunā saṃvidāne
verses.en: The Sage who looketh on mankind hath viewed them bedewed, rejoicing in the seat of Order. They make a home as for a bird, though parted, with one same will finding themselves together.

verses.sa:
समान्या वियुते दूरेअन्ते ध्रुवे पदे तस्थतुर्जागरूके ।
उत स्वसारा युवती भवन्ती आदु ब्रुवाते मिथुनानि नाम॥
verses.tr: samānyā viyute dūreante dhruve pade tasthaturjāgarūke uta svasārā yuvatī bhavantī ādu bruvāte mithunāni nāma
verses.en: Partners though parted, with far-distant limits, on one firm place both stand for ever watchful, And, being young for evermore, as sisters, speak to each other names that are united.

verses.sa:
विश्वेदेते जनिमा सं विविक्तो महो देवान् बिभ्रती न व्यथेते ।
एजद् ध्रुवं पत्यते विश्वमेकं चरत् पतत्रि विषुणं वि जातम्॥
verses.tr: viśvedete janimā saṃ vivikto maho devān bibhratī na vyathete ejad dhruvaṃ patyate viśvamekaṃ carat patatri viṣuṇaṃ vi jātam
verses.en: All living things they part and keep asunder; though bearing up the mighty Gods they reel not. One All is Lord of what is fixed and moving, that walks, that flies, this multiform creation.

verses.sa:
सना पुराणमध्येम्यारान्महः पितुर्जनितुर्जामि तन्नः ।
देवासो यत्र पनितार एवैरुरौ पथि व्युते तस्थुरन्तः॥
verses.tr: sanā purāṇamadhyemyārānmahaḥ piturjaniturjāmi tannaḥ devāso yatra panitāra evairurau pathi vyute tasthurantaḥ
verses.en: Afar the Ancient from of old I ponder, our kinship with our mighty Sire and Father,- Singing the praise whereof the Gods by custom stand on the spacious far-extended pathway.

verses.sa:
इमं स्तोमं रोदसी प्र ब्रवीम्यृदूदराः शृणवन्नग्निजिह्वाः ।
मित्रः सम्राजो वरुणो युवान आदित्यासः कवयः पप्रथानाः॥
verses.tr: imaṃ stomaṃ rodasī pra bravīmyṛdūdarāḥ śṛṇavannagnijihvāḥ mitraḥ samrājo varuṇo yuvāna ādityāsaḥ kavayaḥ paprathānāḥ
verses.en: This laud, O Heaven and Earth, to you I utter: let the kind-hearted hear, whose tongue is Agni, Young, Sovran Rulers, Varuna and Mitra, the wise and very glorious Adityas.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यपाणिः सविता सुजिह्वस्त्रिरा दिवो विदथे पत्यमानः ।
देवेषु च सवितः श्लोकमश्रेरादस्मभ्यमा सुव सर्वतातिम्॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā sujihvastrirā divo vidathe patyamānaḥ deveṣu ca savitaḥ ślokamaśrerādasmabhyamā suva sarvatātim
verses.en: The fair-tongued Savitar, the golden-handed, comes thrice from heaven as Lord in our assembly. Bear to the Gods this song of praise, and send us, then, Savitar, complete and perfect safety.

verses.sa:
सुकृत् सुपाणिः स्ववाँ ऋतावा देवस्त्वष्टावसे तानि नो धात् ।
पूषण्वन्त ऋभवो मादयध्वमूर्ध्वग्रावाणो अध्वरमतष्ट॥
verses.tr: sukṛt supāṇiḥ svavāṃ ṛtāvā devastvaṣṭāvase tāni no dhāt pūṣaṇvanta ṛbhavo mādayadhvamūrdhvagrāvāṇo adhvaramataṣṭa
verses.en: Deft worker, skiful-handed, helpful, holy, may Tvastar, God, give us these things to aid us, Take your delight, Ye Rbhus joined with Pusan: ye have prepared the rite with stones adjusted.

verses.sa:
विद्युद्रथा मरुत ऋष्टिमन्तो दिवो मर्या ऋतजाता अयासः ।
सरस्वती शृणवन् यज्ञियासो धाता रयिं सहवीरं तुरासः॥
verses.tr: vidyudrathā maruta ṛṣṭimanto divo maryā ṛtajātā ayāsaḥ sarasvatī śṛṇavan yajñiyāso dhātā rayiṃ sahavīraṃ turāsaḥ
verses.en: Borne on their flashing car, the spear-armed Maruts, the nimble Youths of Heaven, the Sons of Order, The Holy, and Sarasvati, shall hear us: ye Mighty, give us wealth with noble offspring.

verses.sa:
विष्णुं स्तोमासः पुरुदस्ममर्का भगस्येव कारिणो यामनि ग्मन् ।
उरुक्रमः ककुहो यस्य पूर्वीर्न मर्धन्ति युवतयो जनित्रीः॥
verses.tr: viṣṇuṃ stomāsaḥ purudasmamarkā bhagasyeva kāriṇo yāmani gman urukramaḥ kakuho yasya pūrvīrna mardhanti yuvatayo janitrīḥ
verses.en: To Visnu rich in marvels, songs And praises shall go as singers on the road of Bhaga,- The Chieftain of the Mighty Stride, whose Mothers, the many young Dames, never disregard him.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो विश्वैर्वीर्यै३ः पत्यमान उभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा ।
पुरंदरो वृत्रहा धृष्णुषेणः संगृभ्या न आ भरा भूरि पश्वः॥
verses.tr: indro viśvairvīryai3ḥ patyamāna ubhe ā paprau rodasī mahitvā puraṃdaro vṛtrahā dhṛṣṇuṣeṇaḥ saṃgṛbhyā na ā bharā bhūri paśvaḥ
verses.en: Indra, who rules through all his powers heroic, hath with his majesty filled earth and heaven. Lord of brave hosts, Fort-crusher, Vrtra-slayer, gather thou up and bring us store of cattle.

verses.sa:
नासत्या मे पितरा बन्धुपृच्छा सजात्यमश्विनोश्चारु नाम ।
युवं हि स्थो रयिदौ नो रयीणां दात्रं रक्षेथे अकवैरदब्धा॥
verses.tr: nāsatyā me pitarā bandhupṛcchā sajātyamaśvinoścāru nāma yuvaṃ hi stho rayidau no rayīṇāṃ dātraṃ rakṣethe akavairadabdhā
verses.en: My Sires are the Nasatyas, kind tokensmen: the Asvins' kinship is a glorious title. For ye are they who give us store of riches: ye guard your gift uncheated by the bounteous.

verses.sa:
महत् तद् वः कवयश्चारु नाम यद्ध देवा भवथ विश्व इन्द्रे ।
सख ऋभुभिः पुरुहूत प्रियेभिरिमां धियं सातये तक्षता नः॥
verses.tr: mahat tad vaḥ kavayaścāru nāma yaddha devā bhavatha viśva indre sakha ṛbhubhiḥ puruhūta priyebhirimāṃ dhiyaṃ sātaye takṣatā naḥ
verses.en: This is, ye Wise, your great and glorious title, that all ye Deities abide in Indra. Friend, Much-invoked! art thou with thy dear Rbhus: fashion ye this our hymn for our advantage.

verses.sa:
अर्यमा णो अदितिर्यज्ञियासोऽदब्धानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि ।
युयोत नो अनपत्यानि गन्तोः प्रजावान् नः पशुमाँ अस्तु गातुः॥
verses.tr: aryamā ṇo aditiryajñiyāso'dabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni yuyota no anapatyāni gantoḥ prajāvān naḥ paśumāṃ astu gātuḥ
verses.en: Aryaman, Aditi deserve our worship: the laws of Varuna remain unbroken. The lot of childlessness remove ye from us, and let our course be rich in kine and offspring.

verses.sa:
देवानां दूतः पुरुध प्रसूतोऽनागान् नो वोचतु सर्वताता ।
शृणोतु नः पृथिवी द्यौरुतापः सूर्यो नक्षत्रैरुर्व१न्तरिक्षम्॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ dūtaḥ purudha prasūto'nāgān no vocatu sarvatātā śṛṇotu naḥ pṛthivī dyaurutāpaḥ sūryo nakṣatrairurva1ntarikṣam
verses.en: May the Gods' envoy, sent to many a quarter, proclaim us sinless for our perfect safety. May Earth and Heaven, the Sun, the waters, hear us, and the wide firmament and constellations.

verses.sa:
शृण्वन्तु नो वृषणः पर्वतासो ध्रुवक्षेमास इळया मदन्तः ।
आदित्यैर्नो अदितिः शृणोतु यच्छन्तु नो मरुतः शर्म भद्रम्॥
verses.tr: śṛṇvantu no vṛṣaṇaḥ parvatāso dhruvakṣemāsa iḻayā madantaḥ ādityairno aditiḥ śṛṇotu yacchantu no marutaḥ śarma bhadram
verses.en: Hear us the mountains which distil the rain-drops, and, resting firm, rejoice in freshening moisture. May Aditi with the Adityas hear us, and Maruts grant us their auspicious shelter.

verses.sa:
सदा सुगः पितुमाँ अस्तु पन्था मध्वा देवा ओषधीः सं पिपृक्त ।
भगो मे अग्ने सख्ये न मृध्या उद् रायो अश्यां सदनं पुरुक्षोः॥
verses.tr: sadā sugaḥ pitumāṃ astu panthā madhvā devā oṣadhīḥ saṃ pipṛkta bhago me agne sakhye na mṛdhyā ud rāyo aśyāṃ sadanaṃ purukṣoḥ
verses.en: Soft be our path for ever, well-provisioned: with pleasant meath, O Gods, the herbs besprinkle. Safe be my bliss, O Agni, in thy friendship: may I attain the seat of foodful riches,

verses.sa:
स्वदस्व हव्या समिषो दिदीह्यस्मद्र्य१क् सं मिमीहि श्रवांसि ।
विश्वाँ अग्ने पृत्सु ताञ्जेषि शत्रूनहा विश्वा सुमना दीदिही नः॥
verses.tr: svadasva havyā samiṣo didīhyasmadrya1k saṃ mimīhi śravāṃsi viśvāṃ agne pṛtsu tāñjeṣi śatrūnahā viśvā sumanā dīdihī naḥ
verses.en: Enjoy the offering: beam thou strength upon us; combine thou for our good all kinds of glory. Conquer in battle, Agni, all those foemen, and light us every day with loving kindness.

verses.sa:
उषसः पूर्वा अध यद् व्यूषुर्महद् वि जज्ञे अक्षरं पदे गोः ।
व्रता देवानामुप नु प्रभूषन् महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: uṣasaḥ pūrvā adha yad vyūṣurmahad vi jajñe akṣaraṃ pade goḥ vratā devānāmupa nu prabhūṣan mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: At the first shining of the earliest Mornings, in the Cow's home was born the Great Eternal. Now shall the statutes of the Gods be valid. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion -

verses.sa:
मो षू णो अत्र जुहुरन्त देवा मा पूर्वे अग्ने पितरः पदज्ञाः ।
पुराण्योः सद्मनोः केतुरन्तर्महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: mo ṣū ṇo atra juhuranta devā mā pūrve agne pitaraḥ padajñāḥ purāṇyoḥ sadmanoḥ keturantarmahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Let not the Gods here injure us, O Agni, nor Fathers of old time who know the region, Nor the sign set between two ancient dwellings. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
वि मे पुरुत्रा पतयन्ति कामाः शम्यच्छा दीद्ये पूर्व्याणि ।
समिद्धे अग्नावृतमिद् वदेम महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: vi me purutrā patayanti kāmāḥ śamyacchā dīdye pūrvyāṇi samiddhe agnāvṛtamid vadema mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: My wishes fly abroad to many places: I glance back to the ancient sacrifices. Let us declare the truth when fire is kindled. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
समानो राजा विभृतः पुरुत्रा शये शयासु प्रयुतो वनानु ।
अन्या वत्सं भरति क्षेति माता महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: samāno rājā vibhṛtaḥ purutrā śaye śayāsu prayuto vanānu anyā vatsaṃ bharati kṣeti mātā mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: King Universal, born to sundry quarters, extended through the wood be lies on couches. One Mother rests: another feeds the Infant. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
आक्षित् पूर्वास्वपरा अनूरुत् सद्यो जातासु तरुणीष्वन्तः ।
अन्तर्वतीः सुवते अप्रवीता महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: ākṣit pūrvāsvaparā anūrut sadyo jātāsu taruṇīṣvantaḥ antarvatīḥ suvate apravītā mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Lodged in old plants, he grows again in younger, swiftly within the newly-born and tender. Though they are unimpregned, he makes them fruitful. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
शयुः परस्तादध नु द्विमाता ऽबन्धनश्चरति वत्स एकः ।
मित्रस्य ता वरुणस्य व्रतानि महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: śayuḥ parastādadha nu dvimātā 'bandhanaścarati vatsa ekaḥ mitrasya tā varuṇasya vratāni mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Now lying far away, Child of two Mothers, he wanders unrestrained, the single youngling. These are the laws of Varuna and Mitra. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
द्विमाता होता विदथेषु सम्राळन्वग्रं चरति क्षेति बुध्नः ।
प्र रण्यानि रण्यवाचो भरन्ते महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: dvimātā hotā vidatheṣu samrāḻanvagraṃ carati kṣeti budhnaḥ pra raṇyāni raṇyavāco bharante mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Child of two Mothers, Priest, sole Lord in synods, he still precedes while resting as foundation. They who speak sweetly bring him sweet addresses. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
शूरस्येव युध्यतो अन्तमस्य प्रतीचीनं ददृशे विश्वमायत् ।
अन्तर्मतिश्चरति निष्षिधं गोर्महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: śūrasyeva yudhyato antamasya pratīcīnaṃ dadṛśe viśvamāyat antarmatiścarati niṣṣidhaṃ gormahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: As to a friendly warrior when he battles, each thing that comes anear is seen to meet him. The hymn commingles with the cow's oblation. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
नि वेवेति पलितो दूत आस्वन्तर्महांश्चरति रोचनेन ।
वपूंषि बिभ्रदभि नो वि चष्टे महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: ni veveti palito dūta āsvantarmahāṃścarati rocanena vapūṃṣi bibhradabhi no vi caṣṭe mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Deep within these the hoary envoy pierceth; mighty, he goeth to the realm of splendour, And looketh on us, clad in wondrous beauty. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
विष्णुर्गोपाः परमं पाति पाथः प्रिया धामान्यमृता दधानः ।
अग्निष्टा विश्वा भुवनानि वेद महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: viṣṇurgopāḥ paramaṃ pāti pāthaḥ priyā dhāmānyamṛtā dadhānaḥ agniṣṭā viśvā bhuvanāni veda mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Visnu, the guardian, keeps the loftiest station, upholding dear, immortal dwelling-places. Agni knows well all these created beings. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
नाना चक्राते यम्या३वपूंषि तयोरन्यद् रोचते कृष्णमन्यत् ।
श्यावी च यदरुषी च स्वसारौ महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: nānā cakrāte yamyā3vapūṃṣi tayoranyad rocate kṛṣṇamanyat śyāvī ca yadaruṣī ca svasārau mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Ye, variant Pair, have made yourselves twin beauties: one of the Twain is dark, bright shines the other; And yet these two, the dark, the red, are Sisters. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
माता च यत्र दुहिता च धेनू सबर्दुघे धापयेते समीची ।
ऋतस्य ते सदसीळे अन्तर्महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: mātā ca yatra duhitā ca dhenū sabardughe dhāpayete samīcī ṛtasya te sadasīḻe antarmahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Where the two Cows, the Mother and the Daughter, meet and give suck yielding their lordly nectar, I praise them at the seat of law eternal. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
अन्यस्या वत्सं रिहती मिमाय कया भुवा नि दधे धेनुरूधः ।
ऋतस्य सा पयसापिन्वतेळा महद्देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: anyasyā vatsaṃ rihatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenurūdhaḥ ṛtasya sā payasāpinvateḻā mahaddevānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Loud hath she lowed, licking the other's youngling. On what world hath the Milch-cow laid her udder? This Ila streameth with the milk of Order. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
पद्या वस्ते पुरुरूपा वपूंष्यूर्ध्वा तस्थौ त्र्यविं रेरिहाणा ।
ऋतस्य सद्म वि चरामि विद्वान् महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: padyā vaste pururūpā vapūṃṣyūrdhvā tasthau tryaviṃ rerihāṇā ṛtasya sadma vi carāmi vidvān mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Earth weareth beauties manifold: uplifted, licking her Calf of eighteen months, she standeth. Well-skilled I seek the seat of law eternal. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
पदे इव निहिते दस्मे अन्तस्तयोरन्यद् गुह्यमाविरन्यत् ।
सध्रीचीना पथ्या३ सा विषूची महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: pade iva nihite dasme antastayoranyad guhyamāviranyat sadhrīcīnā pathyā3 sā viṣūcī mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Within a wondrous place the Twain are treasured: the one is manifest, the other hidden. One common pathway leads in two directions. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
आ धेनवो धुनयन्तामशिश्वीः सबर्दुघाः शशया अप्रदुग्धाः ।
नव्यानव्या युवतयो भवन्तीर्महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: ā dhenavo dhunayantāmaśiśvīḥ sabardughāḥ śaśayā apradugdhāḥ navyānavyā yuvatayo bhavantīrmahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Let the milch-kine that have no calves storm downward, yielding rich nectar, streaming, unexhausted, These who are ever new and fresh and youthful. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
यदन्यासु वृषभो रोरवीति सो अन्यस्मिन् यूथे नि दधाति रेतः ।
स हि क्षपावान् त्स भगः स राजा महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: yadanyāsu vṛṣabho roravīti so anyasmin yūthe ni dadhāti retaḥ sa hi kṣapāvān tsa bhagaḥ sa rājā mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: What time the Bull bellows in other regions, another herd receives the genial moisture; For he is Bhaga, King, the earth's Protector. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
वीरस्य नु स्वश्व्यं जनासः प्र नु वोचाम विदुरस्य देवाः ।
षोळहा युक्ताः पञ्चपञ्चा वहन्ति महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: vīrasya nu svaśvyaṃ janāsaḥ pra nu vocāma vidurasya devāḥ ṣoḻahā yuktāḥ pañcapañcā vahanti mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Let us declare the Hero's wealth in horses, O all ye folk: of this the Gods have knowledge. Sixfold they bear him, or by fives are harnessed. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
देवस्त्वष्टा सविता विश्वरूपः पुपोष प्रजाः पुरुधा जजान ।
इमा च विश्वा भुवनान्यस्य महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: devastvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ pupoṣa prajāḥ purudhā jajāna imā ca viśvā bhuvanānyasya mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Tvastar the God, the omniform. Creator, begets and feeds mankind in various manner. His, verily, arc all these living creatures. Great is the Gods' supreme dominion.

verses.sa:
मही समैरच्चम्वा समीची उभे ते अस्य वसुना न्यृष्टे ।
शृण्वे वीरो विन्दमानो वसूनि महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: mahī samairaccamvā samīcī ubhe te asya vasunā nyṛṣṭe śṛṇve vīro vindamāno vasūni mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: The two great meeting Bowls hath he united: each of the Pair is laden with his treasure. The Hero is renowned for gathering riches. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
इमां च नः पृथिवीं विश्वधाया उप क्षेति हितमित्रो न राजा ।
पुरःसदः शर्मसदो न वीरा महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: imāṃ ca naḥ pṛthivīṃ viśvadhāyā upa kṣeti hitamitro na rājā puraḥsadaḥ śarmasado na vīrā mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Yea, and on this our earth the All-Sustainer dwells like a King with noble friends about him. In his protection heroes rest in safety. Great is the Cods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
निष्षिध्वरीस्त ओषधीरुतापो रयिं त इन्द्र पृथिवी बिभर्ति ।
सखायस्ते वामभाजः स्याम महद् देवानामसुरत्वमेकम्॥
verses.tr: niṣṣidhvarīsta oṣadhīrutāpo rayiṃ ta indra pṛthivī bibharti sakhāyaste vāmabhājaḥ syāma mahad devānāmasuratvamekam
verses.en: Rich in their gifts for thee are herbs and waters, and earth brings all her wealth for thee, O Indra. May we as friends of thine share goodly treasures. Great is the Gods' supreme and sole dominion.

verses.sa:
न ता मिनन्ति मायिनो न धीरा व्रता देवानां प्रथमा ध्रुवाणि ।
न रोदसी अद्रुहा वेद्याभिर्न पर्वता निनमे तस्थिवांसः॥
verses.tr: na tā minanti māyino na dhīrā vratā devānāṃ prathamā dhruvāṇi na rodasī adruhā vedyābhirna parvatā niname tasthivāṃsaḥ
verses.en: Not men of magic skill, not men of wisdom impair the Gods' first steadfast ordinances. Ne'er may the earth and heaven which know not malice, nor the fixed hills, be bowed by sage devices.

verses.sa:
षड् भाराँ एको अचरन् बिभर्त्यृतं वर्षिष्ठमुप गाव आगुः ।
तिस्रो महीरुपरास्तस्थुरत्या गुहा द्वे निहिते दर्श्येका॥
verses.tr: ṣaḍ bhārāṃ eko acaran bibhartyṛtaṃ varṣiṣṭhamupa gāva āguḥ tisro mahīruparāstasthuratyā guhā dve nihite darśyekā
verses.en: One, moving not away, supports six burthens: the Cows proceed to him the true, the Highest. Near stand three Mighty Ones who travel swiftly: two are concealed from sight, one is apparent.

verses.sa:
त्रिपाजस्यो वृषभो विश्वरूप उत त्र्युधा पुरुध प्रजावान् ।
त्र्यनीकः पत्यते माहिनावान् त्स रेतोधा वृषभः शश्वतीनाम्॥
verses.tr: tripājasyo vṛṣabho viśvarūpa uta tryudhā purudha prajāvān tryanīkaḥ patyate māhināvān tsa retodhā vṛṣabhaḥ śaśvatīnām
verses.en: The Bull who wears all shapes, the triple-breasted, three-uddered, with a brood in many places, Ruleth majestic with his triple aspect, the Bull, the Everlasting Ones' impregner.

verses.sa:
अभीक आसां पदवीरबोध्यादित्यानामह्वे चारु नाम ।
आपश्चिदस्मा अरमन्त देवीः पृथग् व्रजन्तीः परि षीमवृञ्जन्॥
verses.tr: abhīka āsāṃ padavīrabodhyādityānāmahve cāru nāma āpaścidasmā aramanta devīḥ pṛthag vrajantīḥ pari ṣīmavṛñjan
verses.en: When nigh them, as their tracer he observed them: he called aloud the dear name of Adityas. The Goddesses, the Waters, stayed to meet him: they who were wandering separate enclosed him.

verses.sa:
त्री षधस्था सिन्धवस्त्रिः कवीनामुत त्रिमाता विदथेषु सम्राट् ।
ऋतावरीर्योषणास्तिस्रो अप्यास्त्रिरा दिवो विदथे पत्यमानाः॥
verses.tr: trī ṣadhasthā sindhavastriḥ kavīnāmuta trimātā vidatheṣu samrāṭ ṛtāvarīryoṣaṇāstisro apyāstrirā divo vidathe patyamānāḥ
verses.en: Streams! the wise Gods have thrice three habitations. Child of three Mothers, he is Lord in synods. Three are the holy Ladies of the Waters, thrice here from heaven supreme in our assembly.

verses.sa:
त्रिरा दिवः सवितर्वार्याणि दिवेदिव आ सुव त्रिर्नो अह्नः ।
त्रिधातु राय आ सुवा वसूनि भग त्रातर्धिषणे सातये धाः॥
verses.tr: trirā divaḥ savitarvāryāṇi divediva ā suva trirno ahnaḥ tridhātu rāya ā suvā vasūni bhaga trātardhiṣaṇe sātaye dhāḥ
verses.en: Do thou, O Savitar, from heaven thrice hither, three times a day, send down thy blessings daily. Send us, O Bhaga, triple wealth and treasure; cause the two worlds to prosper us, Preserver!

verses.sa:
त्रिरा दिवः सविता सोषवीति राजाना मित्रावरुणा सुपाणी ।
आपश्चिदस्य रोदसी चिदुर्वी रत्नं भिक्षन्त सवितुः सवाय॥
verses.tr: trirā divaḥ savitā soṣavīti rājānā mitrāvaruṇā supāṇī āpaścidasya rodasī cidurvī ratnaṃ bhikṣanta savituḥ savāya
verses.en: Savitar thrice from heaven pours down abundance, and the fair-handed Kings Varuna, Mitra; And spacious Heaven and Earth, yea, and the Waters, solicit wealth that Savitar may send us.

verses.sa:
त्रिरुत्तमा दूणशा रोचनानि त्रयो राजन्त्यसुरस्य वीराः ।
ऋतावान इषिरा दूळभासस्त्रिरा दिवो विदथे सन्तु देवाः॥
verses.tr: triruttamā dūṇaśā rocanāni trayo rājantyasurasya vīrāḥ ṛtāvāna iṣirā dūḻabhāsastrirā divo vidathe santu devāḥ
verses.en: Three are the bright realms, best, beyond attainment, and three, the Asura's Heroes, rule as Sovrans, Holy and vigorous, never to be injured. Thrice may the Gods from heaven attend our synod.

verses.sa:
प्र मे विविक्वाँ अविदन्मनीषां धेनुं चरन्तीं प्रयुतामगोपाम् ।
सद्यश्चिद् या दुदुहे भूरि धासेरिन्द्रस्तदग्निः पनितारो अस्याः॥
verses.tr: pra me vivikvāṃ avidanmanīṣāṃ dhenuṃ carantīṃ prayutāmagopām sadyaścid yā duduhe bhūri dhāserindrastadagniḥ panitāro asyāḥ
verses.en: My thought with fine discernment hath discovered the Cow who wanders free without a herdsman, Her who hath straightway poured me food in plenty: Indra and Agni therefore are her praisers.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सु पूषा वृषणा सुहस्ता दिवो न प्रीताः शशयं दुदुह्रे ।
विश्वे यदस्यां रणयन्त देवाः प्र वोऽत्र वसवः सुम्नमश्याम्॥
verses.tr: indraḥ su pūṣā vṛṣaṇā suhastā divo na prītāḥ śaśayaṃ duduhre viśve yadasyāṃ raṇayanta devāḥ pra vo'tra vasavaḥ sumnamaśyām
verses.en: Indra and Pusan, deft of hand and mighty, well-pleased have drained the heaven's exhaustless udder. As in this praise the Gods have all delighted, may I win blessing here from you, O Vasus.

verses.sa:
या जामयो वृष्ण इच्छन्ति शक्तिं नमस्यन्तीर्जानते गर्भमस्मिन् ।
अच्छा पुत्रं धेनवो वावशाना महश्चरन्ति बिभ्रतं वपूंषि॥
verses.tr: yā jāmayo vṛṣṇa icchanti śaktiṃ namasyantīrjānate garbhamasmin acchā putraṃ dhenavo vāvaśānā mahaścaranti bibhrataṃ vapūṃṣi
verses.en: Fain to lend vigour to the Bull, the sister with reverence recognize the germ within him. The Cows come lowing hither to the Youngling, to him endued with great and wondrous beauties.

verses.sa:
अच्छा विवक्मि रोदसी सुमेके ग्राव्णो युजानो अध्वरे मनीषा ।
इमा उ ते मनवे भूरिवारा ऊर्ध्वा भवन्ति दर्शता यजत्राः॥
verses.tr: acchā vivakmi rodasī sumeke grāvṇo yujāno adhvare manīṣā imā u te manave bhūrivārā ūrdhvā bhavanti darśatā yajatrāḥ
verses.en: Fixing with thought, at sacrifice, the press-stones, I bid the well-formed Heaven and Earth come hither; For these thy flames, which give men boons in plenty, rise up on high, the beautiful, the holy.

verses.sa:
या ते जिह्वा मधुमती सुमेधा अग्ने देवेषूच्यत उरूची ।
तयेह विश्वाँ अवसे यजत्राना सादय पायया चा मधूनि॥
verses.tr: yā te jihvā madhumatī sumedhā agne deveṣūcyata urūcī tayeha viśvāṃ avase yajatrānā sādaya pāyayā cā madhūni
verses.en: Agni, thy meath-sweet tongue that tastes fair viands, which among Gods is called the far-extended,- Therewith make all the Holy Odes be seated here for our help, and feed them with sweet juices.

verses.sa:
या ते अग्ने पर्वतस्येव धारासश्चन्ती पीपयद् देव चित्रा ।
तामस्मभ्यं प्रमतिं जातवेदो वसो रास्व सुमतिं विश्वजन्याम्॥
verses.tr: yā te agne parvatasyeva dhārāsaścantī pīpayad deva citrā tāmasmabhyaṃ pramatiṃ jātavedo vaso rāsva sumatiṃ viśvajanyām
verses.en: Let thy stream give us drink, O God, O Agni, wonderful and exhaustless like the rain-clouds. Thus care for us, O Vasu Jatavedas, show us thy loving-kindness, reaching all men.

verses.sa:
धेनुः प्रत्नस्य काम्यं दुहाना ऽन्तः पुत्रश्चरति दक्षिणायाः ।
आ द्योतनिं वहति शुभ्रयामोषसः स्तोमो अश्विनावजीगः॥
verses.tr: dhenuḥ pratnasya kāmyaṃ duhānā 'ntaḥ putraścarati dakṣiṇāyāḥ ā dyotaniṃ vahati śubhrayāmoṣasaḥ stomo aśvināvajīgaḥ
verses.en: The Ancient's Milch-cow yields the things we long for: the Son of Daksina travels between them. She with the splendid chariot brings refulgence. The praise of Usas hath awoke the Asvins.

verses.sa:
सुयुग् वहन्ति प्रति वामृतेनोर्ध्वा भवन्ति पितरेव मेधाः ।
जरेथामस्मद् वि पणेर्मनीषां युवोरवश्चकृमा यातमर्वाक्॥
verses.tr: suyug vahanti prati vāmṛtenordhvā bhavanti pitareva medhāḥ jarethāmasmad vi paṇermanīṣāṃ yuvoravaścakṛmā yātamarvāk
verses.en: They bear you hither by well-ordered statute: our sacred offerings rise as if to parents. Destroy in us the counsel of the niggard come hitherward, for we have shown you favour.

verses.sa:
सुयुग्भिरश्वैः सुवृता रथेन दस्राविमं शृणुतं श्लोकमद्रेः ।
किमङ्ग वां प्रत्यवर्तिं गमिष्ठा ऽऽहुर्विप्रासो अश्विना पुराजाः॥
verses.tr: suyugbhiraśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathena dasrāvimaṃ śṛṇutaṃ ślokamadreḥ kimaṅga vāṃ pratyavartiṃ gamiṣṭhā ''hurviprāso aśvinā purājāḥ
verses.en: With lightly-rolling car and well-yoked horses hear this, the press-stone's song, ye Wonder-Workers. Have not the sages of old time, ye Asvins, called you most prompt to come and stay misfortune?

verses.sa:
आ मन्येथामा गतं कच्चिदेवैर्विश्वे जनासो अश्विना हवन्ते ।
इमा हि वां गोऋजीका मधूनि प्र मित्रासो न ददुरुस्रो अग्रे॥
verses.tr: ā manyethāmā gataṃ kaccidevairviśve janāso aśvinā havante imā hi vāṃ goṛjīkā madhūni pra mitrāso na dadurusro agre
verses.en: Remember us, and come to us, for ever men, as their wont is, invocate the Asvins. Friends as it were have offered you these juices, sweet, blent with milk at the first break of morning.

verses.sa:
तिरः पुरू चिदश्विना रजांस्याङ्गूषो वां मघवाना जनेषु ।
एह यातं पथिभिर्देवयानैर्दस्राविमे वां निधयो मधूनाम्॥
verses.tr: tiraḥ purū cidaśvinā rajāṃsyāṅgūṣo vāṃ maghavānā janeṣu eha yātaṃ pathibhirdevayānairdasrāvime vāṃ nidhayo madhūnām
verses.en: Even through many regions, O ye Asvins high praise is yours among mankind, ye Mighty- Come, helpers, on the paths which Gods have travelled: here your libations of sweet meath are ready.

verses.sa:
पुराणमोकः सख्यं शिवं वां युवोर्नरा द्रविणं जह्नाव्याम् ।
पुनः कृण्वानाः सख्या शिवानि मध्वा मदेम सह नू समानाः॥
verses.tr: purāṇamokaḥ sakhyaṃ śivaṃ vāṃ yuvornarā draviṇaṃ jahnāvyām punaḥ kṛṇvānāḥ sakhyā śivāni madhvā madema saha nū samānāḥ
verses.en: Ancient your home, auspicious is your friendship: Heroes, your wealth is with the house of Jahnu. Forming again with you auspicious friendship, let us rejoice with draughts of meath together.

verses.sa:
अश्विना वायुना युवं सुदक्षा नियुद्भिश्च सजोषसा युवाना ।
नासत्या तिरोअह्न्यं जुषाणा सोमं पिबतमस्रिधा सुदानू॥
verses.tr: aśvinā vāyunā yuvaṃ sudakṣā niyudbhiśca sajoṣasā yuvānā nāsatyā tiroahnyaṃ juṣāṇā somaṃ pibatamasridhā sudānū
verses.en: O Asvins, Very Mighty ones, with Vayu and with his steeds, one-minded, ever-youthful, Nasatyas, joying in the third day's Soma, drink it, not hostile, Very Bounteous Givers.

verses.sa:
अश्विना परि वामिषः पुरूचीरीयुर्गीर्भिर्यतमाना अमृध्राः ।
रथो ह वामृतजा अद्रिजूतः परि द्यावापृथिवी याति सद्यः॥
verses.tr: aśvinā pari vāmiṣaḥ purūcīrīyurgīrbhiryatamānā amṛdhrāḥ ratho ha vāmṛtajā adrijūtaḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yāti sadyaḥ
verses.en: Asvins, to you are brought abundant viands in rivalry with sacred songs, unceasing. Sprung from high Law your car, urged on by press-stones, goes round the earth and heaven in one brief moment.

verses.sa:
अश्विना मधुषुत्तमो युवाकुः सोमस्तं पातमा गतं दुरोणे ।
रथो ह वां भूरि वर्पः करिक्रत् सुतावतो निष्कृतमागमिष्ठः॥
verses.tr: aśvinā madhuṣuttamo yuvākuḥ somastaṃ pātamā gataṃ duroṇe ratho ha vāṃ bhūri varpaḥ karikrat sutāvato niṣkṛtamāgamiṣṭhaḥ
verses.en: Asvins, your Soma sheds delicious sweetness: drink ye thereof and come unto our dwelling. Your car, assuming many a shape, most often goes to the Soma-presser's place of meeting.

verses.sa:
मित्रो जनान् यातयति ब्रुवाणो मित्रो दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ।
मित्रः कृष्टीरनिमिषाभि चष्टे मित्राय हव्यं घृतवज्जुहोत॥
verses.tr: mitro janān yātayati bruvāṇo mitro dādhāra pṛthivīmuta dyām mitraḥ kṛṣṭīranimiṣābhi caṣṭe mitrāya havyaṃ ghṛtavajjuhota
verses.en: Mitra, when speaking, stirreth men to labour: Mitra sustaineth both the earth and heaven. Mitra beholdeth men with eyes that close not. To Mitra bring, with holy oil, oblation.

verses.sa:
प्र स मित्र मर्तो अस्तु प्रयस्वान् यस्त आदित्य शिक्षति व्रतेन ।
न हन्यते न जीयते त्वोतो नैनमंहो अश्नोत्यन्तितो न दूरात्॥
verses.tr: pra sa mitra marto astu prayasvān yasta āditya śikṣati vratena na hanyate na jīyate tvoto nainamaṃho aśnotyantito na dūrāt
verses.en: Foremost be he who brings thee food, O Mitra, who strives to keep thy sacred Law, Aditya. He whom thou helpest ne'er is slain or conquered, on him, from near or far, falls no affliction.

verses.sa:
अनमीवास इळया मदन्तो मितज्ञवो वरिमन्ना पृथिव्याः ।
आदित्यस्य व्रतमुपक्षियन्तो वयं मित्रस्य सुमतौ स्याम॥
verses.tr: anamīvāsa iḻayā madanto mitajñavo varimannā pṛthivyāḥ ādityasya vratamupakṣiyanto vayaṃ mitrasya sumatau syāma
verses.en: joying in sacred food and free from sickness, with knees bent lowly on the earth's broad surface, Following closely the Aditya's statute, may we remain in Mitra's gracious favour.

verses.sa:
अयं मित्रो नमस्यः सुशेवो राजा सुक्षत्रो अजनिष्ट वेधाः ।
तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्याऽपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ mitro namasyaḥ suśevo rājā sukṣatro ajaniṣṭa vedhāḥ tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyā'pi bhadre saumanase syāma
verses.en: Auspicious and adorable, this Mitra was born with fair dominion, King, Disposer. May we enjoy the grace of him the Holy, yea, rest in his propitious loving-kindness.

verses.sa:
महाँ आदित्यो नमसोपसद्यो यातयज्जनो गृणते सुशेवः ।
तस्मा एतत्पन्यतमाय जुष्टमग्नौ मित्राय हविरा जुहोत॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ ādityo namasopasadyo yātayajjano gṛṇate suśevaḥ tasmā etatpanyatamāya juṣṭamagnau mitrāya havirā juhota
verses.en: The great Aditya, to be served with worship, who stirreth men, is gracious to the singer. To Mitra, him most highly to be lauded, offer in fire oblation that he loveth.

verses.sa: मित्रस्य चर्षणीधृतोऽवो देवस्य सानसि । द्युम्नं चित्रश्रवस्तमम्॥
verses.tr: mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛto'vo devasya sānasi dyumnaṃ citraśravastamam
verses.en: The gainful grace of Mitra, God, supporter of the race of man, Gives splendour of most glorious fame.

verses.sa: अभि यो महिना दिवं मित्रो बभूव सप्रथाः । अभि श्रवोभिः पृथिवीम्॥
verses.tr: abhi yo mahinā divaṃ mitro babhūva saprathāḥ abhi śravobhiḥ pṛthivīm
verses.en: Mitra whose glory spreads afar, he who in might surpasses heaven, Surpasses earth in his renown.

verses.sa: मित्राय पञ्च येमिरे जना अभिष्टिशवसे । स देवान् विश्वान् बिभर्ति॥
verses.tr: mitrāya pañca yemire janā abhiṣṭiśavase sa devān viśvān bibharti
verses.en: All the Five Races have repaired to Mitra, ever strong to aid, For he sustaineth all the Gods.

verses.sa: मित्रो देवेष्वायुषु जनाय वृक्तबर्हिषे । इष इष्टव्रता अकः॥
verses.tr: mitro deveṣvāyuṣu janāya vṛktabarhiṣe iṣa iṣṭavratā akaḥ
verses.en: Mitra to Gods, to living men, to him who strews the holy grass, Gives food fulfilling sacred Law.

verses.sa:
इहेह वो मनसा बन्धुता नर उशिजो जग्मुरभि तानि वेदसा ।
याभिर्मायाभिः प्रतिजूतिवर्पसः सौधन्वना यज्ञियं भागमानश॥
verses.tr: iheha vo manasā bandhutā nara uśijo jagmurabhi tāni vedasā yābhirmāyābhiḥ pratijūtivarpasaḥ saudhanvanā yajñiyaṃ bhāgamānaśa
