verses.en: Here is your ghostly kinship, here, O Men: they came desirous to these holy rites with store of wealth, With wondrous arts, whereby, with schemes to meet each need, Ye gained, Sudhanvan's Sons! your share in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
याभिः शचीभिश्चमसाँ अपिंशत यया धिया गामरिणीत चर्मणः ।
येन हरी मनसा निरतक्षत तेन देवत्वमृभवः समानश॥
verses.tr: yābhiḥ śacībhiścamasāṃ apiṃśata yayā dhiyā gāmariṇīta carmaṇaḥ yena harī manasā niratakṣata tena devatvamṛbhavaḥ samānaśa
verses.en: The mighty powers wherewith. ye formed the chalices, the thought by which ye drew the cow from out the hide, The intellect wherewith ye wrought the two Bay Steeds,-through these, O Rbhus, ye attained divinity.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य सख्यमृभवः समानशुर्मनोर्नपातो अपसो दधन्विरे ।
सौधन्वनासो अमृतत्वमेरिरे विष्ट्वी शमीभिः सुकृतः सुकृत्यया॥
verses.tr: indrasya sakhyamṛbhavaḥ samānaśurmanornapāto apaso dadhanvire saudhanvanāso amṛtatvamerire viṣṭvī śamībhiḥ sukṛtaḥ sukṛtyayā
verses.en: Friendship with Indra have the Rbhus, fully gained: grandsons of Manu, they skilfully urged the work. Sudhanvan's Children won them everlasting life, serving with holy rites, pious with noble acts.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेण याथ सरथं सुते सचाँ अथो वशानां भवथा सह श्रिया ।
न वः प्रतिमै सुकृतानि वाघतः सौधन्वना ऋभवो वीर्याणि च॥
verses.tr: indreṇa yātha sarathaṃ sute sacāṃ atho vaśānāṃ bhavathā saha śriyā na vaḥ pratimai sukṛtāni vāghataḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo vīryāṇi ca
verses.en: In company with Indra come ye to the juice, then gloriously shall your wishes be fulfilled. Not to be paragoned, ye Priests, are your good deeds, nor your heroic acts, Rbhus, Sudhanvan's Sons.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ऋभुभिर्वाजवद्भिः समुक्षितं सुतं सोममा वृषस्वा गभस्त्योः ।
धियेषितो मघवन् दाशुषो गृहे सौधन्वनेभिः सह मत्स्वा नृभिः॥
verses.tr: indra ṛbhubhirvājavadbhiḥ samukṣitaṃ sutaṃ somamā vṛṣasvā gabhastyoḥ dhiyeṣito maghavan dāśuṣo gṛhe saudhanvanebhiḥ saha matsvā nṛbhiḥ
verses.en: O Indra, with the Rbhus, Mighty Ones, pour down the Soma juice effused, well-blent, from both thy hands. Maghavan, urged by song, in the drink-offerer's house rejoice thee with the Heroes, with Sudhanvan's Sons.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ऋभुमान् वाजवान् मत्स्वेह नोऽस्मिन् त्सवने शच्या पुरुष्टुत ।
इमानि तुभ्यं स्वसराणि येमिरे व्रता देवानां मनुषश्च धर्मभिः॥
verses.tr: indra ṛbhumān vājavān matsveha no'smin tsavane śacyā puruṣṭuta imāni tubhyaṃ svasarāṇi yemire vratā devānāṃ manuṣaśca dharmabhiḥ
verses.en: With Rbhu near, and Vaja, Indra, here exult, with Saci, praised of many, in the juice we pour. These homes wherein we dwell have turned themselves to thee, devotions to the Gods, as laws of men ordain.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ऋभुभिर्वाजिभिर्वाजयन्निह स्तोमं जरितुरुप याहि यज्ञियम् ।
शतं केतेभिरिषिरेभिरायवे सहस्रणीथो अध्वरस्य होमनि॥
verses.tr: indra ṛbhubhirvājibhirvājayanniha stomaṃ jariturupa yāhi yajñiyam śataṃ ketebhiriṣirebhirāyave sahasraṇītho adhvarasya homani
verses.en: Come with the mighty Rbhus, Indra, come to us, strengthening with thy help the singer's holy praise; At hundred eager calls come to the living man, with thousand arts attend the act of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
उषो वाजेन वाजिनि प्रचेताः स्तोमं जुषस्व गृणतो मघोनि ।
पुराणी देवि युवतिः पुरंधिरनु व्रतं चरसि विश्ववारे॥
verses.tr: uṣo vājena vājini pracetāḥ stomaṃ juṣasva gṛṇato maghoni purāṇī devi yuvatiḥ puraṃdhiranu vrataṃ carasi viśvavāre
verses.en: O Usas, strong with strength, endowed with knowledge, accept the singer's praise, O wealthy Lady. Thou, Goddess, ancient, young, and full of wisdom, movest, all-bounteous! as the Law ordaineth.

verses.sa:
उषो देव्यमर्त्या वि भाहि चन्द्ररथा सूनृता ईरयन्ती ।
आ त्वा वहन्तु सुयमासो अश्वा हिरण्यवर्णां पृथुपाजसो ये॥
verses.tr: uṣo devyamartyā vi bhāhi candrarathā sūnṛtā īrayantī ā tvā vahantu suyamāso aśvā hiraṇyavarṇāṃ pṛthupājaso ye
verses.en: Shine forth, O Morning, thou auspicious Goddess, on thy bright car awaking pleasant voices. Let docile horses of far-reaching splendour convey thee hitherward, the golden coloured.

verses.sa:
उषः प्रतीची भुवनानि विश्वोर्ध्वा तिष्ठस्यमृतस्य केतुः ।
समानमर्थं चरणीयमाना चक्रमिव नव्यस्या ववृत्स्व॥
verses.tr: uṣaḥ pratīcī bhuvanāni viśvordhvā tiṣṭhasyamṛtasya ketuḥ samānamarthaṃ caraṇīyamānā cakramiva navyasyā vavṛtsva
verses.en: Thou, Morning, turning thee to every creature, standest on high as ensign of the Immortal, To one same goal ever and ever wending now, like a wheel, O newly-born, roll hither.

verses.sa:
अव स्यूमेव चिन्वती मघोन्युषा याति स्वसरस्य पत्नी ।
स्व१र्जनन्ती सुभगा सुदंसा आन्ताद् दिवः पप्रथ आ पृथिव्याः॥
verses.tr: ava syūmeva cinvatī maghonyuṣā yāti svasarasya patnī sva1rjanantī subhagā sudaṃsā āntād divaḥ papratha ā pṛthivyāḥ
verses.en: Letting her reins drop downward, Morning cometh, the wealthy Dame, the Lady of the dwelling; Bringing forth light, the Wonderful, the Blessed hath spread her from the bounds of earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
अच्छा वो देवीमुषसं विभातीं प्र वो भरध्वं नमसा सुवृक्तिम् ।
ऊर्ध्वं मधुधा दिवि पाजो अश्रेत् प्र रोचना रुरुचे रण्वसंदृक्॥
verses.tr: acchā vo devīmuṣasaṃ vibhātīṃ pra vo bharadhvaṃ namasā suvṛktim ūrdhvaṃ madhudhā divi pājo aśret pra rocanā ruruce raṇvasaṃdṛk
verses.en: Hither invoke the radiant Goddess Morning, and bring with reverence your hymn to praise her. She, dropping sweets, hath set in heaven her brightness, and, fair to look on, hath beamed forth her splendour.

verses.sa:
ऋतावरी दिवो अर्कैरबोध्या रेवती रोदसी चित्रमस्थात् ।
आयतीमग्न उषसं विभातीं वाममेषि द्रविणं भिक्षमाणः॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvarī divo arkairabodhyā revatī rodasī citramasthāt āyatīmagna uṣasaṃ vibhātīṃ vāmameṣi draviṇaṃ bhikṣamāṇaḥ
verses.en: From heaven, with hymns, the Holy One was wakened: brightly to both worlds came the wealthy Lady. To Morning, Agni, when she comes refulgent, thou goest forth soliciting fair riches.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य बुध्न उषसामिषण्यन् वृषा मही रोदसी आ विवेश ।
मही मित्रस्य वरुणस्य माया चन्द्रेव भानुं वि दधे पुरुत्रा॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya budhna uṣasāmiṣaṇyan vṛṣā mahī rodasī ā viveśa mahī mitrasya varuṇasya māyā candreva bhānuṃ vi dadhe purutrā
verses.en: On Law's firm base the speeder of the Mornings, the Bull, hath entered mighty earth and heaven. Great is the power of Varuna and Mitra, which, bright, hath spread in every place its splendour.

verses.sa:
इमा उ वां भृमयो मन्यमाना युवावते न तुज्या अभूवन् ।
क्व१ त्यदिन्द्रावरुणा यशो वां येन स्मा सिनं भरथः सखिभ्यः॥
verses.tr: imā u vāṃ bhṛmayo manyamānā yuvāvate na tujyā abhūvan kva1 tyadindrāvaruṇā yaśo vāṃ yena smā sinaṃ bharathaḥ sakhibhyaḥ
verses.en: Your well-known prompt activities aforetime needed no impulse from your faithful servant. Where, Indra-Varuna, is now that glory wherewith ye brought support to those who loved you?

verses.sa:
अयमु वां पुरुतमो रयीयञ्छश्वत्तममवसे जोहवीति ।
सजोषाविन्द्रावरुणा मरुद्भिर्दिवा पृथिव्या शृणुतं हवं मे॥
verses.tr: ayamu vāṃ purutamo rayīyañchaśvattamamavase johavīti sajoṣāvindrāvaruṇā marudbhirdivā pṛthivyā śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ me
verses.en: This man, most diligent, seeking after riches, incessantly invokes you for your favour. Accordant, Indra-Varuna, with Maruts, with Heaven and Earth, hear ye mine invocation.

verses.sa:
अस्मे तदिन्द्रावरुणा वसु ष्यादस्मे रयिर्मरुतः सर्ववीरः ।
अस्मान् वरूत्रीः शरणैरवन्त्वस्मान् होत्रा भारती दक्षिणाभिः॥
verses.tr: asme tadindrāvaruṇā vasu ṣyādasme rayirmarutaḥ sarvavīraḥ asmān varūtrīḥ śaraṇairavantvasmān hotrā bhāratī dakṣiṇābhiḥ
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, ours be this treasure ours be wealth, Maruts, with full store of heroes..May the Varutris with their shelter aid us, and Bharati and Hotri with the Mornings.

verses.sa: बृहस्पते जुषस्व नो हव्यानि विश्वदेव्य । रास्व रत्नानि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate juṣasva no havyāni viśvadevya rāsva ratnāni dāśuṣe
verses.en: Be pleased! with our oblations, thou loved of all Gods, Brhaspati: Give wealth to him who brings thee gifts.

verses.sa: शुचिमर्कैर्बृहस्पतिमध्वरेषु नमस्यत । अनाम्योज आ चके॥
verses.tr: śucimarkairbṛhaspatimadhvareṣu namasyata anāmyoja ā cake
verses.en: At sacrifices, with your hymns worship the pure Brhaspati- I pray for power which none may bend-

verses.sa: वृषभं चर्षणीनां विश्वरूपमदाभ्यम् । बृहस्पतिं वरेण्यम्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣabhaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ viśvarūpamadābhyam bṛhaspatiṃ vareṇyam
verses.en: The Bull of men, whom none deceive, the wearer of each shape at will, Brhaspati Most Excellent.

verses.sa: इयं ते पूषन्नाघृणे सुष्टुतिर्देव नव्यसी । अस्माभिस्तुभ्यं शस्यते॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ te pūṣannāghṛṇe suṣṭutirdeva navyasī asmābhistubhyaṃ śasyate
verses.en: Divine, resplendent Pusan, this our newest hymn of eulogy, By us is chanted forth to thee.

verses.sa: तां जुषस्व गिरं मम वाजयन्तीमवा धियम् । वधूयुरिव योषणाम्॥
verses.tr: tāṃ juṣasva giraṃ mama vājayantīmavā dhiyam vadhūyuriva yoṣaṇām
verses.en: Accept with favour this my song, be gracious to the earnest thought, Even as a bridegroom to his bride.

verses.sa: यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति । स नः पूषाविता भुवत्॥
verses.tr: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati sa naḥ pūṣāvitā bhuvat
verses.en: May he who sees all living things, see, them together at a glancc,- May lie, may Pusan be our help.

verses.sa: तत् सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥
verses.tr: tat saviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
verses.en: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So May he stimulate our prayers.

verses.sa: देवस्य सवितुर्वयं वाजयन्तः पुरंध्या । भगस्य रातिमीमहे॥
verses.tr: devasya saviturvayaṃ vājayantaḥ puraṃdhyā bhagasya rātimīmahe
verses.en: With understanding, earnestly, of Savitar the God we crave Our portion of prosperity.

verses.sa: देवं नरः सवितारं विप्रा यज्ञैः सुवृक्तिभिः । नमस्यन्ति धियेषिताः॥
verses.tr: devaṃ naraḥ savitāraṃ viprā yajñaiḥ suvṛktibhiḥ namasyanti dhiyeṣitāḥ
verses.en: Men, singers worship Savitar the God with hymn and holy rites, Urged by the impulse of their thoughts.

verses.sa: सोमो जिगाति गातुविद् देवानामेति निष्कृतम् । ऋतस्य योनिमासदम्॥
verses.tr: somo jigāti gātuvid devānāmeti niṣkṛtam ṛtasya yonimāsadam
verses.en: Soma who gives success goes forth, goes to the gathering place of Gods, To seat him at the seat of Law.

verses.sa: सोमो अस्मभ्यं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे च पशवे । अनमीवा इषस्करत्॥
verses.tr: somo asmabhyaṃ dvipade catuṣpade ca paśave anamīvā iṣaskarat
verses.en: To us and to our cattle may Soma give salutary food, To biped and to quadruped.

verses.sa: अस्माकमायुर्वर्धयन्नभिमातीः सहमानः । सोमः सधस्थमासदत्॥
verses.tr: asmākamāyurvardhayannabhimātīḥ sahamānaḥ somaḥ sadhasthamāsadat
verses.en: May Soma, strengthening our power of life, and conquering our foes, In our assembly take his seat.

verses.sa: आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम् । मध्वा रजांसि सुक्रतू॥
verses.tr: ā no mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatam madhvā rajāṃsi sukratū
verses.en: May Mitra-Varuna, sapient Pair, bedew our pasturage with oil, With meath the regions of the air.

verses.sa: उरुशंसा नमोवृधा मह्ना दक्षस्य राजथः । द्राघिष्ठाभिः शुचिव्रता॥
verses.tr: uruśaṃsā namovṛdhā mahnā dakṣasya rājathaḥ drāghiṣṭhābhiḥ śucivratā
verses.en: Far-ruling, joyful when adored, ye reign through majesty of might, With pure laws everlastingly.

verses.sa: गृणाना जमदग्निना योनावृतस्य सीदतम् । पातं सोममृतावृधा॥
verses.tr: gṛṇānā jamadagninā yonāvṛtasya sīdatam pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā
verses.en: Lauded by Jamadagni's song, sit in the place of holy Law: Drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law.
